entries.zh: 我们推荐§S$COSMIC_STORMS_TITLE$§!，因为你所选的部分选项与其主题相符。
entries.en: We're recommending §S$COSMIC_STORMS_TITLE$§! as some of the choices you've selected suit its content.

entries.zh: 统治议会中那些最为杰出的议员们擅长那些惊心动魄的体能考验。他们攀登最高的山峰，踩上最大的海浪，将一生都投入到追求这些原始的考验之中，并藉此获取大家的信任，以及引领众人前进的权利。\n\n无论青壮老幼，议会成员统一被称作长老，因为他们的事迹已然成为传奇，他们的名字也将流芳百世。
entries.en: The members of the most excellent ruling council excel at death-defying acts of physical prowess. By scaling the highest peak or riding the largest wave, they dedicate their lives to the unwavering pursuit of raw experience. This has earned them the trust of their community, and the right to chart a course forward.\n\nCouncil members are called Elders regardless of age, because their deeds have been deemed legendary. Long will their names be remembered.

entries.zh: 我们在星际气象学方面的最新进展使我们有能力根据命令呈现宇宙风暴。一旦有了合适的技术，我们甚至可以选择要制造的风暴类型。
entries.en: Our latest advances in astrometeorology grant us the ability to manifest Cosmic Storms on command. With the right technology, we can even choose the type of storm to create.

entries.zh: —$celestial_storm$会降低星系中的§Y$intel$§!，使得舰队可以通过被关闭的边境。
entries.en: - A $celestial_storm$ lowers §Y$intel$§! on systems and allows fleets to cross closed borders.

entries.zh: —$solar_storm$将揭示所有在受影响星系内的舰队。
entries.en: - A $solar_storm$ reveals every fleet in affected systems.

entries.zh: 利用风暴否定技术背后的原理，我们可以开始操纵星系的星际气象性质来满足我们自己的需求。
entries.en: By harnessing the principles behind storm negation technologies, we can begin to manipulate the astrometeorological nature of the galaxy to serve our own needs.

entries.zh: 对星际气象学的持续研究使我们有能力更精确地扭转和操纵§Y宇宙风暴§!以满足我们自己的需要。
entries.en: Continued study into astrometeorology grants us the power to more precisely bend and manipulate §YCosmic Storms§! to our own needs.

entries.zh: 这种天气通讯枢纽的可以减轻宇宙天气灾难造成的危害。过境的星系风暴对生产的影响将会降低。
entries.en: This nexus of weather communication mitigates the harm done by cosmic weather disasters. Production will suffer less from a passing galactic tempest.

entries.zh: 通过强化区域天气控制系统，调控行星天气模式，可以显著降低宇宙风暴对生产的大部分负面影响。
entries.en: By consolidating local weather control systems, planetary weather patterns can be manipulated to significantly reduce most of the cosmic storms' harmful effects on production.

entries.zh: 通过使用科学的天气模型，我们可以追踪即将到来的§Y宇宙风暴§!的运动和形成。
entries.en: Through the use of scientific weather models, we can track the movement and formation of impending §YCosmic Storms§!.

entries.zh: 在§Y天气预报地图模式§!中解锁§Y宇宙风暴形成预测§!和§Y宇宙风暴动向预测§!的能力
entries.en: Unlocks the ability to see §YCosmic Storm Formation Predictions§! and §YCosmic Storm Movement Predictions§! in the §YWeather Forecast Map Mode§!

entries.zh: 通过向我们的科学天气模型施加或然流，就能大幅提高我们追踪§Y宇宙风暴§!移动以及发现其形成过程的能力。
entries.en: By applying probability currents to our scientific weather models, our ability to track the movement and formation of impending §YCosmic Storms§! is greatly increased.

entries.zh: 最大化§Y天气预报地图模式§!中§Y宇宙风暴形成预测§!和§Y宇宙风暴动向预测§!的范围
entries.en: Maximizes the range of §YCosmic Storm Formation Predictions§! and §YCosmic Storm Movement Predictions§! in the §YWeather Forecast Map Mode§!

entries.zh: 这些抑制力场为穿行宇宙风暴的舰船提供了必需的保护。
entries.en: These dampening field generators offer much needed protection to ships traversing cosmic storms.

entries.zh: 这些特殊的涂层能够为舰船的表壳充能，并覆上风暴抑制力场，进而更有效地抗击风暴。
entries.en: This special coating charges the ship's exterior with a storm dampening field, leading to more efficient protection against storms.

entries.zh: 这种军事领域全新的合金布置方法能够显著减少宇宙风暴对能量以及爆炸性武器的影响。
entries.en: A new approach to alloy use in military applications significantly reduces the ability of cosmic storms to interfere with energy weaponry and explosive payloads.

entries.zh: 这种全新的舰船结构能够显著减少宇宙风暴对于武器系统的负面影响。
entries.en: This novel approach to ship architecture will significantly reduce the negative effects cosmic storms have on our weapon systems.

entries.zh: 允许你的科学船停止手头工作并无限期地维持§Y$default_storm$§!。
entries.en: Allows your Science Ships to stop and sustain §Y$default_storm$§! indefinitely.

entries.zh: 天气预报地图模式在星系地图上显示所有风暴、预测以及受影响的场域。
entries.en: The Weather Forecast Map Mode displays all storms, predictions, and influence fields on the galaxy map.

entries.zh: 在§H[this.GetAffectedStormType]§!带来破坏的余波中，我们取得了许多对这些宇宙自然现象的洞见。\n\n通过研究星际气象学，我们可以在未来更好地保护自己。这一全新的研究领域可能将会得出完全驾驭这些风暴的手段。
entries.en: In the aftermath of the devastation from the §H[this.GetAffectedStormType]§!, we have gained some unique insight on these galactic phenomena.\n\nBy studying astrometeorology, we can better protect ourselves in the future. This new field of research might eventually yield the means to master these storms.

entries.zh: 这些设施可以通过小心地调控吸引力来吸引附近的宇宙风暴。
entries.en: Through the careful manipulation of gravitational forces, these facilities attract nearby cosmic storms.

entries.zh: 在深入理解暗能量之后，我们得以将每座$building_storm_attraction_center$进行超载，以更高的效率吸引宇宙风暴。
entries.en: Advanced insights into dark energy allow us to supercharge each $building_storm_attraction_center$ and draw in cosmic storms even more efficiently.

entries.zh: 风暴越远，我们的人民越安全，而且这样他们就不用一直提心吊胆。这些复杂的星际气象核心仪器能够驱离逼近的风暴。
entries.en: The further the storm, the safer our population - and the easier their minds. The complex astrometeorological instrumentation of these centers repels approaching storms.

entries.zh: 只要能够保护我们的星球免遭宇宙风暴的侵袭，哪怕操控时空都是合理的。该核心装置的功能就在于此。
entries.en: Any manipulation of spacetime is warranted if it keeps our world clear from cosmic tempests. This center does exactly that.

entries.zh: 这个救援中心帮助当地居民消除宇宙风暴对殖民地生产的影响。通过高效沟通协作，$building_storm_resistant_production$快速部署救援小队，改善行星贸易环境。
entries.en: This aid center assists local efforts to negate the impact of a cosmic storm on colony production. Through efficient coordination and communication, the $building_storm_resistant_production$ allows for quick deployment of rescue teams, as well as improving the conditions for planet-wide trade.

entries.zh: 在$building_storm_resistant_production$部署天气控制系统后，宇宙风暴的负面影响大为减轻。此外，救援队伍能更高效地部署，行星贸易也几乎不再受当地天气条件的影响。
entries.en: By adding weather control systems to each $building_storm_resistant_production$, the negative effects of cosmic storms are significantly lessened. Additionally, rescue teams can be deployed even more efficiently and planetary trade is almost impervious to local weather conditions.

entries.zh: $building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$是对情感状况有着先进见解的宝库。在这里，我们让我们的人民在抵御公约残酷的诱惑之歌时能够在内心培育风暴。
entries.en: The $building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$ is a trove of advanced insights into the sentient condition. Here we empower people to cultivate their inner tempest while avoiding the luring song of the Convention's cruelty.

entries.en: If a cosmic storm passes this system, there is a 10% chance that £pop£ §HPops§! gain the $Name_Storm_Fused$ trait.

entries.zh: 每当宇宙风暴经过该恒星系，就有40%的概率让£pop£§H人口§!获得$Name_Storm_Fused$特质。此外，每过10年，就有20%的可能有§Y100§!£pop£§H人口§!化为宇宙风暴。
entries.en: If a cosmic storm passes this system, there is a 40% chance that £pop£ §HPops§! gain the $Name_Storm_Fused$ trait. Additionally, there is a 20% chance every 10 years that §Y100§! £pop£ §HPops§! are transformed into a cosmic storm.

entries.zh: 借助精密的传感器，该观测中心研究不同的气象环境，进而加深我们对自然宇宙的理解。
entries.en: With delicate sensors, this observation center studies diverse environmental conditions to better our understanding of the natural universe.

entries.zh: 艺术与科技的欢快展现，$job_storm_dancer_plural$们的旋转舞步引诱着宇宙风暴前来。
entries.en: A merriment of art and technology, the excited gyrations of our $job_storm_dancer_plural$ help to entice cosmic storms.

entries.zh: $building_storm_holo_theater$向整个星球及更远处广播，让$job_storm_dancer_plural$们迷人的影像传播开来。
entries.en: Broadcast over the entire planet and beyond, the $building_storm_holo_theater$ expands the reach of our hypnotic $job_storm_dancer_plural$.

entries.zh: 这些宏伟的剧场展现了艺术与科技成就的最前沿，为绝美的舞蹈提供了一个完美的舞台。
entries.en: Embodying the cutting edge of artistic and technical achievement, these grand theaters provide the perfect forum for the ultimate dance.

entries.zh: 该装置能够改变局部引力场，进而吸引深空中的风暴。
entries.en: This component allows us to manipulate local gravitational conditions to attract storms from the depths of space.

entries.en: This array of powerful lasers is able to create pockets of highly charged magnetic particles, creating a natural repellent force against cosmic storms.

entries.zh: $job_storm_dancer$的工作不只是表演那么简单，他们是在具现化风暴的本质。
entries.en: Far from a simple entertainer, the work of a $job_storm_dancer$ is to embody the very essence of the storm.

entries.zh: 风暴决斗者以狂暴的舞蹈和雷霆般的战斗来引导凶猛风暴，将武艺和仪式在竞技场里结合起来。
entries.en: Martial meets ritual in the arena as Storm Duelists channel the ferocity of the tempest in violent choreography and electrifying combat.

entries.zh: 这些专业的工作人员既是演员，又是博物馆的典藏员，还是战士，他们意识到理解过去的最好方式就是去亲身体验。
entries.en: Part actor, part museum curator, part warrior, these specialists realize that the best way to understand the past is to experience it.

entries.zh: 为了营造庄重典雅的几何美感，这里的地形经过精心塑造，而生活功能则退居其次。园中的植物品类经过筛选，仅保留单一种类栽培，以此消除任何可能破坏整体和谐的元素。
entries.en: The landscape has been altered to create a sublime geometric experience, prioritizing form over life. Any remaining flora has been reduced to a monoculture to eliminate discordant elements.

entries.zh: 这颗行星上的居民担忧最坏的情况出现，于是采取一切措施预防宇宙风暴带来的损害。
entries.en: Fearing the worst, the inhabitants of this planet will take any and all precautions against the effects of cosmic storms.

entries.zh: 既然宇宙风暴已经离去，我们也不用一直提心吊胆了。不过一切真能恢复“正常”吗？
entries.en: Once the danger of the cosmic storm has passed, we can relax our precautions. But will things ever truly return to 'normal'?

entries.zh: 让我们将这颗星球塑造成一场完美对称的盛典吧。如此纯粹的几何地景能带来内心的宁静。
entries.en: Let us sculpt this world into a celebration of perfect symmetry. To observe the pure geometry of the landscape will bring serenity.

entries.zh: §R必须要先清除所有障碍地块£blocker£§!
怀揣着对自然力量的尊重，这个种群不遗余力地研究自然气候内在的运作机制。在踏足星空之后，他们对于星际气象展现了极大的兴趣。而他们雄心壮志的核心就是探索宇宙风暴这一迷人又蕴含极大破坏力的现象。\n
entries.en: With deep respect for the forces of nature, this species goes to great lengths to uncover the inner workings of environmental phenomena. As they set out across the stars, they take with them a particular interest in astrometeorology. Central to their ambitions are the most fantastic and potentially destructive of all astronomical events, the cosmic storms themselves.\n

entries.zh: 随着这个种群踏足星空，他们的集体意识就被星际气象现象所吸引。蜂群为了一个崇高的目标而拓展疆域：研究宇宙风暴对外界环境产生的影响，并探索种种奇观。为此他们不惜亲身踏入风暴。
entries.en: As the collective reaches for the stars, their consciousness is entranced by the sight of astrometeorological phenomena. These drones expand their home for a noble purpose: to study environmental effects and find wonder in even the cosmic storms themselves.

entries.zh: 对自然力量的理解给这个机械帝国带来了深刻的影响，帝国的集体意识不遗余力地对自然现象开展研究，以神圣庄严的态度勤勤恳恳地记录着所有独特的星际气象现象。而他们研究的重点则是宇宙风暴这一最奇异且蕴含极大破坏力的现象。
entries.en: Understanding how the forces of nature can have profound effects on a machine empire, this collective goes to great lengths to study them. Their models painstakingly detail every every curious astronomical event to an almost sacred level. Central to their focus are the most fantastic and potentially destructive of all astronomical events, the cosmic storms themselves.

entries.zh: 环境效应不是可以开发的免费资源，那还能是什么呢？这家巨型企业专门从星际气象现象中获取尽可能多的知识，并将其出售给出价最高的人。
entries.en: What are environmental effects if not another free resource to exploit? This megacorp specializes in acquiring as much knowledge from astrometeorological phenomena as they can and sell it to the highest bidder.

entries.zh: 自古以来，这个社会能够用仪式来召唤风暴。年复一年，他们不停地运用科技创新提高仪式的效率。而随着太空时代到来，他们得以将这一知识运用与于群星之间。
entries.en: Ever since ancient times, this society has been able to attract tempests through their rituals. Over the years, they combined technical innovations to enhance their efficiency. With the dawn of the space age, they now seek to take this knowledge to the stars.

entries.zh: 这家庞大的媒体集团起初只是一个对神圣仪式的进行简单广播的组织，后来先知和祭司的位置被魅力非凡的艺人所取代，他们都在吸引宇宙风暴这一赛道上争奇斗艳。
entries.en: What started as a simple broadcast of sacred rituals, has since blossomed into a massive media conglomerate. Seers and priests were replaced by charismatic entertainers, all competing to gain a modicum of attention as they appeal to the cosmic storms themselves.

entries.zh: 在经过亿万年精心培养其母星上的完美平衡之后，这个社会已经准备好面对宇宙中那些最不宜居的环境。人们内心坚信，自然世界可以被塑造，控制，并臻于完美。这不是驯化环境，而是为了追求完美。
entries.en: After eons of carefully cultivating a perfect balance on their homeworld, this society is ready to tend to even the most inhospitable environments among the stars. At their core, these people believe nature can be shaped, controlled, and perfected. Not to tame, but in service of perfect beauty.

entries.en: Being a part of a great organism allows these drones to recognize opportunities inside the greatest organism of all: nature. They seek to control and shape natural systems to the collective's desires.

entries.zh: 在有机先驱逝去之后，他们的机械造物仍然保持着对于审美的偏爱。自然世界就是实现编程完美主义的沃土。
entries.en: While the organic precursors are gone, their machine creations still maintain a preference for the old aesthetics. The natural world is fertile ground for programmed perfectionism.

entries.zh: 这家巨型企业的员工们习惯居住在镀金笼子之中。因此，不论他们走到哪，哪都得变成镀金笼子。
entries.en: The employees of this Megacorp are used to living inside a golden cage. Accordingly, the corporation will build one wherever they go.

entries.en: Being inside a cosmic storm fills the $trait_storm_touched$ with devotional aspiration.

entries.zh: 风暴交融者在努力悟道的过程中学会了构建心中的小风暴。
entries.en: The Storm Fused learned to cultivate their Inner Storm as they strain for enlightenment.

如何处理宇宙风暴应该是每个国家自己的责任，不应由星海共同体来分担。
entries.en: How to handle cosmic storms should be an empire's own responsibility. The galactic community should not have to share this burden.

entries.zh: 宇宙风暴影响甚广；应当平等分享所有与其行为有关的知识。
entries.en: Cosmic storms affect us all; any knowledge pertaining to their behavior should be shared equally.

entries.zh: 是时候主动出击了。鼓励创新能让我们更好地利用宇宙风暴带来的经济价值。
entries.en: It is time to be more proactive. Better innovation will help us to utilize the economic gains of the cosmic storms.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_cosmic_storms_protection_initiative$§! resolution , leaving §Y$resolution_cosmic_storms_shared_knowledge$§! as galactic law.

entries.zh: 抵御宇宙风暴促使我们提高效率，但仍有许多东西有待发掘。
entries.en: Weathering the cosmic storms has pushed us to increase our efficiency, but there is still so much more to be gained.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_cosmic_storms_galactic_management$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_cosmic_storms_protection_initiative$§! as galactic law.

entries.zh: 以后我们一定要针对宇宙风暴做好保护，但是也不能就此停止对于风暴的开发利用。
entries.en: It is no longer responsible for any of us to go without cosmic storm protection, and equally foolish not to take advantage of what the storms can offer.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_cosmic_storms_utilization_protocols$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_cosmic_storms_galactic_management$§! as galactic law.

entries.zh: 我们有着主宰宇宙风暴的使命，自然力量本就该服务于我们。
entries.en: We are called to dominate the cosmic storms. These forces of nature were meant to serve us.

entries.zh: 通过释放重要的粒子和能量，宇宙风暴为星系注入生命，焕新它所触及的行星和系统。它们的自然流动不应受到阻碍。
entries.en: By dispersing vital particles and energy, cosmic storms breathe life into the galaxy, renewing the planets and systems they touch. Their natural passage must not be hindered.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_cosmic_storms_storm_encouragement_mandate$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_cosmic_storms_galactic_emergency_relief$§! as galactic law.

entries.zh: 星系是一个巨大且互相联系的系统，宇宙风暴是其中一个重要的组成部分。干涉风暴的行为将违反星际法。
entries.en: The galaxy is a vast, interconnected ecosystem in which cosmic storms play a vital part. Influencing their behavior must be outlawed.

entries.en: A more advanced version of the machine the Inetian Traders used to manipulate cosmic storms; by default this device will increase the effectiveness of all our storm-related technology, but when properly utilized it can even drive out all storms from our borders.

entries.zh: 即使该装置处于关闭状态，其中蕴含的能量也是显而易见的。我们真的敢在最杰出的人才身上引发一场剧烈的风暴吗？为了帝国的荣耀，牺牲势在必行。
entries.en: The waiting potential of this device is tangible even in a powered-down state. Dare we invoke tempestuous fury inside one of our best and brightest? For the glory of our nation, sacrifices must be made.

entries.en: Generate a ['concept_nexus_storm'] in a system of your choice.\n$t$Once a system is selected, a $scientist_with_icon$ will be §PSacrificed§!.

entries.zh: 宇宙风暴经过后，出现了一颗组成成分极不寻常的彗星。它似乎是由有机材料组成的。我们的[solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural]迫切想要进行调查。
entries.en: A cosmic storm has left behind a comet of unusual composition. It appears to be made of organic material. Our [solar_system.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are keen to investigate.

entries.zh: 我们发现这颗彗星实际上是一个巨大的巢穴，里面充斥着微小的昆虫。彗尾也不是冰雾，而是巢穴内部化学反应所排放的废气。\n\n巢穴的外壳由死亡的昆虫组成，这使得内部生的物免受太空恶劣环境的影响。我们还发现了几种依附于巢穴生活的真菌。巢穴中存在一种复杂的共生关系，真菌依赖排放的废气维生，而昆虫则以真菌为食。
entries.en: The comet was revealed to be a giant nest filled with tiny insects. The tail of the comet is not outgassed ice, but rather exhaust from chemical processes occurring deep inside the hive.\n\nThe outer layer of the nest is composed of dead individuals, protecting the living inside from the harsh conditions of space. We've also picked up several types of fungi living in and around the nest. There is a complex symbiosis at work here, with the fungi living off of the exhaust gases and the insects feeding on the fungi.

entries.zh: 轨道上的这个物体是途经的宇宙风暴带来的。它看上去像是一座空间站，但是对其结构组成的扫描结果却有点令人费解。我们建议对此开展调查。
entries.en: This orbiting object has been left behind by a passing cosmic storm. It looks like a space station but scans of its structural composition is returning most confusing results. We recommend investigating.

entries.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetScientistPluralCapital]报告称这个空间站的大部分是由常见的固定材料建成的，这些物质勉强维持着空间站不至于散架。随着我们深入这座结构，构成空间站的物质从金属合金过渡成了塑料等其他材料。

在空间站的核心处，我们发现了一台机器正在高效运转，它不断地拆解有机原料并将其转化为我们之前见到的东西。

在运行DNA模拟模型后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]只能得出结论，这些原料可能是空间站的前住民。
entries.en:
[Root.Owner.GetScientistPluralCapital] report that much of this space station is constructed from everyday stationary objects, barely holding it together. Deeper into the structure, the materials transition from metal alloys to plastics and other substances.

Inside the heart of the construct we found a machine, still in the process of efficiently deconstructing organic material and shaping it into the very items encountered so far.

After running a DNA simulation model, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have been forced to conclude that the material likely came from the former inhabitants of this outpost.

entries.zh: 看看我们能发现些什么。
entries.en: See if we can't gain something here.

entries.zh: 自从一场$shroud_storm$肆虐该恒星系后，我们就开始不断收到一些奇怪的信号。然而，当我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]想要回应这些呼叫时，信号又中断了。科学家们建议派出一艘科研船进行调查。
entries.en: Ever since a $shroud_storm$ raged through this system, we've been receiving strange signals. However, as soon as our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] try to answer this cacophony of hails, it dissipates again. They recommend sending a science vessel.

entries.zh:
这是我们始料未及的发现：大脑集群。来自各种物种的湿糊糊的有机处理器官，成百上千个地连接在一起，悬浮在一个气球状的大型胶囊之中。它似乎已经被废弃，在近期的$shroud_storm$消散之后飘浮在深空之中。

胶囊之中有一个惊人的传感器阵列连接在大脑和胶囊之上，此外还有一个通信模块，能够呼叫舰船并发送信息，之前它对我们就是这么做的。

现在看来似乎是这些大脑自己联系了我们，解释了那一连串的信息。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为这个装置的初衷是测试有机体对$shroud_storm$的反应。考虑到这些悬浮大脑内不稳定的残留灵能，尝试与其连接可能会带来危险。
entries.en:
We could never have anticipated our discovery: brains. Organic, squishy central processing organs from all sorts of species. Hundreds and hundreds of them, all linked together and suspended inside a large balloon-like capsule. It appears to be derelict, left floating in the depths of space after a recent $shroud_storm$ dissipated.

The capsule contains an incredible array of sensors attached to the brains and the balloon, and there is also a communication module, capable of hailing ships and transmitting information, just as it did to us.

It seems likely that the brains themselves contacted us, explaining the cacophony of messages. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] think the construction was designed to measure organic responses to a $shroud_storm$. Given the unstable psionic residue within these floating minds, attempting to interface them would only lead to disaster.

entries.zh:
[fleet.GetName]的扫描仪显示[From.GetStarName]恒星系中漂浮着一座被废弃的空间站。

看起来它是被途径的宇宙风暴卷到这里来的。里面没有探测到生命，也没有任何形式的能量信号。空间站两侧则伸出来一对巨大的望远镜。这对光学设备看起来很先进，不过其尺寸相对于空间站而言还是显得太大了。整个空间站的所展现的科技与结构对于我们而言还是比较陌生。

我们可以试着重启这组望远镜，这或许能给我们带来一些有趣的洞见。
entries.en:
Scans performed by the [fleet.GetName] indicate the presence of a derelict space station in the [From.GetStarName] System.

It looks like it was deposited there by a passing cosmic storm. Life signs return negative, and there are no power signals of any kind. Two massive telescopes protrude from opposite sides of the station. These optical instruments appear advanced, and far too large relative to the station's size. The technology and architecture are not yet familiar to us.

We could attempt to reactivate the telescopes, as this could yield some interesting insights.

entries.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]着实费了一番巧劲才登上空间站并重启望远镜，终究还是没有什么能难倒他们。然而，望远镜瞄向的地方并没有什么值得特别注意的东西。

我们发现空间站周围散布着一些有趣的文物，那是望远镜所拍下的清晰照片，它们被放在精美的相框中。这些照片都是关于宇宙风暴的，它们详细记录了经过该恒星系的所有风暴并且每一次都拍摄了多张照片。望远镜操作员更换变焦，从不同角度进行拍摄，甚至还艺术地倾斜镜头来展示风暴最美的景象。

深入调查后，我们在这座废弃站点上的唯一发现就是这些有趣的艺术作品。我们将对它们进行归档，以便让后来人能够欣赏到这些罕见的、充满力量和美感的图像。
entries.en:
Boarding the station and activating the telescopes took some finessing from our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural], but it was nothing they could not handle. However, the corner of the galaxy the instruments were pointed at showed nothing of note.

Some interesting artifacts were found scattered around the station: detailed images recorded from the telescopes, neatly presented in decorative frames. Every single capture is focussed on cosmic storms, with multiple prints of each storm that has passed through this system. The telescope operator used different angles, zoom levels, and even artistic tilts to show the storms in their best light.

Upon deeper investigation, the artwork is the only interesting find aboard the abandoned station. We will archive them so many future generations can enjoy these images of rare power and beauty.

entries.zh: 宇宙风暴过境[from.solar_system.GetName]星系时改变了该恒星的外观。在风暴的余波过后，这颗恒星的日冕层呈现出异彩纷呈的漩涡，向四面八方喷射出五光十色的耀斑。这一现象值得进一步分析。
entries.en: The passing of a cosmic storm through the [from.solar_system.GetName] system has transformed the visual appearance of the system's star. In the aftermath of the storm, the star's coronal layer presents as a swirl of ever-changing colors, ejecting polychromatic flares in all directions. The phenomenon warrants further analysis.

entries.zh:
[root.leader.GetName]汇报了自[from.GetAffectedStormType]过境以来，[From.GetStarName]的聚变反应所发生的奇妙变化。

显然，这个风暴引发了恒星内核某种意想不到的核反应，导致其对流区稳定地释放出[from.GetEarnedResources]。

这些复杂而特殊的反应产生了我们所观察到的这些不寻常的多色闪光。无论如何，在一段时间内这的都会一直是一个值得仔细研究的来源。
entries.en:
[root.leader.GetName] reports fascinating changes in [From.GetStarName]'s fusion reactions since the passage of the [from.GetAffectedStormType].

It appears that the storm induced unexpected nuclear reactions within the star's core, resulting in a steady release of [from.GetEarnedResources] from its convective zones.

These complex and idiosyncratic reactions are producing the unusual polychromatic flaring we have observed. In any case, it will continue to be a source worthy of close study for some time.

entries.zh: 一场路过的宇宙风暴致使[from.solar_system.GetName]星系中产生了三颗新的小行星。这些天体容易发生难以解释的方向变化，因此无法预测它们的轨迹。此事需要进一步的研究。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm deposited three new asteroids in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system. These celestial bodies are prone to inexplicable changes of direction, making it impossible to predict their trajectories. Further research is needed.

entries.zh: [root.leader.GetName]发现，沉积于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的小行星具有高度不稳定的磁性质，导致它们在恒星系中现有的磁层上发生随机的弹跳。\n\n[root.leader.GetName]通过给每个小行星施加磁场补偿器进行了稳定，使其轨道规范化并使其便于进行资源开采。
entries.en: [root.leader.GetName] discovered that the asteroids deposited in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system possess highly unstable magnetic fields, causing them to ricochet haphazardly off the system's existing magnetospheres.\n\n[root.leader.GetName] stabilized them by adding magnetic compensators to each asteroid, regulating their trajectories and thus making them amenable to resource extraction efforts.

entries.zh: 在§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!的余波中，从§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系上侦测到了一个未识别的求助信号。
entries.en: In the aftermath of the §H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§! an unidentified distress signal has been detected in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh:
我们已经确定了§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中遇险信号的来源，那一艘严重受损但仍在运作的商船。

乘员声称他们被§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!撞离了航线很远。风暴也烧毁了他们的引擎，让飞船和里面的东西滞留在我们的空间里。

如果我们能帮忙的话，他们愿意交出一部分货物。
entries.en:
We have identified the source of the distress signal in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system as a heavily damaged but still functioning mercantile vessel.

The occupants claim they have been knocked a great distance off course by the §H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!. The storm has also burnt out their engines, leaving the ship and its contents stranded in our space.

They are willing to part with a portion of their cargo if we can help.

entries.zh: 我们可以提供帮助换取一些基因样品。
entries.en: We will help in exchange for some DNA samples.

entries.zh: 夺走他们的生命以及货物。
§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!的余波中，监测§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!的质量探测器得到了异常读数。\n\n系统性诊断没有发现设备存在技术故障，所以这些读数需要进行进一步调查。
entries.en: Mass sensors monitoring §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! are showing erratic readings in the aftermath of the §H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!.\n\nSystem diagnostics show no sign of a technical error with the equipment. These readings require further investigation.

entries.zh:
§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系内的异常读数源自一片由§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!的余波所残留下的不寻常的碎片阵列。

这个漂浮的实体是由一团无定形的宇宙污泥在风暴的极端压力下锻造而成。它的无数组成元素形成了一种独特的活性化合物。

对其化学成分的深度研究可以对产生它的条件提供有价值的星际气象学洞见。
entries.en:
The erratic sensor readings in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system are derived from an exceptional debris formation left in the wake of the §H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!.

This drifting entity is an amorphous blob of cosmic sludge, forged in the extreme pressures of the storm. Its innumerable constituent elements have formed a uniquely reactive compound.

Focused study of its chemistry could yield valuable astrometeorological insights into the conditions that produced it.

entries.zh: 在§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!的余波中，§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系内探测到了一个不明物体。对该碎片的进一步研究可以提供宝贵的洞见。
entries.en: In the aftermath of the §H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!, an unidentified object has been detected in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system. Further analysis of this debris could provide valuable insights.

entries.zh:
§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中的物体是一颗古老人造卫星的残骸，上面装有复杂的星际气象探测阵列。我们认为它是伴随着§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!横跨星系漂星过海而来的。

它已严重损坏无法维修，但中央数据库包含了大量的信息贮藏可以为我们所用。

卫星的其余部分就只能作为废品进行打捞了。
entries.en:
The object in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system is the wreckage of an ancient satellite equipped with complex astrometeorological sensor arrays. We believe that it was swept a great distance across the galaxy in the wake of the §H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!.

Now damaged beyond repair, its central databases contain a vast store of information that we can repurpose for our own needs.

The rest of the satellite is only salvageable as scrap.

entries.zh: §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中的探测器发现一个近期被§H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!带进这个恒星系的不明物体。\n\n需要近距离调查以验证该异常物体的本质。
entries.en: Sensors in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system have detected an unknown object brought into the system by the recent §H[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!.\n\nCloser inspection is needed to verify the nature of the anomaly.

entries.zh: 我们发现，§H[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系的怪异物体其实是一大团来自某种太空生物的有机残留物。由于所有可供识别的特征都被宇宙风暴撕碎了，所以无法对这些生物碎片进行准确分类。
entries.en: The foreign object in the §H[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system was discovered to be a large mass of organic remains originating from some type of spaceborne fauna. Having had any identifiable features shredded apart by the cosmic storm, it is impossible to correctly catalog the biological debris.

entries.zh: 幸运的是，大部分仍可食用。
[leader.GetName]确信，对该生物遗骸进行更详细的法医分析将揭示更多有关其起源性质的信息，以及§Y[from.GetAffectedStormType]§!对类似太空生物的影响。
entries.en: [leader.GetName] is confident that a more detailed forensic analysis of the creature's remains would reveal more information about the nature of its origins and the effects of a §Y[from.GetAffectedStormType]§! on similar space faring organisms.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[solar_system.GetName]§!星系发现了被宇宙风暴夹带着穿越星系的某种未知生物的遗骸。对待这具遗骸进行法医鉴定可以揭示更多信息。
entries.en: We have encountered the remains of an unknown creature in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system dragged across the galaxy by a cosmic storm. Forensic dissection of the corpse should reveal more information.

entries.zh: 经过了谨慎的解剖，这团肉块究竟属于什么物种仍是个谜。在风暴中心遭受的巨大破坏使它失去了一切可供识别的特征和遗传标记。\n\n然而，在这项研究的过程中，我们获得了对§Y宇宙风暴§!组成的洞见，了解了其对外星生物质的破坏性影响。
entries.en: After careful dissection, the original species of this visceral mass remains a mystery. The extraordinary damage taken in the epicenter of the storm has stripped it of any recognizable features or genetic markers.\n\nHowever, in the process of this study we have gained insight into the composition of §YCosmic Storms§! and their devastating effects on xenobiological matter.

entries.zh: 我的探测器从$default_storm$的余波中在§H[solar_system.GetName]§!星系发现了三个缇扬奇信号。
entries.en: In the aftermath of the $default_storm$ our sensors have detected three Tiyanki signatures in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh:
§H[solar_system.GetName]§!星系内的三只缇扬奇信号经过识别后发现是一伙流离失所、营养不良的幼崽。

§Y$default_storm$§!将这些幼崽与它们的大群分开，迫使他们自力更生。

它们看来不太可能在幽深的太空中存活太久。我们的传感器显示它们整在试图呼叫鲸群，但没有成功。
entries.en:
The three Tiyanki signatures in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system have been identified as a set of displaced and malnourished calves.

The §Y$default_storm$§! has separated these calves from their larger pod, leaving them to fend for themselves.

They are unlikely to survive for long in open space. Our sensors show they are attempting to call for their pod but are having no success.

entries.zh: 我们可以放大它们呼救的声音，把它们当作诱饵，引来一顿更大的大餐。
entries.en: We could boost their cries for help and use them as bait to draw in a larger feast.

entries.zh: 我们的通讯系统可以用来增强它们的呼救声，吸引它们的群体进入恒星系。
entries.en: Our communication systems could be used to boost their cries for help and attract their pod into the system.

entries.zh: 向你的['concept_vivarium']中增加3只随机稀有度的§Y$NAME_Tiyanki_Hatchling$§!
entries.en: Add 3 §Y$NAME_Tiyanki_Hatchling$§! of random rarity to your ['concept_vivarium']

entries.zh: 三只被宇宙风暴从鲸群中带丢的缇扬奇幼崽在[this.solar_system.GetName]星系游荡。我们可以通过放大它们的叫声来帮助它们把鲸群吸引到这个星系中来帮助它们重聚。
entries.en: Three Tiyanki calves are lost and wandering the [this.solar_system.GetName] system, separated from their pod by a cosmic storm. We can help reunite them with their pod by boosting their cries to attract the rest of their pod to the system.

entries.zh:
缇扬奇的成兽在听到了三只幼崽被放大的叫声后，再度现身在§H[solar_system.GetName]§!星系中。

年轻的缇扬奇重新回到了鲸群，现在已经恢复了快乐和健康。

母鲸在我们的科研船附近留下了一大堆物质碎片，似乎是在感谢我们的帮助。令我们惊讶的是，这件奇怪的礼物中包含了好几种可用的材料。
entries.en:
A Tiyanki cow and bull have both appeared in the §H[solar_system.GetName]§! system having heard the amplified cries of the three displaced calves.

The juvenile Tiyanki have been reintegrated back into their pod, and already appear much happier and healthier.

The cow has deposited a large mass of debris near our science vessel, seemingly as some kind of appreciation for our assistance. To our surprise this curious offering contains several usable materials.

entries.zh: 当然，这些大东西才是真正的猎物；我们已经准备好猎杀了。
entries.en: Of course, these larger beasts are the true prize; primed and ready for the slaughter.

entries.zh: 亿万年前，两颗行星在此相撞。在毁灭的余波中，诞生了一颗独一无二的星球。
entries.en: Eons ago two planets collided. In the wake of their demise a unique world was born.

entries.zh: 灾难的阴影时刻威胁着这颗独特行星之上的脆弱平衡。
entries.en: Disaster threatens to shatter the fragile balance of this unique planet.

entries.zh:
自从探测到[From.Planet.GetName]的那一刻起，它就一直吸引着我们的目光。

在这样一个广阔而混乱的星系中，两个天体相撞并不是什么罕见的事情。不过，在此前类似的碰撞中，至少相撞的其中一个或者全部两个都会被摧毁。

让[From.Planet.GetName]变成现在样子的碰撞发生在数百万年前，但这两颗星球却保持着一种奇怪的平衡，甚至在这一过程中还形成了维护生命体的大气层。
entries.en:
From the moment we detected [From.Planet.GetName], its mere existence has been a source of fascination.

It is not the collision of two celestial objects that is unusual, as the galaxy is a vast and chaotic place. However, in all known instances of such an impact, one or both of the bodies in question was destroyed.

The collision that formed [From.Planet.GetName] took place millions of years ago, and yet these two worlds maintain a strange equilibrium, and have even formed a life-sustaining atmosphere in the process.

entries.zh: “相撞行星”上的情况远比预期的更加危险。最近一连串的地震又揭开了曾经相撞地区的伤疤，大量岩浆从地表喷涌而出。全球变暖和遮天蔽日的火山灰已经开始影响行星地表的各种生物。\n\n更糟糕的是，根据预测结果，如果我们不能在接下来的50年中稳定这对行星，那么行星板块活动将愈演愈烈，并最终使[From.Planet.GetName]解体！
entries.en: The situation on the so-called "collided planet" has turned out to be far more precarious than anticipated. A recent series of earthquakes opened up the old scars around the impact zone, causing a significant amount of magma to erupt from the ground. Various planetary biomes are already beginning to suffer from rising global temperatures and the volcanic ash that clouds the skies.\n\nTo make matters worse, if the joint planets are not stabilized within the next 50 years, our readings predict that tectonic activity will continue to escalate, ultimately causing the complete disintegration of [From.Planet.GetName]!

entries.zh:
我们顶尖的地质学家齐聚于此，提出了两条可行的方案来拯救处于恐怖地壳活动之中的[From.Planet.GetName]。

第一个计划是稳定当前状态，尽管填补撞击区域周围的火山需要数个世纪之久，但是我们可以先小心地在地表进行钻孔，减小地壳压力，避免板块失稳。残余的火山产物将用于改造行星，塑造一个稳定的生态环境。

第二个计划就比较宏大了，与其减轻地壳压力，我们不如利用火山喷发产生的能量和物质来开展定向的环境改造。

这种方法使我们能够塑造出多种生态环境，让不同的生命在此生存，将这个星球变为天堂。然而，该计划失败的可能性很大，甚至可能导致这颗独特的星球完全毁灭。
entries.en:
Our top geologists came together and formed two possible plans to save the [From.Planet.GetName] from succumbing to tectonic terror.

The first plan is to stabilize the collision. While it would take many centuries to heal the volcanic wound around the impact zone, through careful terrestrial trepanning we can alleviate the pressure on the planet's crust, preventing further tectonic instability. The remaining volcanic byproducts will be used to terraform the planet into a stable biome.

The second plan is far more ambitious. Instead of alleviating the pressure on the planet's crust, the energy and materials generated by the volcanic eruption could be adapted to a tailored terraforming process.

This approach allows us to sculpt a multitude of biomes capable of sustaining every type of lifeform, turning this world into a paradise. However, there is a significant chance that this procedure will fail - and could even lead to the complete and utter destruction of this unique stellar body.

entries.zh: 我们选择稳定当前状态。
我们选择利用火山产物。
毁灭性的地壳活动会将相撞星球撕开——在这过程中两颗行星都毁灭了。
entries.en: Devastating tectonic activity will break the Collided Planet apart - destroying both worlds in the process.

entries.zh: 这颗星球将在50年之后崩坏。
entries.en: This world will collapse after 50 years have passed.

entries.zh: 如果我们想要避免这颗星球走向崩坏，就必须要将其稳定下来。
entries.en: Stabilizing the collided planet is necessary if we want to prevent this world from collapsing.

entries.zh: 执行这个大胆的计划，改造被撞行星的生态环境吧。我们要么创造一个适合所有生命的星球，要么将这颗行星推向毁灭。
entries.en: Carry out our ambitious plan to harmonize the biomes of the collided planet. We will either create a world for all, or doom it in the process.

entries.zh: 我们稳定被撞星球的努力得到了回报！先前威胁[From.Planet.GetName]的地震已经被平息，火山带来的产物也如同我们预想中一样迅速减少，这颗星球又回复到了最初处于脆弱平衡的状态。\n\n眼下环境改造的问题在于：[From.Planet.GetName]改造的方向应该是什么？
entries.en: Our efforts to stabilize the collided world paid off! The tremors that previously threatened [From.Planet.GetName]'s existence have been silenced and the volcanic byproducts are rapidly decreasing as we speak, returning the world to its fragile balance.\n\nOne question remains for our final terraforming push: which class of planet shall [From.Planet.GetName] become?

entries.zh: 保持当前的陆地星球状态。
令人震惊的是，我们原以为这些工作只能堪堪稳定[collided_planets.GetName]，没想到我们的成果远超预期。\n\n$cstorms.1225.desc.def$
entries.en: Extraordinary! We thought our efforts would only go as far as to stabilize [collided_planets.GetName], but it turned into something so much more!\n\n$cstorms.1225.desc.def$

entries.zh: 看，这是一个天堂，一个能够让你想象中所有生命形式生活的天堂。\n\n拯救了一个走向毁灭的世界，并将其改造成了现在这副振奋人心的模样——还有什么比这更伟大的成就呢？命运女神无疑是眷顾我们的。
entries.en: Behold, a paradise, a planet capable of sustaining nearly every form of life imaginable.\n\nTo be able to save a doomed world and to transform it into something this inspiring - has there ever been a greater accomplishment? Fortune surely favors us.

entries.zh:
尽管星球本身幸存下来了，但将其改造为天堂的努力却付诸东流了。

行星严峻的地壳活动阻碍了我们对生态环境的改造，不过不稳定的状况似乎已经结束了。火山活动则回到了之前的水平，尽管在撞击区域火山依旧活跃，但短时间内不太可能再次升级。

最坏的时期似乎已经过去了。现在我们所面临的挑战是重建这颗星球。
entries.en:
While the world itself was thankfully saved, our endeavor to terraform the collided planet into a paradise has failed.

Our attempts to tailor the biome were frustrated by the planet's severe tectonic activity, although the worst of the destabilization appears to be over. Volcanic activity has returned to the levels first witnessed before the recent upheaval, and while the impact site remains active, it is unlikely to escalate any time soon.

The worst appears to be over. Our challenge now is to rebuild this world.

entries.zh: 我们试图拯救濒临毁灭的被撞行星的努力付诸东流了。尽管科学家们采取了一切可能的预防措施，但他们的模型从未能考虑到所有情况。\n\n随着星球的残骸逐渐漂向虚空，整个星系都为这一奇景的消失而哀悼。
entries.en: Our attempt to save the collided planet from impending doom has failed miserably. While our scientists took every possible precaution, their models were never able to take every contingency into account.\n\nAs the remnants of these worlds drift ever further into the void, the galaxy mourns the loss of this unique phenomenon.

entries.zh: 被撞行星的毁灭进程完全按照我们的所预测的时间线进行，准确度精确到十分位。这个曾经一度点缀了星海的奇景，如今除了空留下一堆岩石，什么也没有剩下。
entries.en: The collapse of the collided planet followed our timeline predictions down to the decimal. Where once the galaxy was enriched by a unique phenomenon, now nothing but rocks remain.

entries.zh: 我们发现一颗行星表面覆盖着密密麻麻数以兆计的红色昆虫。这对于我们而言究竟是灾疫还是机遇呢？
entries.en: We found a planet carpeted in trillions of red insects. A plague, or an opportunity?

entries.zh: 我们在[From.GetStarName]恒星系中发现了一颗红色的行星，颜色很深。我们应该对此开展调查。
entries.en: A scarlet planet was surveyed in the [From.GetStarName] system. The intensity of the color is remarkable. We should investigate.

entries.zh:
从远处看，[From.GetName]就像那些红色珠宝一样散发着光芒。对于这样一种地质异常现象，通常可能的原因是因为有黏土或者是其他种类的土壤中夹杂了硬金属。但这次的事实要更为离奇。

那是虫子，上万亿条虫子。它们聚集在一起，密密麻麻地铺满了[From.GetName]表面。

我们快速将其命名为“猩红爬虫”，这群无脊椎生物的繁殖周期十分短。尽管没有破坏自然环境，但它们四处蠕动，搞得[From.GetName]不适合开展殖民。

有人提出了一条不怎么正经的方法来处理这些昆虫。初步扫描显示它们是可食用的，或许我们可以把它们当作新的食物来源？不管怎样，至少我们建议先调查一下。
entries.en:
From a distance, [From.GetName]'s shone like some precious crimson jewel. Clay or other soil types infused with hard metals would be the usual explanation for such a geographical anomaly, but the truth was far more bizarre.

Bugs. Trillions, upon trillions, of bugs. They swarm over the surface of [From.GetName] in an almost unbroken carpet of multi-legged life.

Quickly dubbed the 'crimson crawlers', these invertebrates possess a remarkably hyperactive reproduction cycle. While not harmful to their native environment, [From.GetName] is not well suited for colonization with these creatures scurrying about.

One rather unorthodox method of handling the insects has been proposed. Initial scans show they are edible, so perhaps we have found a new food source? We advise at least investigating the opportunity.

entries.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]地表完全被这些温和的红色昆虫所覆盖。想要行星变得宜居，就要先处理掉这些虫子。与此同时，它们似乎是一种不错的食物来源，或许我们可以从此入手。
entries.en: [From.Planet.GetName] is entirely covered by placid, red insects. The planet could be habitable if the bugs are dealt with. At the same time, they appear to be a good source of food. There may be a path forward here.

entries.zh:
一开始，大家都觉得把这种猩红爬虫当作食物有点太荒谬了。但在把一份虫子标本带回船上后，人们觉得吃这些虫子也不是不能接受。

这些虫子简直是奇迹的造物，神经系统极其先进，但是却没有大脑这种中枢处理器官。更重要的是，它们浅色的肉出人意料地嫩滑多汁，哪怕是生吃，猩红的外骨骼尝起来也既酥脆又美味。

现在的问题是，这些虫子是更适合作为研究材料，还是更适合作为一种美味的食物。把它们做成菜肴会带来更多风味和乐趣，但特别是在搭配适当调味品的情况下直接生吃会更快更简单。
entries.en:
The idea of consuming the crimson crawlers may have seemed preposterous at first, but when a specimen was brought on board, it became far more palatable.

The insects are a creature of wonder, possessing an extremely advanced nervous system without the benefit of a central processing organ. More importantly, their pale flesh is surprisingly tender and moist, and even when consumed raw, the vermillion-hued exoskeleton was deemed both crispy and delightful.

The question remains as to whether the bugs would better serve as research material or as a delectable source of food. Cooking them might provide more flavor and fun, but eating them as they come will be quicker and easier, especially if paired with the appropriate condiment.

entries.zh: 一艘不祥的飞船出现在我们的传感器上——但它正处于宇宙风暴之中。那里发生了什么？
entries.en: An ominous vessel has appeared on sensors - but only within the cosmic storms. What could be at play here?

entries.zh:
我们从[This.GetName]星系接收到了一些奇怪的报告。显然，上一场在该星域肆虐的宇宙风暴把一艘不知来处的舰船卷了出来。这艘船没有呼号，它不知怎么地穿过了暴风雨，仿佛完全没受周围风暴的影响。

这艘船没有回应我们的呼叫，风暴消散后，它也消失得无影无踪了。这可能是由于风暴对仪器的干扰，但是肉眼观测却毋庸置疑地表明了真相。

这其中可能潜藏着极为先进的科技，还是说发生了某些不祥的事情？我们会时刻盯着这艘神秘舰船，直到它再次出现。
entries.en:
We are receiving strange reports from the [This.GetName] system. Apparently, the last cosmic storm raging in that sector revealed a ship of unknown origin. Bearing no call sign, it somehow cruised through the tempest as if entirely unaffected by the surrounding violence.

It did not respond to hails, and as soon as the storm dissipated, so did the vessel itself. This might have been dismissed as instrument artifacting, but the visual evidence spoke for itself.

Could this be a display of incredibly advanced technology, or is there something more ominous at play? We will be sure to report back any occurrences of this mysterious vessel.

entries.zh:
[This.GetName]中的一座研究站带给了我们一份惊人的报告：在上一次宇宙风暴肆虐期间，一艘奇怪的舰船差点就撞上了哨站。肉眼观测表明，这艘船就是之前报告的那艘不详的舰船。

据空间站汇报，这艘舰船的船体由奇异的有机物、钙矿以及金属合金的融合体构成。

在船上没有探测到任何有机生命的迹象，这让我们推测这艘船是不是自动化或者是由于某些意外而失去了控制。

然而，最令人困惑的事情是，太空碎片已经将这艘船的大部分推进系统击碎，它本应难逃崩坏的命运。

如果我们能派遣科研船监测下一次宇宙风暴的话，说不定可以获得有关这艘飞船的更多信息。
entries.en:
One of the research stations in [This.GetName] came to us with a startling report: During the last cosmic storm, a strange ship had almost collided with the outpost. Visual reports show it was the same ominous vessel first reported some time ago.

According to the space station, the hulls on the vessel were constructed from a strange amalgamation of organic compounds, calcium minerals and metallic alloys.

No organic life was detected, leading us to speculate that either this vessel was automated, or had somehow gone rogue.

However, the most baffling thing was yet to come: large sections of its propulsion system were clearly shattered by space debris. This vessel should have been dead in space.

If we assign a science vessel to monitor the next cosmic storm, they might be able to find out more about this mysterious craft.

entries.zh: 我们没时间理会这无稽之谈。
entries.en: We have no time for such nonsense.

entries.zh:
[stormbound_science.GetName]远远地发现那艘不祥的舰船出现在风暴之中。当它飘过时，我们从宇宙空间中探测到了一股强烈的信号。

我们无法探测到这艘船的原因终于真相大白：它的物理形态已经伸展得超越了多维空间，看上去就好像已经进入了虫洞又好像没有。可能是由于宇宙风暴的多维起源，这艘船才得以回到我们的空间。

知道这一点后，当这艘船下次再出现时，我们应该能够探测到，说不定还能将它拉回到我们的现实中。
entries.en:
In the distance [stormbound_science.GetName] witnessed the ominous ship appearing between the layers of the storm. As it floated by, we detected wild readings emanating from the cosmic tapestry.

This finally provided an answer to why this ship could not be observed by our sensors: its physical manifestation had been stretched beyond the manifold, as if it had both entered and not entered a wormhole. It was likely due to the hyperdimensional origins of cosmic storms that the ship managed to return to our space.

Knowing this, we should be able to detect the next occurrence, and perhaps pull this craft back to our reality.

entries.zh: 我们已经在§Y[this.GetName]§!中发现了这艘不祥的舰船。
entries.en: The ominous ship has been sighted in §Y[this.GetName]§!.

entries.zh:
就在那里！那艘不祥的船只正位于[Root.Fleet.GetName]前方，并联络了我们。屏幕上出现了一个面带华丽面具的机械实体，她自称为碧廷，并向我们讲述了一则引人入胜的故事。

她曾是一位著名的指挥官，也是恩典公约这一组织的杰出代表。在一次巡逻途中，她和她的船员被卷入了宇宙风暴之中，为求得一线生机，她大胆将舰船的‘突破驱动装置’过载。这种实验性技术从未有人测试过，结果舰船连带船员们一起被困在了风暴的高维场中。

故事到此为止，她从严重损毁的船上抛出一个小匣子，里面放着一摞文件。“把这些拿回去吧，”碧廷请求道。之后通讯结束，舰船也随之消失在多维结空间结构中。

这些文件上都是外星文字，我们需要花点时间进行破译。
entries.en:
There it is! Positioning itself in front of [Root.Fleet.GetName], the ominous ship hailed us. A mechanical entity in an ornate mask appeared on screen. Identifying herself as B'Tiin, her tale was a fascinating one.

She was once a renowned officer, a true paragon of an organization known as the Convention of Benefactors. While on patrol, she and her crew were caught inside a cosmic storm, and in a daring bid for survival, she made the decision to overcharge the ship's 'Breach Drive.' This experimental technology had never been tested, and the vessel and its crew was trapped within the storm's hyperdimensional field.

Her story finished, a small container was released from the decimated ship. Inside was a collection of documents. "Take these home," B'Tiin requested, after which the transmission ended, and the ship disappeared into the spatial manifold.

The documents are written in a foreign script, and will take some time to decipher.

entries.zh:
古怪匣子中的文件已经被翻译完毕。其中一份文件记录了那艘船所谓“突破驱动装置”的设计图。尽管该装置仍超出我们的科技水平，但对其构造原理的仔细研究之后，我们对于超空间航行的理解更加深入了。

其余的则是一些私人信件，没有什么用处，但是却更能触动人心。这些信都是写给他们心爱的人，笔间填满了思念、希望和遗憾。

似乎碧廷的目的是想要让她的船员们有最后一次机会与外界联系。但不幸的是，我们不知道这些信要寄往何方，所以不如把这些信留下来，至少还可以保存他们这份奇异的遗产。或者我们也可以销毁这些信件，毕竟这艘古怪的舰船和幽灵般的信件有点让人内心发毛。
entries.en:
The contents of the strange container have been deciphered. One document contained a schematic of the ship's so-called Breach Drive. While still beyond our own technology, careful study of the principles behind its construction have already improved our understanding of hyperspatial travel.

Less beneficial perhaps, but more affecting, were the translations of personal letters. Each is addressed to a loved one, speaking of fondness, hope, and regret.

It seems B'Tiin's intention was to give her crew one last chance to reach out. Unfortunately, we have no way of knowing where to deliver these letters. Making them available to our own people could at least preserve their strange legacy. Alternatively, it might be wise to destroy them. Knowledge of strange ships and ghostly letters may be unsettling.

entries.zh: 归档这些信件以供后人查询。
我们探测到那艘不祥的舰船将会在这场风暴中现身。\n\n派遣一艘科研船去将其引出并捕获！
entries.en: We have detected the ominous ship will be manifesting itself inside this storm.\n\nSend a science vessel to draw it out and intercept it at once!

entries.zh: 在调查完[From.Planet.GetName]后，我们发现了一种奇特的生物。我们应该怎么办呢？
entries.en: After a survey of [From.Planet.GetName], a strange creature was discovered. What will we do with it?

entries.zh: 在调查完[From.Planet.GetName]后，我们发现了一种奇特的生物。尽管我们只和它们相处了一会，但这已经激发了我们的保护欲。建议开展进一步的研究。
entries.en: After a survey of [From.Planet.GetName], a strange creature was discovered. Despite having only been among us for a short time, it has already instilled a deep  desire to nurture and protect it. Further study is advised.

entries.zh: 这只生物自被发现以来就展现出极大的影响力，激发了我们的爱意和投喂欲。四只鼓起的泡泡般的眼睛展现着它的纯真，吸引所有人前来撸它那柔顺如云的毛发。它似乎很亲近[Root.GetLeaderName]，大部分时间都呆在[Leader.GetHisHer]的膝盖上，享受着[Leader.GetHisHer]的宠爱，没有展现出任何攻击或是危险动作，就好像是被特意设计成这副无害的模样。\n\n尽管如此，一些人质疑，在未经事先批准的情况下，将一种以前未发现的生物留在船上是不负责任的。[Root.GetLeaderName]则保证它大概率是安全的，但也认可需要进行正式调查。
entries.en: From the moment the creature was discovered, its impact was undeniable, inspiring love and devotion among us almost instantaneously. Its four bulging eyes displayed innocence and invited anyone to stroke its soft, cloud-like fur. It seems particularly attached to [Root.GetLeaderName], spending most of its time on [Leader.GetHisHer] lap enjoying [Leader.GetHisHer] affections, not showing any signs of aggression or danger. It is as if it was perfectly engineered to be as inoffensive as possible.\n\nStill, some skeptics have pointed out how irresponsible it would be to keep a previously undiscovered life form aboard the ship without prior approval. [Root.GetLeaderName] vouched that it is definitely probably safe, but has agreed to request a formal investigation.

entries.zh: 调查清楚它到底是什么。

entries.en: Request denied. Get rid of it.

entries.zh: 我们的一艘科研船上出现了一种特别有趣、非常可爱的动物。我们要先进行调查，再行决定要不要留下它。
entries.en: A most intriguing, positively adorable animal was found aboard one of our science vessels. An investigation into the creature's biological qualities is required before we decide to keep it or not.

entries.zh:
我们不需要进行麻醉，也不需要强迫就能触摸并扫描这只动物，它表现得十分顺从。船员们根据它被抚摸时发出的声音将其命名为咕咕。

我们确认咕咕是杂食动物，它的毛发由常见且非常柔软的角蛋白丝组成。但真正神奇的事情是它的内在，它可以在一个月内更新包括自己神经系统在内的全部细胞。这意味着它可以在几天内再生出正常功能的躯体。

如此复杂的生物结构似乎不太可能是自然进化的产物。我们以前从未见过类似的生物，因此无法确定它的性情。尽管看起来温顺，但它随时可能对我们发起攻击。尽管如此，自从它出现以来，[Root.GetLeaderName]似乎比以往任何时候都更有工作动力。

我们应该怎么处理咕咕？我们能把它留下吗？
entries.en:
The docile hexapod did not need to be sedated or even coerced into being prodded and scanned. It seemed strangely agreeable. The crew nicknamed it Gurr, after the soft noise it makes when petted.

We have concluded that Gurr is an omnivore, and that its fur consists of familiar and very soft keratin-based filaments. But the true marvel and mystery takes place inside the adorable creature: it achieves total cell renewal within a month. This includes its nervous system, meaning that it could regrow fully functional body parts within a matter of days.

It seems unlikely something with such a sophisticated biological makeup is a product of natural evolution. We have never before seen anything like it, and cannot be certain of its temperament. Despite its apparent docility, it could turn on us at any moment. That said, since its appearance, [Root.GetLeaderName] seems more motivated to work than ever.

What shall we do with Gurr? Can we keep it?
As long as you clean up after it.

entries.zh: 这只可爱的生物被允许留在科研船上，目前已经被安置妥当。它安抚了[Root.GetLeaderName]的情绪，使其不论走到哪都神清气爽，船员们的士气也前所未有的高。\n\n希望这个非凡的“自然”奇迹能继续成为我们所有人的可爱且温顺的朋友。它，咕咕，将属于我们，直到永远。
entries.en: The adorable creature was allowed to stay aboard the science vessel and has since settled in nicely. It calms [Root.GetLeaderName], lightens the mood wherever it trots, and crew morale is at an all time high!\n\nHopefully this remarkable wonder of "nature" will continue to be a cute, docile, friend to all of us. From now until the end, it shall be ours, and it shall be named Gurr.

entries.zh: 鉴于这只动物的身体不同寻常并且明显经过基因改造，我们不能把它留在科学船上。它很有可能给船员带来负面影响，而且说不定它的主人什么时候就突然愤怒现身要求我们归还。决定执行得迅速且仁慈，在一瞬间，它那柔和的“咕咕”声就此永远消失了。\n\n这个决定尽管情有可原，但还是引发了[Root.GetLeaderName]和船员的抗拒。他们还需要一些时间来平复失去这只可爱奇异动物的悲痛。
entries.en: Given its unusual and clearly genetically engineered body, the creature could not stay aboard the science vessel. The risk of it adversely affecting the crew, or an aggrieved owner appearing to demand its return was simply too great. The deed was done swiftly and mercifully. In an instant, its soft "gurr" was silenced forever.\n\nWhile understandable, this decision has prompted an emotional backlash from [Root.GetLeaderName] and the crew. It will take some time to get over the loss of this adorable freak of nature.

entries.zh:
处理掉这只可爱动物之后，事情没有就此结束，它出色的再生能力似乎超出了我们的预期。

在它死亡后不久，从那显然毫无生机的组织中诞生了两个完全相同的生物。即使杀死它们母体的人就是我们，这些新生的生命体也没有表现出任何攻击性。

我们决定就此打住，而不是冒险创造出一支咕咕大军。[Root.GetLeaderName]和船员们对能够留下这对生物感到非常高兴。
entries.en:
Neutralizing the adorable creature was meant to be the end of it, but its remarkable regenerative characteristics seemed to have gone further than we could have guessed.

Not too long after its demise, two identical copies of the creature were spawned from its apparently lifeless tissue. Even after our decision to terminate its progenitor's life, the resulting lifeforms are not showing any signs of aggression.

We shall leave it at this, rather than risk creating an army of Gurrs. [Root.GetLeaderName] and the crew have expressed their delight at being allowed to keep the pair.

entries.zh:
我们在[From.Planet.GetName]发现一个随风暴逐流的逃生舱。尽管数据签名看起来像是我们的，但可以肯定它不属于我们。我们谨慎地回应了通讯请求，而舱内人员显得尤为高兴。

[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeSheCap]解释称[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]已经随着风暴拉扯了一段时间，正寻求救援，[event_target:the_imitator.GetHerHis]飞船上的生命维持系统已经濒临崩溃。

当我们要求其表明身份时，这个陌生人却奇怪地声称自己就是我们的船员。这显然是在撒谎，因为我们的船员一个不漏，都在船上。
entries.en:
The pod discovered in [From.Planet.GetName] has been left to the mercy of the storm. Even though the data signature it uses looks to be one of ours, the pod is definitely alien. We answered the request for communications cautiously, but we were met with elation by the capsule's inhabitant.

[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeSheCap] explained [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] has been dragged along by the tempest for some time and is seeking rescue, [event_target:the_imitator.GetHerHis] vessel's life support systems on the brink of failure.

When asked to identify themselves, the stranger bizarrely claimed to be a member of our own crew. The lie is painfully obvious, if for no other reason than the fact that everyone on board our ship is accounted for.

entries.zh: 别跟他兜圈子了，摧毁逃生舱。

我们把逃生舱带上船了。我们打开太空舱的封条，真相就揭晓了，里面的外星人立即发出了绝望的请求。

原来这名外星人在对自己母舰的逃生舱进行例行检查时被困在的仓内，并且逃生舱被发射到了太空中。非常不幸的是，船上没有人发现[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]消失了。

在被困几个月之后，[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]终于通过一些在逃生舱内能搞到的小东西，向路过的飞船发送一种诱饵信号。然而这也没能吸引到任何援手。更糟的是，一股宇宙风暴席卷了逃生舱，并把它带到了母星系好多光年之外的地方。在孤独和恐惧的驱使下，[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]想出了一个计划，伪装成发生在附近的任何船只的失踪船员。这位逃生舱的幸存者为他欺骗了我们道歉，但[event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe]很庆幸自己活了下来。
entries.en:
We brought the escape pod aboard our ship. The ruse ended as soon as the capsule's seal opened, after which the alien within immediately launched into a desperate plea.

During a routine inspection of the escape pods on [event_target:the_imitator.GetHerHis] mother ship, [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] was trapped inside and ejected into space. Sadly, no one aboard their vessel noticed [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] was missing.

Stranded for months, [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] used what little tech [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] could find aboard [event_target:the_imitator.GetHerHis] pod to mimic the energy signals of passing ships as a type of lure. However, even this failed to attract help. Worst of all, a cosmic storm took hold of the pod, dragging it lightyears from its home system. Driven to extremes by loneliness and fear, [event_target:the_imitator.GetHeShe] concocted a plan to pose as a missing crew member of any ship that happened by. The pod-dweller apologized for the deception, but is glad to be alive.

entries.zh: 我们或许能够用得上这样灵活的头脑。
提供交通工具送到附近的有人居住的星球。
entries.en: Provide transport to the nearest inhabited planet.

entries.zh: 在最近的一次调查中发现了一个单独的逃生舱。奇怪的是，这个逃生舱用与我们相同的数据签名向我们打招呼。这个逃生舱似乎是被最近一场穿过这个星系的宇宙风暴所带过来的。建议进行更深入的调查。
entries.en: A lone escape pod was spotted during a recent survey. Strangely, the pod hailed us using a data signature matching that of our own. The pod seems to have been displaced by a recent cosmic storm that passed through the system. Investigation is recommended.
I'm so glad to be here!

entries.zh: 在随着宇宙风暴漂流之后，这个狡猾但古怪的天才却知道如何扭转局面，而且通常是向好的方向。
entries.en: Brought aboard after being dragged around by a Cosmic Storm, this crafty but eccentric genius knows how to turn any situation around, usually for the better.

entries.zh: 我们的扫描仪探测到该星球的一个区域不断发出一些有趣的信号。经分析，那里很有可能存在古代文明的遗迹正等着我们去发现。
entries.en: Our scanners picked up a series of intriguing signals coming from this area of the planet. Based on their composition, it's highly likely there is a remnant of an ancient civilization waiting to be uncovered there.

entries.zh:
我们的基地附近出现了一片奇特的城市遗址。

这些建筑包含了我们迄今为止所遇到的每一个文明的建筑特点——也包括我们自己的！

然而，这些建筑所用的材料组成与我们在行星殖民过程中建立基地时使用的材料相似。这很奇怪，因为我们的这类材料不可能坚持数十年之久，更别提我们扫描确定的这些遗迹所经过的时间了。

这些遗址不太可能属于哪位神秘的先驱者，但扫描结果却与之相悖。这其中到底有什么玄机？
entries.en:
Near our basecamp we were greeted by a set of peculiar city ruins.

The architecture showed characteristics of every civilization we've encountered so far - including our own!

However, the material composition is similar to what we use to establish base camps during planetary colonization. This is strange because these materials could never hold out for multiple decades, let alone the age our scanners determined these ruins to be.

It's unlikely for these ruins to have belonged to a mysterious precursor, yet the scanners persist in their conclusion. What could be at play here?

entries.zh: 我们追踪信号进入了废墟城市的地下层。一般情况下，这类考古遗址都会存在一个交通相连的地下网络，或者有一批避难所。不过，我们发现了一个布满布料碎片、聚合物容器，甚至有机废物的小洞穴。看来我们并不是第一批探索这里的人。\n\n令人担忧的是，[Root.GetLeaderName] 告诉我们外面的天空正在变绿，一场宇宙风暴即将在 [Fromfrom.getName] 形成。尽管如此，我们仍然向着信号的来源前进。
entries.en: The trail of the signals led to a pathway into the lower levels of the ruined city. Usually archeological sites of this type have an underground transportation network or a collection of safety bunkers. Instead we found a small cave system littered with scraps of fabric, polymer containers and even organic waste. It appears we are not the first to explore this archeological site.\n\nWorryingly, [Root.GetLeaderName] informs us the skies outside are turning green; a cosmic storm is about to develop inside [Fromfrom.getName]. Still, we press on towards the origin point of the signals.

entries.zh:
我们一时被一扇严重损毁的金属大门挡住去路，但还是不费吹灰之力就打开了通道，门后是一个简陋的仓库。

仓库的架子上堆满了各种废弃的高科技设备，墙边则小心地摆放着属于几家知名企业的箱子。最后，我们终于找到了追踪已久的信号源：一个与我们自己的设备相似的应答机。

在我们登录设备并查看其数据库后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]得出一个大胆的结论：该信号被故意设计得尽可能神秘和引人入胜——它模仿结合了其他文明的特征。

此外，在箱子里我们还发现了地面上废墟所使用的建造模件。

于是我们联系基地，开始汇报当前地发现，但宇宙风暴已经开始干扰我们的通讯。我们最后接收到来自[Root.GetLeaderName]的讯息令人担忧，地上营地似乎正遭受攻击！
entries.en:
Our progress was briefly halted by a set of badly damaged metal doors. With little effort we worked our way past this obstacle and a rudimentary storage facility revealed itself.

Its shelves were filled to the brim with an assortment of derelict technologies. Boxes of well known corporations had been carefully stacked against the walls. And finally, the source of the signals we had been chasing for so long: a transponder computer not unlike our own.

As we logged into the device and searched its databases, our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] started forming a wild conclusion: the signal was deliberately constructed to appear as mysterious and intriguing as possible - mimicking and combining characteristics from other civilizations.

What's more, inside the boxes we found construction kits of the ruins we encountered above ground.

We contacted our basecamp to report our findings, but the cosmic storm has already started interrupting our com lines. The last thing we heard from [Root.GetLeaderName] is a worrying set of commands; it appears our basecamp is under attack!

entries.zh:
一支海盗舰队隐藏在[Fromfrom.getName]的宇宙风暴之中！正是它们攻击了我们的基地。这些海盗向我们发送了一条讯息：

§L亲爱的蠢货们：

谢谢你们来到我们这处隐蔽的驻扎地。

看到你们这些看似聪明的生物们闻到一丝古代文物和肮脏遗珍的气息就立刻抛弃一切理智，不禁让人感叹不已。也许你们希望找到一种摧毁强大敌人的手段？建造无数的舰队直抵事件视界？或者只是想让自己的人民过上美好生活？多么俗套的想法啊。

请不要难过——在你们之前还有许多人来过，而我们的商业模式则依赖于那些重蹈你们覆辙的后来人。

现在，只需2000能量币，我们就会把抢来的东西还给你们。

要是拒绝我们的提议，谁知道会发生什么可怕的事情呢，说不定会给[Leader.getHerHim]和[Leader.getHisHer]的这支装备欠佳的船员们带来什么噩运，他们可还被困在这个星球上。

请做出明智之选。§!

躲在洞穴里暂时是安全的，但我们不知道能安全多久。我们要满足这些土匪的要求吗？
entries.en:
The cosmic storm inside [Fromfrom.getName] turned out to have been concealing a pirate fleet! It was their crew that attacked our basecamp. The pirates asked us to relay this message to you:

§LDear absolute fools,

Thank you for joining us at our most elusive retreat.

Isn't it amazing just how quickly seemingly intelligent beings abandon all reason whenever they detect the merest whiff of ancient artifacts and devious relics? Perhaps you had hoped to find a means to destroy a great enemy? To build fleets as far as the event horizon reaches? Or were you just trying to be nice to your own people? How quaint.

Please don't feel bad - many others came before you, and our business model depends on that many more will follow your footsteps.

Now, for a modest sum of 2000 energy credits we will return something you have lost.

Reject our offer and who knows what terrible things could happen to [Leader.getHerHim] and [Leader.getHisHer] poorly armed crew that is still trapped on the planet.

Please choose wisely.§!

We are safe in these caverns for now, but we don't know for how long. Are we going to entertain these bandits?

entries.zh: 去毁灭之地腐烂成灰吧！
entries.en: Tell them to rot in Oblivion!

entries.zh:
我们收到一条新讯息：

§L可惜，我们本可以用这笔钱做很多有趣的事情。

我们会转告这位领袖和[Leader.getHisHer]的团队，就说他们的命不值分文。也许附近的奴隶商或一位同化斗士会有兴趣。我们听说精神阉割是现在的新潮流。

就此别过。§!

我们把手头上一切能找到的东西用来修筑壁垒，附近的物资也足够我们撑上一段时间。但海盗们最终肯定会突破我们的防御！
entries.en:
We have received a new message:

§LShame. There are a lot of fun things we could've done with those resources.

We will inform the leader and [Leader.getHisHer] crew that their lives weren't worth the effort or credits. Maybe a nearby slaver or a very driven assimilator might be interested. We hear nerve stapling is the hot new trend.

Entrepreneurs out.§!

We have used everything we could find to barricade ourselves in, and there are enough supplies to keep us safe for a while. But the pirate fleet is bound to break through our defenses eventually!

entries.zh:
这些海盗的技术完全支持不了它们狂妄的言论。不久之后，他们的舰队成为了星系生态系统的一部分。

我们很快重新与地表的船员们取得联系。他们被吓坏了，但没有受到伤害。

虽然在这里没有发现古代文明的洞见，但这段经历告诉我们以后要提高警惕。探险队领袖未能察觉到眼前的危险——我们以后不能再犯同样的错误。
entries.en:
These pirates could not back up their cocky speeches with skill. Before long, whatever was left of their fleet became a part of the galactic ecosystem.

We reestablished contact with the crew on the surface soon after. They were rather shaken by the experience, but suffered no harm.

While we discovered no insights into ancient civilizations here, our experience instilled a need for vigilance. The expedition leader failed to see incoming danger - we will not make the same mistake.
Let that be a lesson to us all.

entries.zh: 这位领袖不会再让我们失望了。
entries.en: That leader will never fail us again.

entries.zh:
我们收到了回复的讯息：

§L如果可以的话，我愿意称之为明智之选！

请知悉，您对于“急需度假星球的弱势企业家”的拨款已经收到。

很快你们就能再见到你们的领袖和随人附赠的船员。

此外，您可以向所有贸易伙伴推荐我们。§!

不久之后，我们重新与地表船员建立了联系。他们称自己被吓坏了，但没有受到伤害。

虽然在这里没有发现古代文明的洞见，但这段经历告诉我们以后要提高警惕。探险队领袖未能察觉到眼前的危险——我们以后不能再犯同样的错误。
entries.en:
We've received a message in return:

§LMarvelous choice, if we may say so!

Let it be known that your contribution to our 'Fund for Disadvantaged Entrepreneurs in Need of a Resort Planet' has been received and processed.

You will find your leader and the complimentary crew in your possession soon enough.

And do recommend us to all your trade partners.§!

Soon after we were able to reestablish contact with the crew on the surface. They reported to be rather shaken by the experience, but suffered no harm.

While we discovered no insights into ancient civilizations here, our experience instilled a need for vigilance. The expedition leader failed to see incoming danger - we will not make the same mistake.

entries.zh: 我们现在对这些潜在的危险更加警惕。
entries.en: We are now more vigilant against incoming danger.

entries.zh: 席卷而过的宇宙风暴留下了一份奇怪的礼物：一座属于老旧居住站系统的轨道复合体。登陆之后有可能加以激活。
entries.en: The passing cosmic storm left behind a curious present: an orbital complex from an old habitat system. Boarding may allow us to reactivate it.

entries.zh: 尽管这座轨道复合体被宇宙风暴拖拽着漂星过海，但它似乎没怎么受到损伤。我们发现居住站中的居住和商业空间几乎状态完好。这些区域一尘不染，仿佛从未有人使用过一般。\n\n在中控室中迎接我们的是一个令人眼花缭乱的输入系统：各种没有任何说明的刻度盘，设置不一的拉杆，大量的按钮以看似随机的间隔五颜六色地闪烁着。幸运的是，我们最终找到了一本手册。相信只要成功翻译出来，我们就可以重新激活这座居住站了。
entries.en: Despite having been dragged across the galaxy by the cosmic storm, the orbital complex suffered very little harm. We found the living and commercial spaces of the habitat in almost perfect condition. Not a single bit of dust laid atop the surface that would betray a previous occupancy, as if it had never before been used.\n\nInside the central control hub we were greeted by a bewildering input system: dials with no explanation, levers with inconsistent settings and a great amount of buttons flashing a whole spectrum of colors at seemingly random intervals. Fortunately, we eventually came across a manual. Once this is successfully translated, we are confident we can reactivate the habitat.

entries.zh: 不幸的是，我们之前的估计过于乐观了：翻译出来的手册和这个控制系统一样令人无法理解。不仅缺失了一半的页面，图片说明上有着大量的符号学设定，而且另一半手册则是用一种难以破译的象形文字书写的。\n\n然而，最后一页展示了一个通讯频率并附有一组可翻译成“帮助台”的字符。我们现在正尝试联络这个频率。
entries.en: Unfortunately, our previous estimation appears to have been optimistic: the manual turned out to be just as incomprehensible as the control system. Half of the pages appeared to be missing and the pictorial instructions make significant semiotic assumptions. The other half of the manual is written in difficult to interpret hieroglyphs.\n\nHowever, the last page displayed a com frequency accompanied by a set of characters translated to 'help desk'. We're attempting this frequency now.

entries.zh: 您的来电对我们很重要
entries.en: Your Call is Important To Us

entries.zh:
手册中的通讯频道连接到了一个名为“天空花园”的商业实体的帮助台主机。

助手人工智能用一种友好而中立的语气告诉我们，它感谢我们的联系，并询问是否有什么可以帮得上忙的。列出的选项包括“回答有关订阅的问题”、“了解新的智能防御系统”，以及我们是否希望更多地了解该公司的“社会责任倡议”。

然而，随后的选项把我们引向越来越不相关的话题。更糟的是，它还经常会让我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]等待，然后切断通讯。显然，这个人工智能服务并没有像居住站的其他部分一样经受住时间的考验。

无论如何，我们将继续按自己的方法来试着搞定这个神秘的系统。
entries.en:
The manual's com frequency connected us to the help desk mainframe of a commercial entity known as Skygarden.

With a friendly though neutral tone, the help desk AI informed us that it appreciated our reaching out, and asked if there was anything it could aid us with. Among the listed options were 'answering questions about subscriptions', 'learning about the new line of smart defense systems' and if we wished to know more about the corporation's 'social responsibility initiatives'.

However, the subsequent options continued to direct us to entirely unrelated topics. Worst of all, it would often put our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on hold only to drop the call. Obviously, the service AI has not survived the passing of time as well as the rest of the habitat.

Nevertheless, we will continue trying to find our way through this arcane system.

entries.zh:
我们的[Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报，无论他们和人工智能说什么，在几分钟的等待过去后，这个系统都只会复读之前的内容。

我们尝试运行多个模拟来绘制精确的菜单树，但是却发生了递归错误，并且无法同时解决和检查解决方案。即使运行量子模型也没有得到理想的结果。我们怀疑在这个过程中我们不小心破坏了一些波函数。

我们不知所措了。
entries.en:
Our [Root.Owner.GetEngineerPlural] report that regardless of what they said to the AI, after passing through several menus, the system would simply revert back to a previous statement.

We attempted to run several simulations to map out the exact menu tree, but our efforts returned recursive errors and an inability to both solve and check the solution at the same time. Even running a quantum model achieved no desirable results. We suspect we accidentally collapsed a few wave functions in the process.

We're at a loss.

entries.zh: 告诉这个人工智能它的§R违禁词§!被§R违禁词§!了。
终于有进展了！这个人工智能警告我们用语不当，并告知我们应该等待客户服务代表的联系。\n\n$cstorms.1295.desc.followup$
entries.en: Finally a breakthrough! The AI admonished us for using inappropriate language and stated we should wait until we are contacted by a customer service representative.\n\n$cstorms.1295.desc.followup$

entries.zh: 终于有进展了！这个人工智能显然对于我们长时间的沉默感到困惑不解，并将会把我们转给客服代表。\n\n$cstorms.1295.desc.followup$
entries.en: Finally a breakthrough! The AI was apparently confused at our prolonged silence and will refer us to a customer service representative.\n\n$cstorms.1295.desc.followup$

entries.zh: 终于有进展了！这个人工智能警告我们正在虐待操作面板，并告知我们应该等待客户服务代表的联系。\n\n$cstorms.1295.desc.followup$
entries.en: Finally a breakthrough! The AI admonished us for abusing the control panel and stated we should wait until we are contacted by a customer service representative.\n\n$cstorms.1295.desc.followup$

entries.zh: 我们等了一阵子之后，通讯频道又打开了。另一端的实体介绍她自己为天空花园公司的记录管理员。服务台本身是她从上一位记录管理员那里继承来的人工智能程序。据她所知，自从几十年前天空花园破产以来，这个通讯站就再没有使用过了。当我们问她为什么继续为一个破产的机构工作时，她只说这就是她的合同内容。\n\n向记录管理员阐明了我们的情况后，她翻出了一本古老的居住站快速入门指南。她很快就会把书页的数字印痕传送给我们。
entries.en: For a while we were left waiting, and then the com line was reopened. The entity on the other end introduced herself as the record keeper of the Skygarden Corporation. The help desk itself was an AI program she had inherited from the last record keeper. As far as she knows, the com station had not been used since the bankruptcy of Skygarden many decades ago. When we questioned why she remained working for a bankrupt organization, she simply said it was in her contract.\n\nExplaining our situation, the record keeper dug up an old quick start guide to the habitat. She will transfer digital impressions of the pages to us soon.
Years to Earn, Seconds to Lose

entries.zh:
有了新的指南后，重新启动居住站毫不费力。

在机器启动的声音慢慢平息后，我们决定再一次向记录员表示感谢。

她说在这个通讯台找到了一些信息，显然，这是五个多世纪前建造的原型，但在一场特别恶劣的宇宙风暴之后，迷失于混沌太空之中。财产损失和开发成本的打水漂就够让天空花园破产的了。

帮助我们是这位记录员多年来第一件有意义的服务。

“再说了，”她说。“我也很高兴能再次听到我曾祖母的声音，即使只是一个人工智能而已。”
entries.en:
With the new guide in our possession, restarting the habitat required little effort.

After the noise of activating machinery slowly died down, we decided to reach out to the record keeper once more to thank her.

She told us she had recovered some information on this station. Apparently it had been built over five centuries ago as a prototype, but was lost in the astrological chaos following a particularly nasty cosmic storm. The loss of property and development costs was enough to bankrupt Skygarden.

Helping us was the record keeper's first useful task in years.

"Besides," she said. "It was nice to hear my great-grandmother's voice on the line again, even it was just an AI."

entries.zh: 紧随着最近过境的§Y$electric_storm$§!，在§H[From.Planet.GetName]§!的地表之下探测到了一场难以解释的能量骤增。进一步扫描发现了一座古老的地下复合体，其中的发电机被风暴重新激活，让这座设施又开始了运作。
entries.en: Following the passing of a recent §Y$electric_storm$§!, an unexplained power surge was detected beneath the surface of §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!. Further scans revealed an aging subterranean complex whose power generators were reactivated by the storm, bringing the facility back online.

entries.zh: §H[From.Planet.GetName]§!上遗弃设施的入口建设得格外地坚固。显然非常地耐用，外表铺着有厚重的装甲、辐射护盾和一座气象传感阵列。§H[Leader.GetName]§!相信它是用来抵御极端条件的。\n\n扫描表明，通过数道密封的安全门之后可以抵达一座巨大的地下舱室。
entries.en: The entrance of the isolated complex on §H[From.Planet.GetName]§! is of exceptionally robust construction. Clearly built to last, its exterior features heavy armor plating, radiation shields, and an array of atmospheric sensors. §H[Leader.GetName]§! believes it was built to withstand extreme conditions.\n\nScans suggest that a large underground chamber can be accessed via a series of sealed security doors.

entries.zh:
在进入主要舱室后，§H[Leader.GetName]§!得出结论，我们发现了一座很久以前为某些未知有机物种建造的尚未启用的生存避难所。

它配备了储备充足的居住区，包括睡眠舱、休闲区和医疗舱。每层楼的储物柜里都有大量未开封的营养包、电池和工具。这座隐藏的洞穴里的所有东西都处于未使用的状态。

最后一扇安全门仍然密封这着，我们相信打开它便会到达基地的指挥室。
entries.en:
Having gained access to the main interior, §H[Leader.GetName]§! concludes that we have discovered an unused survival shelter, built long ago for some unknown organic species.

It is outfitted with well stocked habitation quarters comprising sleep pods, leisure zones, and a medical bay. Storage lockers on every floor hold deep reserves of unopened nutrient packs, batteries, and tools. Everything contained in this hidden vault is in pristine condition.

One final set of security doors remains sealed. We believe they will lead us to the facility's command deck.

entries.zh:
这座舱室的指挥面板上有一组令人印象深刻的§Y$default_storm$§!显示器，全部连接着外面的气象探测阵列。这些控制台在待机状态运行后，储存了了几个世纪以来的历史风暴数据，这将极大地促进我们对星际气象学的理解。

§H[Leader.GetName]§!还找到了一台精致小巧的全息投影仪。当被激活时，它会投射出一个3D的软体类模型，从带着公司标志的庇护所地标边跑过，一边进行着推销。

这个幸存的产品是否找到了买家不得而知，但它显然已经在这里闲置了很多年。
entries.en:
The shelter's command deck is equipped with an impressive array of §Y$default_storm$§! monitors, all fed by the atmospheric sensors on the surface. After running on standby, these consoles contain centuries' worth of historical storm data, which will greatly advance our understanding of astrometeorology.

§H[Leader.GetName]§! also found a small and well-used holo-projector. When activated, it beams a 3D molluscoid figure delivering a sales pitch, running through the shelter's key features under a corporate logo.

Whether this survival product ever found a buyer is impossible to say, but it has clearly remained unused here for many years.

entries.zh: 我们的营销部门已经在分析哪里出了问题。
entries.en: Our marketing departments are already analyzing where they went wrong.

entries.zh: 我们辨别出了一些隐藏于§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!地下的结构，似乎有着很悠久的历史。应该借此机会进行调查。
entries.en: We have identified several obscured subterranean structures on §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! that appear to be of considerable age. We should take this opportunity to investigate.

entries.zh:
§Y[From.GetStarName]§!恒星系内的[From.Planet.GetName]行星是一颗残破的星球，显然是某个消失在历史长河中的帝国的遗迹。这些引起我们兴趣的地下结构都差不多古老，且相对完好无损。

回声共振成像显示出一座复杂的地下结构，包含储藏室和庇护所，设计用于对抗自然之力。行星表面的破坏毫无疑问是宇宙风暴的杰作，这也与这座庇护所的存在遥相呼应。

然而，大量的碎片让我们难以进一步调查。进行考古学发掘才能让我们得到进一步的收获。
entries.en:
The planet §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! in the [From.GetStarName] system is a ruined world, apparently a remnant of an empire lost to antiquity. The subterranean structures that were of interest to us are equally ancient, and relatively intact.

Sonar resonance imaging revealed a complex underground structure of storage rooms as well as shelters designed to withstand the forces of nature. The destruction on the planet`s surface is no doubt a result of cosmic storms, which would align with the existence of the sanctuary.

However, the amount of debris is making it hard to investigate any further. An archaeological dig site could tell us more.

entries.zh: 在一颗被风暴毁灭的星球中埋葬于废墟之下的庇护所：外部的残破使其难以调查，但内部似乎还是完好的。
entries.en: A shelter buried under the debris of a storm-ravaged world; the devastation is making it hard to investigate, but the interior appears intact.

entries.zh:
我们从地面接近避难所时，发现两座倒塌塔楼的下面有一个小开口，里面发出点点微光，透过这个开口可以看到一些机器正在运转。

我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]将这个开口作为基点，进而测定整个复杂设施的大小，并尽可能在不破坏其脆弱结构的前提下找到打开它的方法。

这一被掩埋的废墟上布满了宇宙风暴肆虐的典型痕迹。奇怪的是，没有迹象表明这座城市的居民进行自保避难。

似乎他们尽可能长时间地忍受着风暴的肆虐，然后匆忙撤离。或许真正的答案就藏在§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!的地下。
entries.en:
Approaching the shelter from ground-level revealed a small opening beneath two collapsed towers, through which the faint glow of operational machinery could be seen.

The opening provides an anchor point for our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] to map out the size of the complex, and possibly find a way to open it up without damaging the delicate structural integrity.

The ruins that entomb this site have all the hallmarks of cosmic storm damage. Curiously, there are no signs that the city's inhabitants attempted to protect themselves.

It is as if they endured the violence for as long as possible, only to evacuate in a great hurry. Perhaps the answers lie beneath the ruined ground of §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!.

entries.zh:
在清理了多层碎片和灰尘之后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]终于把塔楼下的开口挖得足够大，可以让他们进入避难所。

这间避难所简单且实用，有许多附属房间，其中大多数都是空的。事实上，它虽然看上去简陋，但看起来确实是某种避难所，然而却无法抵御宇宙风暴。墙壁太薄，几乎没有支撑，天花板和地板也没有加固。这个避难所之所以能够保存下来，纯粹是因为运气好。如果不是因为上面的两座塔楼和山体滑坡让整个建筑群整体产生了位移，这个“风暴”避难所早就被毁灭了。

从外面看到的微光来自一些故障的报警系统，在避难所深处还可以看到几个仍在运行的终端。这可能是了解该设施从前的居民以及相关异常现象的绝佳机会。
entries.en:
After clearing many layers of debris and dust, the opening underneath the towers grew large enough for our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] to enter the shelter.

The sanctuary is simple and utilitarian, with many offshoot rooms, most of them empty. In fact, it seems overly simple. It definitely appears to be a shelter of some kind, but it would not hold up against cosmic storms. The walls are too thin, providing very little support, and the ceilings and floors are not reinforced. It has been saved by nothing less than pure luck. Had it not been for the two towers above and the landslide moving the complex in one fell swoop, this 'storm' shelter would have been eradicated long ago.

The glow seen from the outside stems from a few malfunctioning alarm systems, and several operational terminals can be spotted deeper into the shelter. This could be a prime opportunity to learn more about the previous owners of this facility, as well as the curious circumstances at play.

entries.zh: 这些终端比我们想象中更难摸到，部分被塌方阻挡。一些碎石是新掉落的，这表明避难所在被扰动后出现了严重的结构问题。建议小心行事。\n\n不幸的是，这些古老的数据很难解码。所有的记录都是一种现已失传的语言写成的，不过界面中留下的星际通讯日志可能会对我们有所帮助。通过将这些日志与散落在避难所周围的废弃实体介质结合起来，我们应该能够完成基础翻译。此外，只要避难所不倒塌，还有更多的房间可以调查。
entries.en: The terminals were harder to reach than anticipated, partially obstructed by cave-ins. Some of the rubble was more recent, indicating a critical failure with the shelter now that it has been disturbed. Caution is advised.\n\nUnfortunately, the ancient data processors do not give up their secrets easily. Everything was recorded in a lost language, though the intergalactic communication logs left behind in the interface might be able to help us. By combining this with the abandoned physical media scattered around the shelter, we should be able to complete a basic translation. Additionally, there are still more rooms to investigate, so long the shelter does not collapse.
Hasten your efforts. Leave everything else.

entries.zh:
位于更下面的房间不像入口通道那么荒芜。一箱箱的商品包装整齐，从上到下堆得满满当当。初步翻译说明这些是原材料和未完成的电子元件，而这两者都不是生存所必需的。这份清单还详细列出了这里储存的物品数量，以及它们在星系平等贸易网络（简称为因内特）中预计会产生的利润。

他们对这个庞大的交易所不吝褒美之辞，还有一丝不苟的交易记录和逐项的利润指数。事实上，这个消失的文明似乎是就以这个交易所命名的，称自己为因内特贸易体。

这个避难所并不是为了保护普通民众而建的，而是一坐美化的商品仓库。这就提出了一个问题，为什么他们的避难所设备如此糟糕，无法应对风暴?

进一步的翻译应该能带来更多见解，但我们的时间有限，基础设施正在令人不安地隐约发出崩塌的声响。
entries.en:
The rooms and chambers located further down are not nearly so abandoned as the entryway. Boxes of merchandise fill them from top to bottom, all neatly packaged and stacked. Initial translations describe unprocessed materials and unfinished electrical components, neither of which are imperative to survival. The list also details quantities of items at this location, and the projected profits they would have generated on something called the Intergalactic Network of Equal Trade, INET for short.

The language surrounding this vast trading exchange is almost ecstatic, with meticulous notes on transactions and itemized indexes of profit. In fact, it appears this vanished civilization based their name on the exchange, calling themselves the Inetian Traders.

This shelter was not built to protect the general population, but rather as a glorified commodities warehouse. This raises the question as to why their shelters were so woefully under-equipped to handle the storms?

Further translation should provide more insights, but we are on borrowed time, as evidenced by the unsettling sound of creaking infrastructure.

entries.zh:
撕裂和崩塌的声音愈发强烈了。尽管如此，在§Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!的庇护所内，翻译工作仍在进行着。虽然对库存商品的调查没有得出什么结果，但功能正常的终端揭示了很多信息。

一组混乱的坐标指向了位于附近行星上的一座“强大”设备的位置。据我们所知，这个装置拥有“操纵”宇宙风暴的能力，如果这种说法是真的，那真是令人难以置信。

然而，由于避难所的稳定性越来越差，而且坐标的副本已经传送回了在轨飞船，所以我们就决定撤离现场。仍有许多问题尚未得到解答，搜寻工作仍会继续。
entries.en:
The sound of tearing and cracking has intensified. Nevertheless, translation efforts continue within the shelter on §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!. While the stockpiled merchandise proved fruitless as a source of inquiry, the functioning terminals revealed much.

A set of scrambled coordinates point to the location of a device of 'great power' located on a nearby planet. From what we can understand, this device possessed the ability to "manipulate" a cosmic storm, a claim which would be incredible if true.

However, with the waning stability of the shelter and a copy of the coordinates already transmitted to our vessel in orbit, we evacuated the site. Many questions remain unanswered, but the hunt is on.

entries.zh: 这是个不容错过的好机会。
entries.en: A chance too good to pass up.

entries.zh: 在§Y[wm_storm_shelter_planet.GetName]§!的庇护所崩塌之前发现了一组受干扰的坐标。我们有理由相信其中的一个坐标是指向一台因内特贸易体用于操纵宇宙风暴的机器。这可是一项值得去找到的科技。
