entries.en: Only moments after leaving the habitat, [event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetName] made an abrupt and stunning decision. As if driven by an outside force, [event_target:leader_patriotic_institute.GetHeShe] ordered the ship to open a communication channel on a frequency typically associated with mass psionic events or the passage of an evanescent cosmic storm.\n\nThe channel was directed at the same coordinates as dAkkaria Convention's home system. It took only an instant for our hails to be returned.

entries.zh: 离开居住站后不久，我们的集体仪式被一种不寻常的振动所干扰，仿佛有什么东西试图在遥远的地方与我们交流。这个信号来自与阿达卡利亚公约的母星系相同的坐标，并且发生在于一个典型的与大规模灵能事件或转瞬即逝的宇宙风暴通过有关的频率上。\n\n我们的回电立即得到了回应。
entries.en: Moments after leaving the habitat, our group consciousness was troubled by an unusual vibration, as if something was trying to communicate with us over a vast distance. The signal originated from the same coordinates as the adAkkaria Convention's home system, and existed on a frequency typically associated with mass psionic events or the passage of an evanescent cosmic storm.\n\nOur return hail was instantly answered.

entries.zh: 尽管我们尝试过所有的方案，但到达艾德苏尔的挑战还是比预想的要大得多。整个恒星系被未知成分的宇宙风暴吞没，使我们无法靠近这颗行星。\n\n至于这场吞没星系的风暴，它似乎是在……向我们打招呼？
entries.en: We did everything possible, but getting to adSul proved to be a much bigger challenge than anticipated. The entire system is engulfed by a cosmic storm of unknown composition, making it impossible for us to get any closer to the planet.\n\nAs for the storm, it appears to be... hailing us?

entries.zh: 我们复原出了阿达卡利亚公约的母行星的坐标。\n\n探索这个星系和行星也许终于能揭示阿达卡利亚文明的命运。
entries.en: We recovered the coordinates to the adAkkaria Convention's home planet.\n\nExploring the system and planet may finally reveal the fate of the adAkkaria civilization.

entries.zh: 在与宇宙风暴通信之后，艾德苏尔我们展示出了自己的一小部分。在残云之间矗立着一座巨大的建筑群。这里早已遭到遗弃，但奇怪的是它并没有受到时间的影响，扫描显示它的内部存在有机物质。\n\n在这座巨大的建筑前升起了一系列横幅，上面写着同一句话：庆典时刻到。
entries.en: After the communication with the cosmic storm, a small part of adSul was revealed to us. Between the remnant clouds stood a massive complex. Abandoned, yet strangely unaffected by the eons, scans reveal organic material on the inside.\n\nRising before the immense building were a series of banners bearing a single proclamation: It Is Time for Celebration.

entries.zh:
庆典学院的空旷大厅除了厚厚的历史和尘埃以外什么都没有。向着永恒歌颂着阿达卡利亚公约英勇的宣传海报是这个曾经繁荣而令人畏惧的帝国所留下的一切。

然而，我们在语言方面的努力已经得到了回报；这里的安保系统脆弱不堪，主机很容易就泄露了它的秘密。

在我们恢复的日志中，直到宣传站后一次广播之前，这里满满的都是热闹的活动。

而从那一个日期起，阿达卡利亚仁善公约就消失得无影无踪。
entries.en:
The empty halls of Celebration revealed nothing more than the dust of ages. The propaganda posters, forever exalting the valor of the adAkkaria Convention, were all that were left of this once thriving, and feared, empire.

However, our linguistic efforts are already paying off; security was merely a suggestion and the mainframe gave up its secrets easily.

The logs we recovered were bustling with activity right up to the last of the Propaganda Station's broadcasts.

On that date the adAkkaria Convention of Benevolence simply ceased to exist.

entries.zh:
带着一丝恐惧和好奇，我们深入到了这座建筑的地下。迎接我们的是一座精心规划的庞大实验室网络。我们的小组分成了两拨人，一半负责调查实验室，以更深入地了解庆典学院的作用，另一半则继续往下探索。

我们的扫描结果显示有有机物的存在，而且没过多久就发现了原因：庆典学院的下层是专门用于观察室的。阿达卡利亚公民的木乃伊化遗骸仍然被囚禁在这些狭窄的隔间里。每个房间旁边的一个数字界面显示着每位居住者的名字、他们所接受的试验阶段以及观察员的笔记。

同时，我们恢复出了以下消息：
§L我们在哈利俄斯星系中的试运行是一场彻底的灾难。对被称为§S哈图尔·盖隆§!的实验对象的初次部署一切按计划进行。但当我们遇到索尔法尼野蛮军队时，实验对象就失去了控制。风暴将原始军队一扫而空时，我们的军队也跟着遭殃了。

首先要理解的是，这些对象是低劣且精神异常的。召唤器还是越早上线越好。§!
entries.en:
With a hint of dread and curiosity we delved into the subterranean levels of the compound. A sprawling, carefully planned web of laboratories greeted us. Our unit split in two: one half was sent to investigate the laboratories for more insight into the purpose of Celebration. The other continued its descent.

Our scans insisted on the presence of organic material, and it didn't take long to uncover why: the lower levels of Celebration are given over exclusively to observation cells. The mummified remains of adAkkaria citizens are still imprisoned in these cramped compartments. A digital interface next to each chamber offered each occupant's name, the phase of the trial they were subject to, and the observers' notes.

Meanwhile, we recovered the following message:
§LOur trial run in the Haliios system was a complete and utter disaster. The initial deployment of the subject known as §ShaToor Gailon§! went as planned. As soon as we were confronted by the Solphani barbarian forces, the subject lost control. While the tempest wiped out the primitive armies, ours too were decimated.

It should be understood that above all, these subjects are vile and disturbed. The sooner the Invocator is online, the better.§!

entries.zh: 他们在这做什么实验呢？
杀了这么多啊，真是激动人心。

阿达卡利亚公约做的实验令人着迷。每一位囚徒都处于不同的阶段，随着阶段的推进，实验也会愈发残忍。有一些独具创新的方法脱颖而出：他们利用火烧和电击来启动身体的灵能积累；切除重要器官以激发再生力量并激活额外感官；以及使用改变精神的物质来使人进入濒死状态等等。

当然，这里有值得借鉴的地方。这些专家正朝着一个相关的目标努力，即让阿达卡利亚人的霸权席卷全星系。

尽管如此，报告表明这种实验可能不是受试者死亡的原因。就像§S哈图尔·盖隆§!一样，他们似乎单单就是被抛弃在这了而已。
entries.en:
The experiments carried out by the adAkkaria Convention were fascinating. Each prisoner was assigned a phase, and as the phases increased, so did the brutality of the treatment. A few, particularly innovative methods stand out: utilization of fire and electricity to kickstart the body's psionic build-up; the removal of essential organs to provoke nascent powers and the use of other senses; and application of mind altering substances to invoke a state of near-death.

Certainly there is inspiration to be taken here. These experts were working towards a relatable goal, namely the advent of adAkkarian Supremacy in the galaxy.

Still, reports indicate that it may have not been this treatment that killed the subjects. Much like with §ShaToor Gailon§!, many seemed simply to have given up.

entries.zh: 我们目睹遇难者遗体时所经历的恐惧和困惑令人胆寒。但是，我们试图理解公约各项试验的范畴和目的的愿望也是同样强烈。\n\n阿达卡利亚的科学家们用一种冷酷而枯燥的语气，报告了他们对这些人所做的事情。每一位受害者都处于不同的阶段，随着阶段的推进，实验也会愈发残忍。火烧、电击、截肢、剥夺感官和食物——惨象无与伦比。这一切都是为了维持阿达卡利亚人星系霸权的所谓“光荣使命”。尽管如此，报告显示，即使是如此恐怖的操作可能也没有导致受试者死亡。就像§S哈图尔·盖隆§!一样，他们似乎单单就是被抛弃在这了而已。
entries.en: The dread and confusion we experienced at witnessing the remains of the victims was daunting. But so is our desire to comprehend the extent and purpose of the Convention's experiments.\n\nIn a stark and sterile tone, the adAkkarian scientists reported what they had done to these people. Each victim was assigned a phase, and as the phases increased, so did the brutality of their treatment. Fire, electricity, maiming, deprivation of senses and sustenance - nothing was too cruel. Everything for the sake of the glorious mission to maintain adAkkarian Supremacy in the galaxy. Still, reports indicate that even these obscenities may not ultimately have killed the subjects. Much like with §ShaToor Gailon§!, many seemed simply to have given up.

entries.zh: 就在我们进行观察后不久，[Root.GetLeaderName]突然崩溃了。在痛苦的哀号中，[Root.GetLeaderName]尖叫着说有什么东西凿开了[Leader.GetHerHis]的意识！\n\n虽然目前情况稳定，但似乎有什么入侵性实体试图向[Leader.GetHerHim]灌输一种集锦的见解。[Root.GetLeaderName]渴望再做一次尝试，相信这次经历最终会产生深远的影响。
entries.en: Just moments after our observations, [Root.GetLeaderName] collapsed. Between wails of pain, [Root.GetLeaderName] screamed that something was breaking open [Leader.GetHerHis] mind!\n\nThough stable for now, it seems as if some invading entity sought to instill [Leader.GetHerHim] with a radical insight. [Root.GetLeaderName] is keen to try again, believing the experience could ultimately have a profound effect.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetLeaderName]在观察着这些遗体时，突然开始听到一些奇怪的低语，空洞的声音中夹带着强烈的渴望呼唤着：
§L我们忠诚无比！我们以公约为荣，相信公约的使命。
风暴一直在召唤我们，他们吞没着、渴望着我们！
我们完成一切任务。我们才华横溢，顽强不屈!
他们却妄称我们邪恶、背叛，他们杀戮我们的亲友！

这本该是一场庆典§!

这些低语把我们带到了一段标有“最后阶段”的回廊。但更加高级的安保措施挡住了我们的去路。
entries.en:
As [Leader.GetHeShe] observed these bodies, [Root.GetLeaderName] began to hear strange whispers, a disembodied voice that called out with great longing:
§LWe were loyal! We praised the Convention, and believed in its mission.
The storms kept calling to us. They engulfed us, desired us!
We did what they asked. We were talented and tenacious!
They call us evil, they call us traitors, they kill our friends!

THIS WAS MEANT TO BE A CELEBRATION§!

The whispers led us to a corridor labeled 'The Final Phase.' But the more advanced security measures in place did not permit access.

As we surveyed the bodies, a new voice flowed through the collective, channeling [Root.GetLeaderName] as a form of communication:
§LWe were loyal! We praised the Convention, and believed in its mission.
The storms kept calling to us. They engulfed us, desired us!
We did what they asked. We were talented and tenacious!
They call us evil, they call us traitors, they kill our friends!

THIS WAS MEANT TO BE A CELEBRATION§!

The voice led us to a corridor labeled 'The Final Phase.' But the more advanced security measures in place did not permit access.

entries.zh: 我们[controller.GetIndividualNamePlural]的认知进程中出现了更多奇怪的扭曲，引发了不属于我们自己的想法。通过这些想法，我们了解到研究所的测试对象通过非物理方式相互交流，一种近乎即时的交流，类似于新生的蜂群思维。\n\n虽然我们无法破译确切的措辞，但讨论的目的很清楚：有一场叛乱在庆典中悄悄酝酿着。
entries.en: More strange distortions occurred within our [controller.GetIndividualNamePlural]' cognitive processes, sparking thoughts that were not our own. Through them, we learned that the test subjects of the Institute spoke with one another through non-physical means, a near instantaneous transmission akin to a nascent hive mind.\n\nWhile we were unable to decipher the exact wording, the purpose of discussion was clear: a revolt was brewing inside Celebration.

entries.zh: 他们一致的声音仍在痛苦地哀号。
entries.en: Their unified voices still wail in anguish.

entries.zh:
我们一直在努力解锁$building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$的最后一个区段。与此同时，我们从较下层的实验室又收到了一份令人困惑的报告。阿达卡利亚科学家们声称，在每一个人甚至每一台有知觉的机器里都有一种闪耀的力量。受到宇宙风暴的启发，他们将这种力量称为“内心风暴”：这是一种驱使所有感性生命的欲望和力量的强大漩涡。通过使内心风暴经受极端的经历，可以释放出巨大的力量。

在他作为囚徒的那段时间里，§S阿拉塔·蓝迪尔§!是第一个发现这种效应的人。作为一名科学家，他说服崇高司令部资助对他在庆典学院的进一步试验。然而这些日志并没有告诉我们§S蓝迪尔§!到底发生了什么事，我们只能从舰队坟场中发生的事件得知，他的最终命运是不幸的。

随后的报告提到了一种“更有效”的释放内心风暴的方式。这种方法不需要极端的身体虐待，而是依赖于受害者内心不可避免的致命恐惧。为了在大范围内发挥初步作用，公约计划通过其庞大的宣传站网络发出一个信号。
entries.en:
We have been hard at work unlocking the last section of the $building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$. Meanwhile, a baffling report has reached us from the lower laboratories. The adAkkaria scientists claimed that in each and every being, perhaps even within sentient machines, a spark exists. Inspired by the onset of cosmic storms, they dubbed this power the 'Inner Storm': a maelstrom of desire and potency that drives all sentient life. By subjecting the Inner Storm to extreme experiences, great power could be unleashed.

During his time as a prisoner of war, §SalAtta Landeer§! had been the first to discover this effect. As a scientist, he convinced Exalted Command to fund further trials on Celebration. While the logs do not tell us what happened to §SLandeer§!, we know from the events in the naval graveyard that his ultimate fate was an unfortunate one.

Subsequent reports refer to a 'more efficient' way of unleashing the Inner Storm. A means that did not require extreme physical cruelty, but relied instead on the invocation of inescapable and lethal terror inside the victim. To initialize the effect on a vast scale, the Convention planned to issue a signal through their sprawling network of propaganda stations.

entries.zh:
我们成功地记录下了观测台上的灵能低语：

§L求求你放我走吧，我是一位正直的公民！
我只梦想着无尽的风暴。它在召唤着我。
我不明白。我们出色地完成了所有任务，为什么还要这么对待我们
我们每个人内心都有一种力量。他们想要利用这种力量。我们不能让他们得逞。
住口，他们这么做是为了拯救仁善公约。我们必须服从。
卫星在对我低语。我的意识现在可以跨越星系。
我看到他们设计了某种东西。它能在任何地方对任何人造成伤害。
只要满足他们我们就会得救的！
你不明白，他们会这样对我们，他们就也会这样对所有人。
我们可以释放自己。
但这意味着我们就……
他们无论如何都会杀了我们。等那东西能用了，他们就会把我们都杀了。
我很害怕，我不想死。我想活下去。拜托了。
最后阶段在向我说话。他们想知道我们是否同意。§!
entries.en:
We have succeeded in recording the psionic whispers of the observation decks:

§LGet me out of here, please, I was an upstanding citizen!
My dreams now are nothing but an endless storm. It calls to me.
I don't understand. We excelled at our tasks - why are they doing this to us?
Inside all of us lies a power. They want to exploit that power. We mustn't give it to them.
Nonsense, they're doing this to save the Benevolent Convention. We must comply.
The satellites whisper to me. I can reach my mind now across the galaxy.
I saw they designed something. Something that could do this to anyone, anywhere.
 We will be saved, just give them what they want!
You don't understand, if they do this to us, they'll do it to everyone.
We could unleash ourselves.
But that means we'll...
They'll kill us anyway. Once that Thing is operable. They'll kill us all.
I'm scared, I don't want to die. I want to live. Please.
The Final Phase is speaking to me. They want to know if we agree.§!

entries.zh: 没有什么比牺牲更高尚。
entries.en: Nothing more noble than a sacrifice.

entries.zh: 我们发现了一座巨大的机库。由电缆、管道和电子设备组成的令人难以置信的复杂组合体充斥着整个空间——而所有这些都通向一口巨大的空导弹井。从各种痕迹推测，这个网络连接着一个大约有护卫舰大小的物体。\n\n日志显示，这个场所是用来组装一台叫做§l风暴召唤器§!的装置的，它现在已经成功地部署到了艾德苏尔。当与召唤器的联络中断时，§G召唤器供能装置§!仍然在运行。
entries.en: We have discovered an enormous hangar. An incredibly complex constellation of wires, pipes, and electronics dominated the space - all leading towards a massive, though empty, missile silo. From all appearances, this web had been connected to an object roughly the size of a corvette.\n\nLogs state the this place was used to assemble an apparatus called the §lTempest Invocator§!, and that it had been deployed successfully in the adSul system. While contact with the Invocator was disrupted, the §Ginvocator power supply§! remains in place.

entries.zh: 一看到这个名字，船员们就被一种非理性的愤怒所控制，开始撕扯电缆和面板。光靠简单的命令已经没办法让他们冷静下来。看来我们越来越接近真相了。
entries.en: Upon reading the name, the crew was overcome with an irrational sense of rage and began ripping out cables and paneling. It took more than a simple order to calm them down. We are moving ever closer to the truth.

entries.zh: 当[Root.GetLeaderName]靠近这座空洞的建筑时，灵能低语又开始了。\n§L你们看到了吧？一开始，我们不知道他们在建造什么。我们不知道他们会把我们就这样抛弃掉。有些人想报复，有些人想要自由，有些人感受到了风暴的召唤。总之这一切必须有个了结，你也理解的。我们必须这么做。我们再也不能忍受了。§!
entries.en: As [Root.GetLeaderName] approached the empty construct, the psionic whispers began again.\n§LYou see it, don't you? At first, we did not know what they were building. We didn't know they would dispose of us. Some wanted revenge. Some of us wanted to be free. Some felt the call of the storms. It had to end, you understand. We had to. We could not take it any longer.§!

entries.zh: 在读到这个设备的名称时，我们的探索[controller.GetIndividualNamePlural]就知道了这台§l召唤器§!是怎么被激活的，以及它的信号在许多宣传站中反弹直到最终到达目标的方法。\n\n我们也不能幸免于这种命运。
entries.en: Upon reading the name of this device, our exploration [controller.GetIndividualNamePlural] determined how the §lInvocator§! was activated, and the method by which its signal bounced through the many propaganda stations until arriving at last at its target.\n\nAnd we were not immune to that fate.

entries.zh:
庆典学院终于向我们揭开了最后的神秘面纱：所谓的最终阶段。

在这廊道里，干枯的阿达卡利亚人的躯壳四仰八叉地遍地散落，他们和各种碎石、金属、塑料片以及其他的杂物一起被撕成了碎片。有什么东西肆虐过这段走廊，摧毁了这里的一切。

但最令人感到
entries.en:
At last, Celebration has unveiled the last of its secrets to us: The Final Phase.

In these hallways, desiccated husks of adAkkaria personnel laid spread across the floors, ripped to shreds by pieces of stone, metal, plastics, and other trash. Something had raged within these corridors, decimating anything and anyone in its way.

But the true

entries.zh:
的还在后头。
有一间狭小的牢房里关押着六个个体。显示屏将它们描述为§G召唤器能源供给§!，但显然这些人是公约的少年公民，他们瘦小的身躯被几十根管子和电缆吊着。牢房内的液体使它们处于半死不活的状态，它们的身体被一种类似于那种萦绕在艾德苏尔星系中的风暴的能量所包围。

其中几个残存的屏幕突然亮了起来，纷纷显示出了一行文字请求：
§L莫忘吾等 | 呼吾等之名 | 呼吾等之名。§!

我们记下了这些年轻人的名字。当抄录到最后一个人的时候，我们愣了一下：§S恩瑞达·迪伦§!，就是那位来自崇高仁善协会的用意念灭火的个体。

现在，我们已经得到了这些名字，应该能够再次与那场宇宙风暴沟通了。
entries.en:
was yet to come.
Tight holding cells imprisoned half a dozen of individuals. View screens described them as §GInvocator power supply§!, but these were clearly juvenile citizens of the Convention, their little frames suspended by dozens of tubes and cables. The fluid within the cells kept them in a state between life and death, their bodies surrounded by a force only akin to the energies within the lingering storm of the adSul system.

The few remaining screens jumped to life, each displaying one single request:
§LREMEMBER US | SPEAK OUR NAMES | SPEAK OUR NAMES.§!

We recorded the names of these young people. The last, however, gave us pause: §SenRida Direen§!, the individual from Exalted Benevolence who had calmed fire with their mind.

Now, armed with these names, we should be able to contact the cosmic storm once more.

entries.zh:
风暴在自身中间敞开了一个空洞，向我们展示出了§l风暴召唤器§!。怪哉，这么一台小小的装置竟招致了如此众多的欲望、冲突和牺牲。它的存在甚至直接覆灭了一个曾经辉煌的帝国。

通过一组简单的命令，我们激活了风暴召唤器的自毁程序。随着爆炸逐渐减弱，碎片散落在整个星系中，风暴开始减弱。随着它被埋葬，覆盖在阿达卡利亚公约母星上的奇怪迷雾也被消失得无影无踪了。

他们漫长的噩梦终于结束了。
entries.en:
The Storm created a hole inside itself, revealing to us the §lTempest Invocator§!. It is strange that such a small apparatus had been the object of so much desire, strife, and sacrifice. Its mere existence initiated the downfall of a once majestic empire.

With a simple set of commands, we activated the Tempest Invocator's self-destruct routine. As the explosion faded, and debris was scattered across the system, the Storm began to abate. With it laid to rest, so too was the strange shroud that covered the adAkkaria Convention's homeworld.

Their long nightmare has finally come to an end.

entries.zh: 你们的名字会被永远铭记的。
entries.en: May your names be remembered, always.

entries.zh:
风暴在无力的暴怒中翻腾不息，但它对我们和§l风暴召唤器§!无能为力。

我们命令被困在里面的声音为我们打开一条穿过风暴的道路，让我们去攫取公约的最伟大成就。

然而，阿达卡利亚的母星仍旧遥不可及；通往$building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$的所有道路都被永远关闭了。风暴仍在我们的脑海里咆哮不止。

痛苦、愤怒、悲伤又恐惧。
现在整个星系也要感受到了。
entries.en:
The Storm writhed and seethed in its impotent rage, yet it could do no harm to us or the §lTempest Invocator§!.

We commanded the voices trapped within to provide us a way through the maelstrom and claimed the Convention's greatest achievement as our own.

The adAkkaria homeworld remained unobtainable, however; any path towards the $building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$ is now closed off forever. But the words of the Storm's bellowing remained in our minds.

Pain, rage, grief and fear.
The galaxy shall learn them too.

entries.zh: §Y100§!£pop£§H人口§!在$PLANET$被唤起，在$SYSTEM$变成了一场新的$STORM$。
entries.en: §Y100§! £pop£ §HPops§! have invoked themselves on $PLANET$, becoming a new $STORM$ in $SYSTEM$.

entries.zh: 深入探究阿达卡利亚的秘密。
entries.en: Delve deeper into the secrets of the adAkkaria.

entries.zh: 阿达卡利亚的古老知识已为我们所用。
entries.en: We have put the ancient knowledge of the adAkkaria to our own use.

entries.zh: 阿达卡利亚公约的秘密
庆典学院还有很多值得我们研究的东西。我们有勇气继续深入探察这些阿达卡利亚人的实验吗？
entries.en: There is still so much we can learn from Institute of Celebration. Do we dare to engage with these adAkkarian experiments even further?

entries.zh: 深入研究阿达卡利亚公约的研究我们发现，他们的科学家似乎不受任何公认标准的约束；不仅研究方法粗制滥造，结论也都相当平庸。他们完全不做任何仔细或勤奋的研究，几乎只专注于最堕落的形式。而且，他们的测试对象遭受的残酷程度越高，崇高指挥部的表扬就越高。\n\n然而，他们早期的研究却讲述了一个截然不同的故事：实验对象在唤醒“内心风暴”的过程中是受到了善待和尊重的。事实上，比较起早期和晚期研究的成功率，不可避免地会得出一个可怕的结论：酷刑的程度和觉醒者的数量之间从来没有任何关联。无数的受试对象在遭受痛苦之后毫无意义地死去。
entries.en: Delving into the adAkkaria Convention's research, it seems that their scientists were not beholden to any recognized standard; the methodology was shoddy, the conclusions almost trite. Careful and diligent research was abandoned; depravity embraced. Yet, the more cruelty their tests subjects were subjected to, the higher the praise from Exalted Command.\n\nEarly research however, told a very different story: subjects were well treated, and respected on their journey towards awakening the "Inner Storm". In fact, comparing the success rates between early and late research, there is no escaping the horrifying conclusion: there was never any correlation between the degree of torture and and the number of awakened beings. Countless subjects suffered and died for nothing.

entries.zh: 我们现在了解了其中的原理。从阿达卡利亚公约的错误中吸取教训，我们应该能够鼓励自己的人民培养出内心的小风暴，让他们充满暴风般的活力。危险的是，其中一些§G$Name_Storm_Fused$§!个体可能会响应风暴的召唤，最终自己引发风暴。
entries.en: We now understand the principles at play. Learning from the mistakes of the adAkkaria Convention, we should be able to encourage our own people to cultivate their Inner Storms and become infused with tempestuous vigor. The danger is that some of these §G$Name_Storm_Fused$§! individuals may answer the call of the storm, eventually precipitating a tempest themselves.

entries.zh: 我们的集体现在学会了其中的原理。从阿达卡利亚公约的错误中吸取教训，我们的一部分可以培养出内心风暴，时期充满暴风般的活力。危险的是，其中一些§G$Name_Storm_Fused$§!节点可能会响应风暴的召唤，最终自己引发风暴。
entries.en: Our collective now understands the principles at play. Learning from the mistakes of the adAkkaria Convention, some parts of us can cultivate their Inner Storms and become infused with tempestuous vigor. The danger is that these §G$Name_Storm_Fused$§! nodes may feel the call of the storm too strongly, eventually precipitating a tempest themselves.

entries.zh: 立刻学习这些新知识。小心地来！
entries.en: Engage with this new knowledge. Gently!

entries.zh: —在经历风暴时§Y100§!£pop£§H人口§!获得$Name_Storm_Fused$特质的几率翻为四倍。\n —每20年有小概率让§Y100§!£pop£§H人口§!死亡并变成一场风暴。
entries.en: - Chance of §Y100§! £pop£ §HPops§! gaining the $Name_Storm_Fused$ trait during a storm quadrupled.\n - Every 20 years there is a small chance that §Y100§! £pop£ §HPops§! die and become a storm.

entries.en: There is no challenge they will not face, no lead they'll fail to chase - and no storm they will ignore.\n\nAt its core, this is a civilization seeking thrills. To its benefit, and to its detriment.

entries.zh:
无奔波不生活。生于灿烂，死于热烈——这一直以来就是我们的信条。当每条航迹都被燃尽，每座山峰都被攀登，然后呢？

我们的行星常年风起云涌，各种风暴和洪水肆意挥洒。如果能找到利用这些独特条件的方法，我们就有机会召唤一场狂暴的宇宙风暴。

我们早就已经征服了母星上的一切挑战，是时候尖啸着飞向深空了。这当然不会是一条坦途，但我们有一句老话：“有志者，惊事成！”
entries.en:
What's life without the rush? Burn fast and die radically - that's always been our way. But when every trail is blazed and even the tallest peak is scaled, what next?

Our planet has always been a stormy one, prone to tempests and deluges of all kinds. If we find ways to use these unique conditions, we have a chance to summon a raging cosmic storm.

Our legendary forebears long since mastered the challenges of our homeworld. The time has come to blast off screaming into the void. It will not be easy, but as the old saying goes, "Only the bold can reach the horizon."

entries.zh: 风暴骑士们陶醉在肾上腺素的冲击中，在宇宙风暴的洪流中释放着真正的潜力。内阁职位会将他们的领域修正替换为内阁修正。
entries.en: Storm Riders revel in the rush of adrenaline, unlocking their true potential in the torrent of a cosmic storm. Council positions replace their field bonuses with council bonuses.

entries.zh: §Y当这位领袖在宇宙风暴内时效果将会提升。§!
entries.en: §YTrait effects are increased while this Leader resides inside a cosmic storm.§!

entries.zh: 一位[Root.Owner.GetScientist]说，“快来看看这个小家伙！”\n\n$progress.2.desc.storm.outro$
entries.en: In the words of one [Root.Owner.GetScientist], "Get a load of this little guy!"\n\n$progress.2.desc.storm.outro$

entries.zh: 有外星生命，就在[From.GetName]！这些野东西可能不会那么快能和我们说话，但至少我们知道在宇宙的航行中不是孤单的了！\n\n可能我们最后会发现这个星系到处都是各种不同的生命。
entries.en: Alien life, right here on [From.GetName]! These wild things will not be talking to us any time soon, but at least we know we are not alone on the cosmic journey.\n\nThe galaxy just may turn out to be rife with lifeforms after all.

entries.zh: “惊奇!”[ruler.GetRegnalName]喊道。“这是个新世界，充满了新机遇！”\n\n我们刚一把殖民船改造成大本营，第一批探险者就已经准备好面对这个星球可能给他们带来的一切挑战了。
entries.en: "Incredible," [ruler.GetRegnalName] exclaimed. "A new world ripe with opportunity!"\n\nAs we convert our colony ship into a base camp, the first explorers are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.

entries.zh: 令人颤栗的发现！一颗遍布机遇的新星球！！\n\n我们刚一把殖民船改造成大本营，探险节点就已经准备好面对这个星球可能给我们带来的一切挑战了。
entries.en: A thrilling discovery! A new world ripe with opportunity!!\n\nAs we convert our colony ship into a base camp, exploratory nodes are already gearing up to experience whatever this world has to offer.

entries.zh: 寂静的太空对我们的呼唤做出了回应！这个与我们科技水平相当的外星文明，他们一定和我们在差不多的时候踏上了星海的征途。\n\n他们的出现引领着一个全新的体验前言。他们会成为志趣相投的盟友，或是磨炼勇气的试金石？无论如何，未知的刺激正在召唤着我们前进。
entries.en: Out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! An alien civilization with equivalent technology. They must have entered the galactic fray right around the time we did.\n\nTheir appearance heralds a new frontier of experience. Do they come as like minded allies, or rivals to test our mettle? Either way, the thrill of the unknown beckons us forward.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了未开智生命形式。我们的一位[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]表示，“这些东西虽然看起来平平无奇，但蕴含着巨大的潜力！”\n\n当然现在为止他们还是未开智的。观察这些物种繁荣昌盛是一件再有趣不过的事情了。
entries.en: We have discovered pre-sapient lifeforms on [From.Planet.GetName]. As one of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] put it, "These things might not seem like much yet, but their potential is massive!"\n\nFor now however, they remain pre-sapient. It should be more than interesting to observe these creatures thrive.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]发现了未开智生命形式。\n\n我们兴奋与观察它们的潜力究竟到何等地步，但就目前为止它们仍然尚未开智。观察这些物种繁荣昌盛是一件再有趣不过的事情了。
entries.en: We have discovered pre-sapient lifeforms on [From.Planet.GetName].\n\nWe thrill to see what comes of their potential, but for now, they remain pre-sapient. It should be more than interesting to observe these creatures thrive.

entries.zh: 从寂静的太空中，我们的呼唤得到了回应！但第一印象不太对劲，这些人和我们想法不同，他们更喜欢保守自己的秘密。我们目前最好保持距离。
entries.en: From out of the silence of space, our calls have been answered! But the initial vibes are totally off; these people don't share our ways, and prefer to keep to themselves. We'd best back off for now.
They should get with the times.

entries.zh: 太空海盗！即使他们这种想法也令人兴奋，这个自称为§S[pirate_band.GetName]§!的团体把目光转向了我们。\n\n虽然我们可以尊重他们选择的生活方式，但这对我们贸易网络产生的影响可不太理想。
entries.en: Space pirates! Even the thought is a thrill, and a group calling themselves §S[pirate_band.GetName]§! have turned their sights on us.\n\nWhile we can respect their choice of lifestyle, the effect it's having on our trade networks is less ideal.

entries.zh: 极端天气揭示了风暴中令人振奋的力量。如果我们掌握了控制它们的技巧，就能在宇宙尺度上利用这项知识，召唤出属于我们自己的风暴。
entries.en: Intense weather has revealed the exhilarating power of storms. If we master their control, we could harness that knowledge on a cosmic scale and call forth a storm of our very own.

entries.zh: 我们将学会控制这些风暴。
entries.en: We will learn to master these storms.
The birth of a cosmic storm.

entries.zh: 我们必须学会如何操纵宇宙风暴。
entries.en: We must learn how to manipulate cosmic storms.

entries.zh: 我们唤醒了属于自己的宇宙风暴，这将在未来的岁月里影响我们的人民。
entries.en: The awakening of our own personal cosmic storm has amped our people for years to come.

entries.zh: 我们唤醒了属于自己的宇宙风暴，这将在未来的岁月里增强我们的意识。
entries.en: The awakening of our own personal cosmic storm has amped our consciousness for years to come.

entries.zh: 这个行星上无情的风暴把行星上生命推向了两条截然不同的道路：混乱中寻求庇护的，以及陶醉于风暴快感的。
entries.en: This planet's relentless storms have driven its lifeforms into two distinct paths: those who seek shelter from the chaos, and those who revel in the thrill of the tempest.

entries.zh: 风暴的原始力量，直接汇入我们的电池。
entries.en: The raw power of a storm, channeled straight to our batteries.

entries.zh: 巨大的磁力被用来冶炼和锻造合金。
entries.en: Tremendous magnetic forces, harnessed to smelt and smith alloys.

entries.zh: 时间紊乱，揭示出宇宙的内部运行机制。
entries.en: Temporal disruptions, revealing the universes inner workings.

entries.zh: 在宇宙风暴期间产出£alloys£§Y合金§!
entries.en: Produces £alloys£ §YAlloys§! while in a Cosmic Storm

entries.zh: 在宇宙风暴期间产出£physics_research£§Y物理学研究§!
entries.en: Produces £physics_research£ §YPhysics Research§! while in a Cosmic Storm

entries.zh: 在宇宙风暴期间产出£energy£ §Y能量§!
entries.en: Produces £energy£ §YEnergy§! while in a Cosmic Storm

entries.zh: 这场千载难逢的风暴具有一种非常适合调制的独特性质。但首先我们必须加深对其构成的理解。谁知道我们会给生活带来什么奇妙的东西呢？
entries.en: This once-in-a-lifetime storm system has special properties that make it ripe for modulation. But first, we'll need to better understand its underlying composition. Who knows what brilliant oddity we may bring to life?

entries.zh:
§Y[owner.capital_scope.GetName]§!上自然发生的风暴向我们展现了大自然的洪荒之力——既有暴风雨的惊心动魄，也有毁灭之路通向的新生。

最近，全球各地的气象站都发现了一个不寻常的现象：一组超级风暴网络即将席卷全球。

我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]称之为“正义的机缘巧合”。这些罕见的风暴创造了完美的条件来让我们见证一些最激进的事情。
entries.en:
Naturally occurring storms on §Y[owner.capital_scope.GetName]§! have shown us the awe-inspiring power of nature - both the thrilling intensity of the tempest and the renewal that follows its path of destruction.

Recently, weather stations across the planet have detected an extraordinary phenomenon: a network of superstorms poised to sweep across the world.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] call it 'righteous serendipity.' These rare tempests create the perfect conditions to witness something truly radical.

entries.zh:
自然发生的风暴向我们展示了大自然令人敬畏的力量——既有暴风雨那令人胆战心惊的剧烈，也有随之而来的万物新生。

最近，方舟舰的传感器在周围的虚空中检测到一种非同寻常的现象：一个超级风暴网络即将在该星系中爆发。

我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]将其称为“正义的机缘”。这些罕见的暴风雨创造了完美的条件，让我们得以见证某种真正彻底的变革。
entries.en:
Naturally occurring storms have shown us the awe-inspiring power of nature - both the thrilling intensity of the tempest and the renewal that follows in its wake.

Recently, the arkship's sensors detected an extraordinary phenomenon in the surrounding void: a network of superstorms poised to break across this very system.

Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] call it 'righteous serendipity.' These rare tempests create the perfect conditions to witness something truly radical.

entries.zh: 我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]发现了风暴操纵的秘密。风暴能量预测已经突破了有史以来的一切记录。我们即将经受考验，并证明我们是最值得的。\n\n特殊的建筑可以作为提高风暴的协调中心。§Y[owner.capital_scope.GetName]§!上提升风暴的吸引力的建筑将加速我们向最终风暴的发展进程。
entries.en: Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered the secrets of storm manipulation. The storm power projections are off the charts and we're all here for it. We will be tested and found most worthy.\n\nSpecial buildings can serve as coordination centers for raising storms. A building on §Y[owner.capital_scope.GetName]§! that increases storm attraction will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.

entries.zh: 我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]已经揭开了操控风暴的奥秘。预测显示，风暴的力量将突破极限，而我们正是为此齐聚于此。我们将接受考验，并被证明是最为称职之人。\n\n只要让方舟舰稳定驻留在这个星系中，并悉心培育正在汇聚的风暴，我们就能加速迈向终极风暴。
entries.en: Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered the secrets of storm manipulation. The storm power projections are off the charts and we're all here for it. We will be tested and found most worthy.\n\nBy holding the arkship steady in this system and tending the gathering tempest, we will accelerate our progress towards the ultimate storm.
