将方舟舰留在§Y[stormfall_system.GetName]§!恒星系中，以应对正在聚集的风暴：
$situation_speed_tt$：§G+10%§!
entries.en:
Keep the arkship in the §Y[stormfall_system.GetName]§! system to tend the gathering storm:
$situation_speed_tt$: §G+10%§!

entries.zh:
通过向自然风暴中注入能量，我们可以为电力风暴创造出条件。

操纵行星核心可以改变[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的磁场方向，从而引起磁力风暴。

最后，通过在行星的特定位置逆转快子的极性，场的变化将可以用于产生引力风暴。
entries.en:
By injecting energy into the natural storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Planetary core manipulation could reorient the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] to give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity at specific planetary sites, field changes can produce gravity storms.

entries.zh: 我们已经学会了如何启动[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的狂暴振动，以及将它们塑造成一种终极体验。但是我们必须决定哪一种风暴是最为壮观的。\n\n$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$
entries.en: We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we must decide which storm type is the most glorious.\n\n$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 我们已经学会了如何启动[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的狂暴振动，以及将它们塑造成一种终极体验。但是我们尚未决定哪一种风暴是最为壮观的。\n\n$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$
entries.en: We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we have yet to decide which storm type is the most glorious.\n\n$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 我们已经学会了如何启动[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的狂暴振动，以及将它们塑造成一种终极体验。但是在试图确定哪种风暴类型是最为壮观时，我们的价值判断进程陷入了递归循环。\n\n$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$
entries.en: We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations of [owner.capital_scope.GetName], shaping them into the ultimate experience. But our value judgment processes are stuck in recursive loops trying to determine which storm type is the most glorious.\n\n$cstorms.3110.desc.outro$

entries.zh:
我们已经学会如何启动方舟舰周围狂暴的振荡，并将其塑造成终极体验。但我们必须决定哪种风暴类型最为壮观。

通过将原始能量引入周围的风暴，我们可以创造出形成电暴的条件。

重新调整作用于方舟船体的磁场方向，或许能引发磁暴。

最后，通过逆转我们周围空间中的超光速粒子极性，场的变化可以产生重力风暴。
entries.en:
We have learned how to kickstart the tempestuous vibrations surrounding the arkship, shaping them into the ultimate experience. But we must decide which storm type is the most glorious.

By channeling raw power into the surrounding storms, we can generate the conditions for electric storms.

Reorienting the magnetic fields that play across the arkship's hull could give rise to magnetic storms.

Finally, by reversing the tachyon polarity in the space around us, field changes can produce gravity storms.

entries.zh: 天雷滚滚，电闪嘶鸣！\n\n这些强大的放电过程不仅使行星表面带上电荷，而且也让我们感受到了真正的兴奋！虽然农业将遭受电力风暴的影响，但发电的潜力是不可否认的。
entries.en: The sky rumbles. Lightning sizzles all around us!\n\nNot only have these powerful discharges electrified the planet's surface, but they've left us truly amped! While farming will suffer from Electrical Storms, the potential for energy generation is undeniable.

entries.zh: [owner.capital_scope.GetName]的磁场剧烈扭曲着，罗盘也随之狂乱起舞。\n\n通过钻穿我们母星的地壳，我们将磁化物质直接注入地核，自然风暴放大了由此产生的磁场波动。这将妨碍能源生产，但会改善对新矿藏的探测。
entries.en: Compasses spin wildly as the magnetic field of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] contorts itself.\n\nBy boring through the crust of our homeworld, we were able to inject magnetized matter directly into the core, and the natural storms amplified the resulting field fluctuations. This will hamper energy generation, but improve the detection of new mineral deposits.

entries.zh:
简单的运动在如今也是如此令人感到前所未有地兴奋！重力在难以察觉的瞬间增大减小。

分散在[owner.capital_scope.GetName]各地的粒子操作站逆转了快子的极性，将它们聚焦成噼啪作响的能量球。当光球球迅速消失时——[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信它们被送回了过去——引力波在各个方向荡漾。

由此产生的波动将使行星表面作业变得困难，但可以改善促进在轨空间站的岗位。
entries.en:
Never before has simple movement around been so exhilarating! Gravity increases and decreases without a moment's notice.

Particle manipulation sites scattered across [owner.capital_scope.GetName] reversed the polarity of tachyons, which focused them into crackling balls of energy. As the orbs quickly vanished - [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe they were sent backward in time - gravity waves rippled in all directions.

The resulting fluctuations will make working on the planet's surface harder, but could improve jobs on orbiting stations.

entries.zh: 虚空噼啪作响，闪电划过方舟舰的船体！\n\n这些强大的放电让我们的船员真正振奋起来。虽然我们的水培系统将遭受电磁风暴的破坏，但其发电潜力不容置疑。
entries.en: The void crackles. Lightning sizzles across the arkship's hull!\n\nThese powerful discharges have left our crew truly amped. While our hydroponics will suffer from the electrical storms, the potential for energy generation is undeniable.

entries.zh: 方舟舰周围的磁场剧烈扭曲，舰上每一个罗盘都在疯狂旋转。\n\n通过向周围的风暴中排放磁化物质，我们放大了其磁场波动。这会妨碍能源生产，但也能提高发现新矿物的几率。
entries.en: Every compass aboard spins wildly as the magnetic fields around the arkship contort themselves.\n\nBy venting magnetized matter into the surrounding storms, we amplified their field fluctuations. This will hamper energy generation, but improve the detection of new mineral deposits.

entries.zh:
从未有过，仅仅穿行于各层甲板之间就如此惊心动魄！重力在毫无预兆的情况下时强时弱。

方舟舰各处的场发射器逆转了快子的极性，将其聚焦成噼啪作响的能量球。随着这些能量球迅速消失——[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] 认为它们被送回了过去——引力波向四面八方荡漾开来。

由此产生的波动会让舰上的工作更加困难，但也可能提高轨道空间站的工作效率。
entries.en:
Never before has simple movement through the decks been so exhilarating! Gravity swells and fades without a moment's notice.

Field emitters across the arkship reversed the polarity of tachyons, focusing them into crackling balls of energy. As the orbs quickly vanished - [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe they were sent backward in time - gravity waves rippled in all directions.

The resulting fluctuations will make work aboard harder, but could improve jobs on orbiting stations.

entries.zh: [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，我们用来刺激行星风暴的想法可以应用到更大的范围中去，现在整个恒星系都在狂暴的能量中旋转。
entries.en: Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are convinced that the same ideas that we devoted to prodding the planetary storms could apply on a much larger scale, now that the whole system swirls with tempestuous energy.

entries.zh:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

我们可以利用现成的知识和基础设施将其转化为一场$electric_storm$，也可以创造一些刺激的新东西。

引入特定的矿物将会增强风暴的磁场共振，而利用合金则会将其变为一个重力井。
entries.en:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an $electric_storm$, or we create something new and exciting.

Introducing certain minerals would amplify the storm's magnetic resonance, while utilizing alloys would instead transform the storm into a gravity well.

entries.zh:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

我们可以利用现成的知识和基础设施将其转化为一场$magnetic_storm$，也可以创造一些刺激的新东西。

充能恒星将会增强风暴的电力潜能，而利用合金则会将其变为一个重力井。
entries.en:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an $magnetic_storm$, or we create something new and exciting.

Charging our sun would amplify the storm's electric potential, while utilizing alloys would instead transform the storm into a gravity well.

entries.zh:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

我们可以利用现成的知识和基础设施将其转化为一场$gravity_storm$，也可以创造一些刺激的新东西。

引入特定的矿物将会增强风暴的磁场共振，而充能恒星将会增强风暴的电力潜能。
entries.en:
$cstorms.3140.desc.intro$

We can use existing knowledge and infrastructure to transform it into an $gravity_storm$, or we create something new and exciting.

Introducing certain minerals would amplify the storm's magnetic resonance, while charging our sun would instead amplify the storm's electric potential.

entries.zh: 随着行星风暴的消散，[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上又出现了一个新的长期特征。风暴又一次带来了新生的机遇。\n\n虽然这场局部风暴令人振奋，但是我们也只能畅想着一场真正的宇宙风暴的可能性。为什么它要花这么长时间？
entries.en: When the planetary storm dispersed, a new lasting feature appeared on [owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Once again a storm has brought about change and rebirth.\n\nAs exhilarating as this local storm was, we can only imagine the possibilities of a true cosmic storm. Why does it take so long?

entries.zh: 风暴消散后，在方舟舰本身留下了永久的印记。风暴再次带来了改变与新生。\n\n尽管这一切令人振奋，我们也只能想象真正的宇宙风暴会带来怎样的可能性。为什么它迟迟不来？
entries.en: When the storm dispersed, it left a lasting mark upon the arkship itself. Once again a storm has brought about change and rebirth.\n\nAs exhilarating as this was, we can only imagine the possibilities of a true cosmic storm. Why does it take so long?
The storm left behind electrified §Y$d_buzzing_plains$§! on [owner.capital_scope.GetName].
The storm left behind new §Y$d_geothermal_vent$§! on [owner.capital_scope.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们已为方舟舰装配了§Y$d_stormfall_electric$§!。
entries.en: We have fitted the arkship with a §Y$d_stormfall_electric$§!.

entries.zh: 我们已为方舟舰装配了§Y$d_stormfall_magnetic$§!。
entries.en: We have fitted the arkship with a §Y$d_stormfall_magnetic$§!.

entries.zh: 我们已经为方舟舰装配了§Y$d_stormfall_gravity$§!。
entries.en: We have fitted the arkship with a §Y$d_stormfall_gravity$§!.

entries.zh: 我们可以加速巨大的宇宙风暴的涌现，但我们也必须扪心自问——我们真的准备好为此命悬一线了吗？\n\n
entries.en: We can hasten the appearance of the immense cosmic storm now taking shape, but must ask ourselves - are we truly ready for the ride of our lives?\n\n

entries.zh: 一支由§Y[event_target:storm_scientist.GetName]§!带领的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]队伍可以研究这些早期的宇宙风暴模式，以发现操作它们生成的理想途径。\n\n
entries.en: A team of [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] led by §Y[event_target:storm_scientist.GetName]§! could research these early cosmic storm patterns to find optimal ways to manipulate their formation.\n\n

entries.zh: 如果我们让§Y[event_target:storm_commander.GetName]§!带领一支军队过去，他们能够引爆萌发中的风暴，让能量倾泻而下。\n\n
entries.en: If we send the military led by §Y[event_target:storm_commander.GetName]§!, they can blast the burgeoning tempest and let the energy cascade.\n\n

entries.zh: 这支由领袖带领的队伍未必能安全回来。然而，他们也有成就一番伟大事业的可能！
entries.en: This leader-led team risks an uncertain return. Then again, they may achieve something awesome!

entries.zh: 我们现在能做的只有坐等宇宙风暴成型。\n\n这种等待让人心急如焚，但也会让回报来得更猛烈一些。
entries.en: All we can do now is wait for the cosmic storm to take shape.\n\nThe anticipation is almost unbearable, but will make the payoff even greater.

entries.zh: 科学家§Y[event_target:storm_scientist.GetName]§!暂时失踪，并有死亡的风险。
entries.en: Scientist §Y[event_target:storm_scientist.GetName]§! is temporarily lost and at risk of death.

entries.zh: 指挥官§Y[event_target:storm_commander.GetName]§!暂时失踪，并有死亡的风险。
entries.en: Commander §Y[event_target:storm_commander.GetName]§! is temporarily lost and at risk of death.

entries.zh: 起初只是宇宙织构中的一点波纹。能量在这里舞动、融合、碰撞。加一点奇异粒子、再一点质量，最后，附近一颗恒星的引力使这一切都倾泻到我们面前的这只野兽身上。\n\n这个按照我们的意愿雕刻而来的自然和智慧的奇迹主宰了天空，并激起了狂热的兴奋。
entries.en: It began with a wrinkle in the cosmic fabric. Energies danced, merged, and collided. A hint of exotic particles, a dash of mass, and finally, the nascent storm that circles our star precipitated the beast before us.\n\nSculpted according to our wishes, this blessing of nature and ingenuity dominates the skies.

entries.zh: $cstorms.3190.desc.intro$我们的领袖穿越风暴，激起了一阵狂热的兴奋。\n\n我们做到了。只有我们做到了。让我们乘风破浪，享受一生难得的快感吧！
entries.en: $cstorms.3190.desc.intro$ Our leader riding out through the storm has whipped up a frenzy of excitement.\n\nWe did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

entries.zh: $cstorms.3190.desc.intro$我们的领袖迷失在风暴中，但这是多么好的出路！\n\n我们做到了。只有我们做到了。让我们乘风破浪，享受一生难得的快感吧！
entries.en: $cstorms.3190.desc.intro$ Our leader was lost in the storm, but what a way to go out!\n\nWe did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

entries.zh: $cstorms.3190.desc.intro$我们已经等待了太久，但这一天终于到了。\n\n我们做到了。只有我们做到了。让我们乘风破浪，享受一生难得的快感吧！
entries.en: $cstorms.3190.desc.intro$ We have waited long, but the day is finally here.\n\nWe did this. We alone did this. Let us ride this storm and embrace the thrill of a lifetime!

entries.zh: \n我们的领袖光荣地离开了人世。
entries.en: \nOur leader went out in a blaze of glory.
We feel a sudden onset of ennui.

entries.zh:
宇宙的振动消失了，一如既往的壮举却没有像往常一般唤起人们的兴奋。我们毫无疑问完成了难以置信的事情，但人们都感到缺少了一些东西。我们祖先的成就，从水平和野心上都是传奇，向身后的我们投下了长长的阴影。

“这些斗争是最存在主义的！”我们的一位顶尖人士最近写道。“我们是在穿越了虚空之后，让自己陷入了空虚之中？”

焦虑是真实存在的，现在是采取行动的时候了。为了重新开始，我们回到起点：制定一系列挑战，以最大限度激发肾上腺素！
entries.en:
The cosmic vibrations are off, and the usual feats just don't evoke the same excitement they used to. There's no doubt we've accomplished incredible things, but there is a pervasive sense that something is missing. The achievements of our ancestors, legendary in their scope and ambition, cast a long shadow.

"These struggles are most existential!" one of our top minds recently wrote. "By traversing the void, have we opened a void in ourselves?"

The angst is real, and the time to act is now. To start fresh, we return to the beginning: a series of challenges custom designed to invoke maximum adrenaline!

entries.zh:
宇宙的振动消失了，一如既往的壮举却没有像往常一般唤起人们的兴奋。我们毫无疑问完成了难以置信的事情，但人们都感到缺少了一些东西。

我们被这样的问题所困扰着：我们真的知道自己是谁吗？我们的光辉岁月已经过去了吗？作为一个集体，我们有责任成为最好的自己。

焦虑是真实存在的，现在是采取行动的时候了。为了重新开始，我们回到起点：制定一系列挑战，以最大限度激发肾上腺素！
entries.en:
The cosmic vibrations are off, and the usual feats just don't evoke the same excitement they used to. There's no doubt we've accomplished incredible things, but there is a pervasive sense that something is missing.

We are plagued by questions: do we truly know who we are? Are our glory days behind us? As a collective, we have a responsibility to become the best version of ourselves.

The angst is real, and the time to act is now. To start fresh, we return to the beginning: a series of challenges custom designed to invoke maximum adrenaline!

entries.zh: 在情报日志查阅过往的挑战。
entries.en: Discover the challenges of the past in the Situation Log.

entries.zh: 我们做到了！\n\n我们的目标是追求纯粹的刺激，我们也已经迎接了每一个挑战。见证我们在往昔岁月里所取得的成就吧！
entries.en: We've done it!\n\nSetting our sights on the pure pursuit of thrills, we've met every challenge. Witness what we've accomplished in the past years!

entries.zh:
$cstorms.3215.intro$

就像我们的杰出先烈们一样，我们超越了自己的极限。

甚至，由于与自然的狂怒抗衡，我们还获得了对自身存在价值的难以置信的洞见。
entries.en:
$cstorms.3215.intro$

Like the most excellent pioneers of old, we have pushed ourselves beyond our limits.

Even better, due to our engagement with nature's fury, we have gained incredible insight into the meaning of our existence.

entries.zh: 浩宇风暴将临使我们陷入了狂热。
entries.en: The advent of the Big One sets us in a state of frenzy.

entries.zh: 浩宇风暴将临使我们的意识如火燎烧。
entries.en: The advent of the Big One sets our consciousness aflame.

entries.zh: 驱使我们行动的既非霸权，也不是物质上的收益。生活就是要挑战极限，我们是信众，追随着存在本身的极限。
entries.en: It is not supremacy that drives us, nor material gain. We live to test our limits, disciples of the bleeding edge of existence.

entries.zh: §Y[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]§!对我们的看法发生了以下变化：
我们一直在挑战极限。在前人事迹的鼓舞下，我们现在有机会塑造自己梦想的风暴。
entries.en: We have always pushed the limits. Inspired by the deeds of our predecessors, we now have the chance to sculpt the storm of our dreams.

entries.zh:
我们的人民永无止境地追求刺激。每天我们都会发现不可思议的情景，面临更大的挑战，但[ruler.GetRegnalName]觉得我们还能更进一步：

“宇宙风暴的核心唯有潜能；那是真正的、最尖锐的前沿。它尖锐到足以斩断现状，释放出一生难得一次的快感。”

挑起一场真正史诗级风暴的时机已到，这将会是一场混乱的狂欢：浩宇风暴。现在只剩下两个小细节：一是要进行最后的研究，以敲定如何触发完美风暴，二是星系的其他人对我们是否应该这么做有什么看法。

实现这样的东西肯定会激起一些怨恨的。
entries.en:
Our people will never stop looking for a thrill. Every day we discover incredible situations and face greater challenges, but [ruler.GetRegnalName] thinks we can go even further:

"The core of a cosmic storm is pure potential; the true, bleeding edge. An edge sharp enough to sever the status-quo and unleash the rush of a lifetime."

The time is ripe to provoke a storm of truly epic proportions, a nexus of joyous pandemonium: The Big One. Only two minor details remain: a final study to determine exactly how to invoke the perfect storm, and the opinion of the rest of the galaxy should we choose to do so.

Bringing something like this into being is sure to stir up some resentment.

entries.zh: 我们有培植风暴的技术，附近却没有初生的风暴。我们需要研究如何播种出一个可以培植的风暴。
entries.en: We have the technology, but without a nascent storm in the vicinity, we will need to investigate how to seed a storm we can sculpt.

entries.zh: 暗物质独一无二的性质使其成为浩宇风暴的完美导火索。我们将向环绕风暴中心的太空织构注入这种难以捉摸的物质，等待风暴的第一波涟漪出现。\n\n然而，这件事已经引起了多余的关注：邻国们开始抗议了。“不是谁都跟我们一样兴高采烈地随风逐浪，”我们一位[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]埋怨道。
entries.en: The unique properties of Dark Matter make it the perfect thing to stir up The Big One. We will inject this elusive material into the spatial fabric surrounding the storm's heart and wait for the first ripples of the storm to appear.\n\nHowever, this has already attracted some unwanted attention: our neighbors have begun to protest. "Not everyone is as stoked as us to ride this particular wave," complained one of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural].
We need to save up some resources.

entries.zh: 小心地将暗物质注入太空织构就可以在这个恒星系中激起可塑的风暴。
entries.en: By carefully injecting Dark Matter into the spatial fabric, a malleable storm will be provoked within this system.

entries.zh: 难以置信！即将来临的风暴的萌动已经能感觉到了。我们[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]的还在努力着，但使我们离引发浩宇风暴又近了一步。\n\n然而，我们的邻国并不太满意。他们声称我们在胡搞我们不可能理解的力量，这已经影响了我们间的关系。
entries.en: Incredible! The nascent vibrations of the coming storm are already being felt. The work of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] is ongoing, but we are now one step closer to summoning The Big One.\n\nHowever, our neighbors are less pleased. They claim we're meddling with powers we cannot possibly comprehend, and this has already affected our relations.

entries.zh: 数据已然明晰：这场风暴可谓种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。既是如此，若是我们给风暴饲喂合适类型的资源，它就能拥有任何一种风暴的特性，并达到史诗般的规模。\n\n星系的住民们再次表达了担忧，但世纪之旅已指日可待。该穷尽国力饲育风暴了！
entries.en: The data is clear: whatever we put into this storm, something similar will come out of it. Ergo, if we feed it the right type of resources, then it will take on properties - and epic proportions- of every type of storm.\n\nThe people of the galaxy continue to express concern, but the ride of the century is just waiting to be born. Let us feed it what we have!

entries.zh: 若是我们想要创造一场史诗般的风暴，就必须为这场初生的风暴提供种种养分。这项惊人的壮举需要我们手头上一组特定的资源。
entries.en: We must provide the nascent storm a wide variety of nourishment if we wish to create a storm of epic proportions. This amazing feat requires a specific sampling of resources at our disposal.

entries.zh: 我们如今知晓宇宙风暴能靠提供正确的饮食来操控。为了饲育这场风暴，我们需要特定的资源。
entries.en: We now know that a cosmic storm can be manipulated by feeding it the correct diet. To feed this one, we require a certain sampling.

entries.zh: 创造一场完美的风暴需要一组精心调配的资源。
entries.en: Creating the perfect storm will require a carefully measured sampling of resources.

entries.zh: 兴奋之情溢于言表。前方的道路越发清晰：前进，前进，向着目标前进。让我们与宇宙的狂热融为一体！万事俱备，只需稍加一把推手，浩宇风暴就要来临。\n\n我们的邻国已然怒不可遏，声称我们所谓的“$nexus_storm$”将对星系造成巨大的破坏。但我们真要让这些扫兴的家伙毁掉这一史诗般的项目吗？抉择的时刻到了。
entries.en: The excitement is palpable. The path ahead grows clear: push further, push harder, push through. Let us become one with cosmic frenzy itself! Everything is now ready for the Big One. We just need to give one small push.\n\nOur neighbors are already beyond livid, claiming that our so-called '$nexus_storm$' will wreak havoc on the galaxy. But are we really going to let these killjoys derail a project of such epic proportions? The time to choose is now.

entries.zh: 浩宇风暴是我们的终极宿命！
entries.en: The Big One is our ultimate destiny!

entries.zh: 算了，我们可以做得更好！
entries.en: No, we are better than this!

entries.zh: 我们站在新体验的悬崖边。终极灾难的时刻到了。我们的风暴骑士无所畏惧，从没有他们不肯接受的挑战。让星系听见我们的名字吧！\n\n让整个星系开开眼界！
entries.en: Here we are - at the precipice of a new experience. The time of ultimate calamity has arrived. There is nothing our Storm Riders won't face. No challenge we will ever deny.\n\nLet the galaxy witness!

entries.zh: 我们学到了很多。终于知道星系不是玩物，而是一场有待体验的冒险。\n\n[ruler.GetRegnalName]说得好：“人生从不缺刺激。我们永远不会停止追求下一个挑战，但我们必须怀着敬意。与星系及其居民和谐共处是我们的准则。我们选择了这么做，这才是我们真正的意义所在。”
entries.en: We have learned much. Now we understand that the galaxy is not a toy to be played with, but an adventure to be experienced.\n\n[ruler.GetRegnalName] said it best: "In this life, there are no shortages of thrills. We'll never stop seeking the next challenge, but we must do so with respect. This is what we have chosen. This is who we are truly meant to be.

entries.zh: 为了再创新高，感受欢愉以及挑战我们的极限，我们现在开始一系列试炼。欢乐时间到！
entries.en: To reach new heights, to know joy and to test our limits, we now embark on a series of trials. Let the fun begin!

entries.zh: 在风暴内战胜一支舰队
entries.en: Defeat a Fleet Inside a Storm

entries.zh: 激烈的战斗一直算是试金石。现在，想象一下在宇宙风暴的狂暴核心内体会战斗！让我们向星系展示我们的狂野。\n\n当前挑战是在风暴中击败一支敌方舰队。
entries.en: The heat of battle has always been a proving ground. Now imagine experiencing it from within the raging heart of a cosmic storm! Let's show the galaxy just how wild we really are.\n\nThe challenge now is to defeat an enemy fleet in a storm.
Explore the Edge of the Galaxy

entries.zh: 超越我们的边界，徘徊在群星边缘，探索太空最遥远的深处——还有什么比这更令人振奋吗？\n\n我们需要派遣一艘科研船前往指定的恒星系——不择手段。
entries.en: To go beyond our own borders, to balance on the edge of the stars, to seek the furthest reaches of space - is there anything more invigorating?\n\nWe'll need to send a Science Ship to the designated system - any way we can.

entries.zh: 最优秀的人才渴望风暴的刺激。让他们在风暴中驰骋、绽放吧！\n\n我们的下一项挑战是帮助一位风暴骑士在宇宙风暴中坚持超过180天。
entries.en: The best of the best yearn for the thrill of the storm. Let them cruise and thrive!\n\nOur next challenge is to help a Storm Rider weather a cosmic storm for more than 180 days.
Days Rider Spent in a Storm

entries.zh: 星系中充满埋藏的宝藏与古老的秘密——还有一股邪恶的风将星系搅动！让我们出发吧，去看看能找到什么。\n\n挑战自己，去调查一处被风暴揭示的异常现象或考古遗址吧。
entries.en: A galaxy full of buried treasure and ancient secrets - and a wicked wind to stir them up! Let's get out there and see what we can find.\n\nLet's challenge ourselves to investigate an anomaly or archaeology site revealed by a storm.

entries.zh: 调查异常现象或发掘遗址。
为什么要独享乐趣呢？就冒险而言，分享多多益善。\n\n为了让我们的邻国也感受到刺激，当前挑战是让一场宇宙风暴偏转到他们的领土。
entries.en: Why should we have all the fun? When it comes to adventure, it's always better to share.\n\nTo help our neighbors feel included, the challenge now is to cause a cosmic storm to veer into their space.

entries.zh: 向其他帝国发送的风暴
老去然后淡出，这不是我们的风格。耀眼地燃烧殆尽远胜于此。\n\n下一个挑战是帮助风暴骑士在宇宙风暴体验最终时刻。
entries.en: It is not in our style to grow old and fade away. Far better to burn out in a blaze of glory!\n\nThe next challenge is to help a Storm Rider experience their final moments inside a cosmic storm.

entries.zh: 风暴骑士在风暴中牺牲或失踪
entries.en: Storm Riders Killed or MIA in Storms

entries.zh: 我们到达了新高度、检验了新极限！这正是那种让人心潮澎湃的事情，我们完成了挑战！
entries.en: New heights were reached and limits have been shredded! Just the thing to get the emotions firing. We have completed the trial!

entries.zh: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\n那支舰队连一战的机会都没有。还有谁？
entries.en: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\nThat fleet never had any fighting chance. Who dares challenge us next?

entries.zh: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\n这个星系可以给我们这么多！永远不会无聊，永远也不用停步。继续下一个挑战！
entries.en: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\nThe galaxy has so much to offer! There's never a dull moment, and there's no sense stopping now. Onward to the next challenge!

entries.zh: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\n我们的风暴骑士发回的报告中只有喜悦的欢呼声。宇宙风暴是一种全新档次的刺激！
entries.en: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\nOur Storm Rider reported back with nothing but exultant cheers. The cosmic storms are a whole new level of thrill!

entries.zh: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\n我们感觉充满了喜悦。宇宙风暴带来了全新档次的刺激。
entries.en: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\nWe feel filled with exultation. The cosmic storms bring excitement to a whole new level.

entries.zh: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\n钻研远古的秘密、发掘埋藏的宝藏总是这么令人兴奋。谁知道外面的世界还有什么等着我们去发现呢?
entries.en: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\nDelving into ancient secrets and unearthing buried treasure is always a thrill. Who knows what's still out there, just waiting to be found?

entries.zh:
$challenge_completed_intro$

这场风暴径直穿过了他们的空间，在同等程度上传播了兴奋和混沌！为邻居们提供了如此令人难以置信的体验，这下我们可以放心了。

他们现在可能不感激，但最终会感谢我们的。
entries.en:
$challenge_completed_intro$

That storm tore right through their space, spreading thrills and disarray in equal measure! We can rest easy knowing we provided our neighbors with such an incredible experience

They may not appreciate it now, but they'll thank us eventually.

entries.zh: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\n强大的风暴呼唤他的名字，他也欣喜地回应。致敬风暴骑士，你是绝对的传奇！愿你通往彼岸的旅程如同你的退场一样壮丽。
entries.en: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\nThe great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend! May your journey to the great beyond be as epic as your exit.

entries.zh: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\n强大的风暴呼唤我们的一部分加入它的欢腾肆虐。从未有过对失去节点感觉如此有意义和充满活力！这一史诗般的经历将在未来许多年里定义我们是谁。
entries.en: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\nThe great storm has called a part of ourself to join it in jubilant carnage. Losing a node has never felt so meaningful and invigorating! This epic experience will define our species for many years to come.

entries.zh: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\n大风暴呼唤着他，他也欢欣鼓舞地回应着。向风暴骑士致敬，您绝对是个传奇!
entries.en: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\nThe great storm called their name and they answered with jubilation. Hail Storm Rider, you absolute legend!

entries.zh: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\n大风暴召唤了我们的一部分加入它的欢腾屠杀。从来没有一次近乎失去一个节点的感觉是如此地有意义，令我们充满活力！这一史诗般的经历将在未来的日子里告诉我们自己是谁。
entries.en: $challenge_completed_intro$\n\nThe great storm has called a part of ourself to join it in jubilant carnage. Nearly losing a node has never felt so meaningful and invigorating! This epic experience will define our species for many years to come.

entries.zh: 电磁场的碰撞使这场宇宙风暴充满了接近危险水平的电荷。它对护盾有害，但可以提升行星产出。
entries.en: The collision of electromagnetic fields imbues this cosmic storm with near a dangerous level of electric charge. Hazardous for shields, but beneficial for planetary production.

entries.zh: 这种风暴看起来就像活物一般，通过星系织构的内部移动，它们既不猎杀也不躲避太空舰船。它们既危险又不稳定，这种存在足以跨越各种要素凝聚起一个文明。
entries.en: These storms almost seem alive, moving through and within the galactic fabric, neither hunting nor avoiding spaceborne vessels. Dangerous and unstable, their mere presence is enough to unite a civilization in defiance of the elements.

entries.zh: 每当发生大型天体碰撞，造成的影响将向整个星系散播引力涟漪。在涟漪相撞的地方，引力风暴就会诞生。对舰船的火控系统会造成负面影响，而且波动的重力场迫使大多数人口闭门不出。
entries.en: When massive stellar bodies collide, the resulting impact sends gravitational ripples throughout the galaxy. When these in turn collapse, a gravity storm is born. Negative effects on ship targeting systems, and the fluctuating gravity makes almost everyone forced to stay at home.

entries.zh: 当游荡的金属小行星带与强大的引力相互作用时，其内部就会形成磁场。这种类型的风暴会撕裂船体、导致工业建造中断，但它们也有助于从地壳中带出有价值的矿物质。
entries.en: When roving metallic asteroid belts interact with strong gravitational forces, magnetic fields are formed within. Storms of this type rip hulls apart and cause interruptions to industrial construction - yet they also assist in bringing up valuable minerals from a planet's crust.

entries.zh: $solar_storm$会在空间织构中创造出一种耀眼的波动。它的存在导致恒星产生前所未有的耀斑。由此产生的辐射极具破坏性，但可以超载空间站产出并让舰船难以隐形。
entries.en: A $solar_storm$ creates a glistening fluctuation within the spatial fabric. Its presence causes stars to produce unprecedented flares. The resultant radiation is extremely damaging, but supercharges space station output and makes it hard for ships to stay hidden.

entries.zh: 每时每刻，来自数百万行星的尘埃都在星系中漫无目的地飘荡。有时，这些颗粒聚集起极大的数量，以至于形成了沙尘暴。虽然这种沙尘暴会干扰整个行星的通信，但其带来的化学物质也对资源产出有益。但这些潜藏在风暴中的物体对我们的扫描仪而言却往往难以捕捉。
entries.en: At any given moment, dust from millions of planets is drifting aimlessly through the galaxy. Sometimes these granules gather in such significant quantities that a dust storm results. Disturbs planet-wide communication, but the chemical elements it brings are useful for resource production. Objects inside these tempests may as well not exist as far as our scanners are concerned.

entries.zh: 在极罕见的情况下，虚境会向现实世界低语。这种稀有的风暴会让人们看到崇高而又怪诞的景象。那些与虚境交流的人甚至可以享受到变幻莫测的协同作用。
entries.en: On rare occasions, the Shroud may whisper through the physical world. These rare storms expose sentients to visions both sublime and grotesque. Those who have communed with the Shroud can even enjoy a fickle synergy.

entries.zh: 当数颗恒星直列时，即使是很小的宇宙风暴也会成长得超出常规限制。这种罕见的事件将引发世界末日般的恐怖威胁。在这可憎之物里面没有人能够侥幸获益；光是幸存下去就已经谢天谢地了。
entries.en: When the stars align, even a minor cosmic storm can grow beyond conventional limits. This rare event will unleash terror of apocalyptic proportions. There is no thriving inside this abomination; the only option is to survive.

entries.zh: 这颗行星的土地含有从地壳自然形成的矿物中重吸收的高浓度氮、磷元素。这让植物以极夸张的速度生长，对农业有帮助但会妨碍建筑工程。
entries.en: This planet's soil contains uniquely high concentrations of nitrogen and phosphorus, reabsorbed from naturally formed minerals in the crust. This results in extraordinarily rapid plant growth; great for farming, but hampering any building projects.

entries.zh: 这个星球上的野生动物和植物生长缺乏许多天敌，生得异常温顺，因此与它们一起生活很愉快。种群数量主要受到风暴破坏的制约，而不是适者生存。
entries.en: This planet's wildlife and plant growth lacks many natural predators, making them unusually docile, and thus pleasant to live with. The population is checked by storm damage rather than survival of the fittest.

entries.zh: 构造活动使岩浆湖冷却成巨大的黑曜岩，将宝贵的资源带到离地表更近的地方。
entries.en: Tectonic activity has caused magma lakes to cool into enormous sheets of obsidian, bringing valuable resources much closer to the surface.

entries.zh: 这颗行星的表面是一片由万亿的红色小昆虫组成的深红色的地毯。尽管它们的数量惊人，但它们似乎是无害的，而且它们成功地在行星的生态系统内建立了一种脆弱的平衡。
entries.en: The planet's surface is a carpet of crimson due to the presence of trillions of tiny red insects. Despite their incredible numbers, they appear harmless, and have managed to establish a tenuous balance within the planet's ecosystem.

entries.zh: 这颗行星完全被天然的金属所覆盖。它缺乏基本的生活必需品，如水或可呼吸的大气，但确实含有大量可用的资源！
entries.en: This planet is entirely covered in crude, naturally occurring metals. It lacks basic life necessities such as water or a breathable atmosphere, but does contain a lot of usable resources!

entries.zh: 这颗行星存在金属外壳，因此不能被改造。
entries.en: This planet cannot be terraformed due to its metallic crust.

entries.zh: 以前环境改造过的行星
这是一颗有氮氧大气和大量海洋的岩质星球。有证据表明，更古老的帝国曾经到达并殖民过这个行星，但它们后来消失了。这意味着这里有很多尚待发现与未知的东西，但也让这个行星成为一个预先准备好的殖民地候选者!
entries.en: A rocky world with a nitrogen-oxygen atmosphere and plenty of oceans. There is evidence of older empires having reached and colonized this planet before, but they have since disappeared. This means there is a lot to discover and uncover, but also leaves the planet a pre-made candidate for a colony!

entries.zh: 之前的环境改造尝试使得这颗行星更容易改造成为盖亚星球。
entries.en: Previous terraforming attempts make turning this planet into a Gaia world much easier.

entries.zh: 这颗星球曾是阿达卡利亚公约的基础。这座$building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$就是这一度强盛帝国的唯一残迹。
entries.en: This planet was once the foundation of the adAkkaria Convention. The $building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$ is all that is left of this once mighty civilization.

entries.zh: 拥有建筑：$building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$。殖民该行星以获取控制权。
entries.en: Has building: $building_adakkaria_patriotic_institute$. Colonize this planet to gain ownership.

entries.zh: 每年在该星系中以§Y100§!£pop£§H人口§!为代价触发风暴的概率。
entries.en: Chance every year a Storm is triggered in the system at the cost of §Y100§! £pop£ §HPops§!.

entries.zh: 这颗行星的表面是由数万亿的小红色昆虫组成的深红色的阴影。即使直接生吃，它们也是一种美味的食物。
entries.en: The planet's surface is a deep shade of crimson due to the presence of trillions of tiny red insects. Even when consumed raw, they are a delectable source of food.

entries.zh: 这颗行星的表面是由数万亿的小红色昆虫组成的深红色的阴影。它们是一种人们喜闻乐见的烧烤食物。
entries.en: The planet's surface is a deep shade of crimson due to the presence of trillions of tiny red insects. They have become a joy for the population to grill and consume.

entries.zh: §R这个行星不能被机器帝国或噬岩者帝国殖民。§!
entries.en: §RThis planet cannot be colonized by Machine or Terravore empires.§!

entries.zh: 两颗行星撞到了一起，它们没有互相毁灭，反倒是纠缠在了一起。在增加可用面积的同时，这颗星球也带来了独特的居住和建筑挑战。
entries.en: Two planets crashed into one, and rather than destroying each other, they have become entangled. While boasting increased usable surface area, the world poses unique habitation and building challenges.

entries.zh: 几千年来，这颗行星的地壳已经变成了一层厚厚的树根，厚达几公里，使它成为一个巨大的生命有机体。
entries.en: Over thousands of years, this planet's crust has become a dense layer of roots several kilometers thick, making it one titanic living organism.

entries.zh: 建造和维护住房需要花费$w_food$。\n建造农场需要花费$w_food$。
entries.en: Housing costs $w_food$ to build and upkeep.\nFarms cost $w_food$ to build.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的构造变动导致一个巨大板块上的黑曜岩薄层破碎。熔岩倾泻而出遍布地表，造成了毁灭性的影响。从殖民地发回的报告相当可怕。
entries.en: Tectonic events on [Root.GetName] have caused the Obsidian sheets on one of the giant plates to shatter. Lava pours across the surface to ruinous effect. Reports from the colony are dire.

entries.zh: 最近那场震动了我们在[Root.GetName]上殖民地的黑曜岩原野爆发已经演化成了一座活火山！附近的一切都已经被埋葬在熔岩之下。
entries.en: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] has turned into an active volcano! Anything that once existed there is now buried under molten rock.

entries.zh: 最近那场震动了我们在[Root.GetName]上殖民地的黑曜岩原野爆发奇迹般地没有造成损伤。更幸运的是，它击碎了大量的黑曜石，方便了我们采集。
entries.en: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] miraculously caused no damage. In a fortunate twist, it has also shattered the Obsidian for easy gathering!

entries.zh: 最近那场震动了我们在[Root.GetName]上殖民地的黑曜岩原野爆发奇迹般地没有造成损伤。
entries.en: The recent eruption on the Obsidian Fields that shook our colony on [Root.GetName] miraculously caused no damage!

entries.zh: —取决于风暴的强度，殖民地将会被持续施加持续3年的以下修正：
entries.en: - Depending on the storm's intensity, colonies will have the following modifier applied for 3 Years:

entries.zh: $electric_storm$在大气层中残留下涌动的电力，这会让机械产出变得不稳定。然而，能量产出已经爆表了！
entries.en: The $electric_storm$ left surging electricity in the atmosphere, causing unreliable output from machinery. However, energy production is off the charts!

entries.zh: $particle_storm$可以将一切磨为齑粉，无论是金属还是有机生命，这会造成严重的损伤并影响食物产出。然而，残余物包含着极具价值的物质。
entries.en: $particle_storm$ grind down everything from metal to organic life, causing great damage to our mineral output. However, the residue contains valuable substances.

entries.zh: $gravity_storm$引发的重力水平的波动使建筑工程变得困难，但它们确实为引力研究提供了独特的科学洞见。
entries.en: While fluctuating gravity levels from the $gravity_storm$ have made building difficult, they do provide unique insights into gravity and space-time.

entries.zh: $magnetic_storm$残留的磁场波动导致了许多大气光学现象。尽管景观美轮美奂，但这对导航设备而言是一场灾难。
entries.en: The magnetic disturbances left by the $magnetic_storm$ cause a brilliant display of atmospheric lights. Remnant magnetic fields also impact the speed of planetary construction projects.

entries.zh: $solar_storm$造成的高水平辐射使得我们不得不进行几乎无限期的封控。由于所有人的生活空间都受到了限制，犯罪反倒是受到了打击。
entries.en: High levels of radiation caused by the $solar_storm$ necessitate near permanent lockdown. Given the heavily controlled living spaces, armed control of the planet has become significantly easier at a cost of a despondent population.

entries.zh: 虽然由稀有矿物组成，但$celestial_storm$带来星际尘埃的无情冲击一直渗透到了矿山的最深处，阻碍了生产。
entries.en: Although composed of rare materials, the relentless onslaught of interstellar dust from the $celestial_storm$ has seeped all the way down into the soil, impeding production.

entries.zh: 最近的$shroud_storm$引发了关于奇怪的目击和事件的报道。在余波之中，有些人得到了启示，另一些人则陷入了疯狂。
entries.en: The recent $shroud_storm$ has precipitated reports of strange sightings and occurrences. In the aftermath, some have found enlightenment, others madness.

entries.zh: $nexus_storm$极具破坏力的性质导致也难以预测究竟会产生何种类型的破坏。
entries.en: The extremely destructive nature of a $nexus_storm$ makes it impossible to predict what type of devastation they will leave behind.

entries.zh: 该装置即使处于关闭状态，其中蕴含的能量也是显而易见的。如果我们真有勇气使用它，就可以获得驾驭风暴的力量。\n\n选择一个位置产生一场$nexus_storm_color_tooltip$。
entries.en: The waiting potential of this device is tangible even in a powered-down state. Should we have the courage to use it, we would harness the power of the storms themselves.\n\nSelect a location to spawn a $nexus_storm_color_tooltip$.

entries.zh: 我们可以根据自身利益来§S操控§!某个§Y$default_storm$§!的§S移动路线§!。可以将风暴§S驱斥§!远离我方恒星系，或是§S吸引§!风暴进而利用其正面效果。
entries.en: We can §Smanipulate§! the §Spath§! of a §Y$default_storm$§! for our own benefit. Either to §Sdeflect§! them away from our systems, or §Sattract§! them to utilize their positive effects.

entries.zh:
该地图可视化地展现了星系中所有的§S宇宙风暴§!，以及关于其产生的效果的信息。

£storm_forecast_map£

单击右下角的地图图标即可进入天气预报地图模式。

随着科技的提升，该模式将不仅能展示§S$default_storm$§!的位置和方向，还能以越来越高的准确度进行预测，此外还能显示预期的风暴类型。
entries.en:
This map mode visualizes any §SCosmic Storms§! in the galaxy, with information on their effects.

£storm_forecast_map£

To access the weather forecast map mode, click the map icon in the bottom right.

With advanced technology, it can be upgraded to give increasingly accurate predictions not only of the location and direction of a §S$default_storm$§!, but also what type of storm to expect.

entries.zh: §S宇宙风暴§!是一股强大的自然力量，能够对我方一些舰船，经济，甚至是人口带来毁灭性影响。然而，宇宙风暴也会带来一些不错的机遇。\n\n研究§S风暴科技§!能够解锁一些显著§S降低§!风暴负面§S影响§!的建筑与技术。§S进一步的研究§!甚至能够让我们§S开发利用§!风暴。
entries.en: §SCosmic Storms§! are a formidable force of nature. They can have devastating effects on our fleets, economy, and even our population. However, they can also provide great opportunities.\n\nResearching §SStorm Technology§! provides us with buildings and tech to greatly §Sreduce§! the negative §Seffects§! of a storm. With §Sadditional research§! should even be able to take §Sadvantage§! of the storms.

entries.zh: 扫描仪探测到一场$TYPE|Y$型宇宙风暴正逼近我方边境。我们现已将其命名为$NAME|Y$。\n\n
entries.en: Our scanners have picked up a cosmic storm of the $TYPE|Y$ type. We have named it $NAME|Y$.\n\n

entries.zh: 这类风暴会对所有殖民地造成破坏，并妨碍我们的舰队进行紧急超光速。强烈建议采取预防性措施。\n\n
entries.en: This storm will cause devastating effects to colonies and hamper our fleets' access to emergency FTL. Taking preemptive measures is strongly advised.\n\n

entries.zh: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$风暴所携带的极端电荷会对我们舰队的护盾造成伤害。但由于风暴中所蕴含的丰沛能量，我们预期殖民地的产出和舰船速度会有显著提升。
entries.en: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$The extreme electrical charges carried by the storm will present a danger to our fleets' shield systems. However, we are expecting a significant increase in colony production and ship speed due to the abundant energy present in the storm.

entries.zh: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$这场风暴中的辐射将会使陷入其中的舰队无法对能扫描风暴者隐蔽身形。尽管这会带来一些安全问题，但我们的空间站在这种条件下工作效率大幅提高了。
entries.en: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$The radiation from this storm will make fleets caught inside visible to anyone who has the storm on their scanners. While this presents some security risks, our stations will operate much more efficiently under these conditions.

entries.zh: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$这类风暴会阻碍我们的传感器，让我们无法探测这些星系内的其他舰队，并且拖慢太空旅行。与这些风险相对，我们也应该能积极利用这些条件，在风暴过境的过程中提升特定岗位的产出。
entries.en: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$This type of storm will jam our sensors, making us unable to detect other fleets within these systems and slow down space travel. Despite these risks, we should be able to use these conditions to our advantage and increase the output of certain jobs throughout the duration of the storm.

entries.zh: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$此类风暴对我们的殖民地、舰队和空间站有极高的危险。当风暴过境时，它们会受到严重的损害。
entries.en: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$This type of storm poses an extreme risk to our colonies, fleets, and stations. They will be taking heavy damage until it passes.

entries.zh: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$该风暴中高浓度的灵能能量将会显著降低我们殖民地的稳定度，但会有助于舰队闪避的效率。
entries.en: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$The heavy concentration of psionic energy in this storm will significantly reduce stability in our colonies, but aid in the effectiveness of fleet evasion.

entries.zh: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$该风暴中高浓度的灵能能量将会显著降低我们殖民地的稳定度，但我们关于在虚境中导航的知识会提高我们舰队和心灵感应的效率。\n\n虚境正在搅动着……我们必须做好一切准备。
entries.en: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$The heavy concentration of psionic energy in this storm will significantly reduce stability in our colonies, but our knowledge in navigating the Shroud will aid us in the effectiveness of our fleets and Telepaths.\n\nThe Shroud stirs... We must be prepared for anything.

entries.zh: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$该风暴强大的重力影响会对我们的舰队行动造成越来越大的困难，舰船尺寸越大面临的风险也越高。\n\n尽管存在这些问题，我们的殖民地则可以积极利用该极端环境，提升我们特定任务的效率。
entries.en: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$The heavy gravitational influences of this storm will inflict progressive difficulty to fleet operations, with our larger ships at the highest risk.\n\nDespite these issues, our colonies will be able to use this extreme environment to our advantage, enhancing the effectiveness of certain tasks.

entries.zh: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$该风暴极端的磁场会让我们的舰队和建筑的维护系统疲于奔命。\n\n风暴的磁力与我们先进的冶金技术产生了意想不到的协同作用，这应该会在整场星系事件的过程中降低与我们冶金师有关的花费。
entries.en: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$The extreme magnetic forces of this storm will place our fleet and structural maintenance systems in disarray.\n\nThe storm's magnetic forces have created an unexpected synergy with our advanced metallurgical techniques. This interaction should reduce the costs associated with our Metallurgists throughout the duration of this galactic event.

entries.zh: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$这场风暴中高密度的微粒碎片的将对舰船和空间站造成毁灭性的影响，使它们的护盾完全失效。敢于在风暴内逗留的舰队应该做好应对高危环境的准备。
entries.en: $MESSAGE_COSMIC_STORM_SPOTTED_DESC$$MESSAGE_STORM_INTRO$The density of the particulate debris in this storm will inflict devastating effects on ships and stations, negating their shield regeneration entirely. Those fleets brave enough to remain inside should prepare for a highly dangerous environment.

entries.zh: §Y$electric_storm$§!影响了建造速度，但会提升能量产出。
entries.en: The §Y$electric_storm$§! has impacted construction speeds, but will boost energy production.

entries.zh: §Y$particle_storm$§!在整颗星球上留下了侵蚀性粒子。
entries.en: The §Y$particle_storm$§! has left corrosive particulate across the planet.

entries.zh: §Y$gravity_storm$§!过境，在我们的一个殖民地留下了遍地的重力异常。
entries.en: A §Y$gravity_storm$§! has passed, leaving behind gravitational anomalies on one of our colonies.

entries.zh: §Y$magnetic_storm$§!过境，我们的一个殖民地汇报在两极地区发生了电磁场扰动。
entries.en: A §Y$magnetic_storm$§! has passed. Our colony reports electromagnetic disturbances in the polar regions.

entries.zh: §Y$solar_storm$§!在整颗行星上留下了高危水平的辐射污染。
entries.en: The §Y$solar_storm$§! has left dangerous levels of radioactive contamination across the planet.

entries.zh: §Y$celestial_storm$§!让整颗行星被宇宙尘埃的雾霾覆盖。
entries.en: The §Y$celestial_storm$§! has left the planet coated in a thick fog of cosmic dust.

entries.zh: §Y$shroud_storm$§!导致了全球范围内超自然现象的活跃。
entries.en: A §Y$shroud_storm$§! has caused a rise in paranormal activity across the planet.

entries.zh: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_EARLY_GAME_SPAWN_CHANCE_SCALE$§!\n该数值决定§Y宇宙风暴§!在游戏前期生成概率的倍率$requires_cosmic_storms$
entries.en: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_EARLY_GAME_SPAWN_CHANCE_SCALE$§!\nThis multiplies the spawn chance of §YCosmic Storms§! during early-game $requires_cosmic_storms$

entries.zh: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_MID_GAME_SPAWN_CHANCE_SCALE$§!\n该数值决定§Y宇宙风暴§!在游戏中期生成概率的倍率$requires_cosmic_storms$
entries.en: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_MID_GAME_SPAWN_CHANCE_SCALE$§!\nThis multiplies the spawn chance of §YCosmic Storms§! during mid-game $requires_cosmic_storms$

entries.zh: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_LATE_GAME_SPAWN_CHANCE_SCALE$§!\n该数值决定§Y宇宙风暴§!在游戏末期生成概率的倍率$requires_cosmic_storms$
entries.en: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_LATE_GAME_SPAWN_CHANCE_SCALE$§!\nThis multiplies the spawn chance of §YCosmic Storms§! during end-game $requires_cosmic_storms$

entries.zh: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_EARLY_GAME_SPAWN_MAX_CAP$§!\n该数值决定在游戏前期可生成§Y宇宙风暴§!的最大数量$requires_cosmic_storms$
entries.en: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_EARLY_GAME_SPAWN_MAX_CAP$§!\nThis sets the maximum amount of §YCosmic Storms§! that can spawn during early-game $requires_cosmic_storms$

entries.zh: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_MID_GAME_SPAWN_MAX_CAP$§!\n该数值决定在游戏中期可生成§Y宇宙风暴§!的最大数量$requires_cosmic_storms$
entries.en: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_MID_GAME_SPAWN_MAX_CAP$§!\nThis sets the maximum amount of §YCosmic Storms§! that can spawn during mid-game $requires_cosmic_storms$

entries.zh: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_LATE_GAME_SPAWN_MAX_CAP$§!\n该数值决定在游戏末期可生成§Y宇宙风暴§!的最大数量$requires_cosmic_storms$
entries.en: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_LATE_GAME_SPAWN_MAX_CAP$§!\nThis sets the maximum amount of §YCosmic Storms§! during end-game $requires_cosmic_storms$

entries.zh: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_SPAWN_COOLDOWN_SCALE$§!\n该数值决定§Y宇宙风暴§!生成冷却时间的乘数$requires_cosmic_storms$
entries.en: §H$FE_COSMIC_STORM_SPAWN_COOLDOWN_SCALE$§!\nThis multiplies the spawn cooldown of §YCosmic Storms§! $requires_cosmic_storms$

entries.zh: 地幔深处的电磁活动使得磁性采矿成为可能，但同时也破坏了技术设施。
entries.en: Electromagnetic activity in the deep mantle makes magnetic mining viable while also disrupting technical infrastructure.

entries.zh: 据报道，在最近的§Y$magnetic_storm$§!之后，[this.GetName]出现了不寻常的后遗症。风暴的强大能量场增加了行星熔融核心的磁场波动，导致科技基础设施普遍失灵。\n\n然而，这种情况也提供了一个绝无仅有的资源开采机会。地幔下富含金属的熔岩流被带上了电荷，可以在采矿磁铁的帮助下收获。
entries.en: Unusual after effects are being reported on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent §Y$magnetic_storm$§!. The storm's potent energy fields increased magnetic volatility in the planet's molten core, resulting in the widespread failure of technological infrastructure.\n\nHowever, the situation also presents a unique resource extraction opportunity. Metal-rich lava flows underneath the planet's mantle are now electromagnetically charged and can be harvested with the aid of mining magnets.

entries.zh: 一股永恒的电流在行星浩瀚的海洋中涌动。
entries.en: A perpetual electrical current surges throughout the planet's vast ocean.

entries.zh: 在最近的§Y$electric_storm$§!后，[this.GetName]上观察到了一种异常现象。该行星的[GetOceansState]现已充斥着永久性的电流，电流在广阔的水体中循环，对水生生物构成致命威胁。
entries.en: An unusual phenomenon has been observed on [this.GetName] in the wake of the recent §Y$electric_storm$§!. The planet's [GetOceansState] have been left charged with a perpetual electrical current now circulating in this vast body of water, posing lethal risks for aquatic life.

entries.zh: 这对我们殖民地的生存前景构成严重威胁，必须立即加以解决。
entries.en: This represents a serious threat for our colony's survival prospects and must be addressed immediately.

entries.zh: 这种现象对我们没有造成直接的伤害，但对我们殖民地的未来发展产生了挑战。
entries.en: This phenomenon is causing us no direct harm but poses challenges to our colony's future development.

entries.zh: 参观这个峡谷的人目睹了空灵的幽灵。
entries.en: Ethereal apparitions are witnessed by those who visit this canyon.

entries.zh: 在最近[this.solar_system.GetName]的§Y$shroud_storm$§!事件后，[owner.GetColonistPlural]报告称在某个孤立的峡谷中发现了难以解释的神秘现象。幽灵般的蓝色身影短暂出现，似乎无法或不愿与我们的[owner.GetColonistPlural]互动，只是漫无目的地徘徊，随后消失。
entries.en: Following the recent §Y$shroud_storm$§! in [this.solar_system.GetName], [owner.GetColonistPlural] report inexplicable sightings of ethereal apparitions in an isolated canyon. These ghostly blue figures appear briefly, unable or unwilling to interact with our [owner.GetColonistPlural], wandering aimlessly before dissipating.

entries.zh: 虽然这些幽灵在本质上似乎是灵能体，但我们仍无法与这些实体建立任何数量的精神交流。然而，我们发现他们的存在是对我们心灵感应能力的被动强化。
entries.en: While the apparitions appear to be psionic in nature, we have not been able to establish any amount of mental communication with these entities. However, we have found their presence to be a passive reinforcement to our own telepathic abilities.

entries.zh: 虽然这些幽灵在本质上似乎是灵能体，但我们仍无法与他们建立任何灵能交流。然而，系统检查倒是能确认他们的出现给我们的心灵感应能力带来了积极的帮助。
entries.en: While the apparitions appear to be psionic in nature, we have not been able to establish any psionic communication with these entities. However, system checks have confirmed that their presence provides passive reinforcement to our own telepathic abilities.

entries.zh: 这一非凡现象提醒我们，我们的生存中有着无形的奇迹。
entries.en: This remarkable phenomenon is providing a welcome reminder of the intangible wonders of our existence.

entries.zh: 截止目前为止，没有进一步的人身伤害或损害的报告。
entries.en: No physical harm or aggressive behavior has thus far been reported.

entries.zh: 截止目前为止，没有人身伤害或损害的报告。尽管如此，这种奇怪的现象还是令人不安地分散了人们的注意力。
entries.en: No physical harm or damage has thus far been reported. Nonetheless, the strange phenomenon is proving to be an unsettling distraction.

entries.zh: 用泥土填满峡谷。死者将被埋葬。
entries.en: Fill the canyon with earth. The dead will stay buried.

entries.zh:
最近的§H[this.GetAffectedStormType]§!残留的辐射导致§Y[this.GetName]§!上的地质活动变得异常。

尤其值得注意的是，风暴的影响使得一座活火山不再活跃，将其与地质学上的热点隔离，切断了岩浆供应。

由于冷却的岩浆开拓了新的土地，进一步开发这颗行星的新机遇因这些变化而呈现于我们面前。
entries.en:
The residual radiation from the recent §Y[this.GetAffectedStormType]§! has led to erratic geological activity across §H[this.GetName]§!.

Most notably, the impact of the storm has rendered an active volcano extinct, cutting it off from its geological hotspot and severing the supply of magma.

These changes present us with new opportunities to develop the planet further, as the cooling magma opens up new lands.

entries.zh: 一座巨大的山脉悬挂在行星上层大气的稀薄空气中，暴露出崭新的矿藏。
entries.en: A colossal mountain range hangs suspended in the thin air of the planet's upper atmosphere, exposing fresh ore deposits.

entries.zh: 一场严重的§Y$gravity_storm$§!导致了§H[this.GetName]§!的地景发生了剧变。这场风暴强劲的重力波动将行星最高的山脉从构造架上剥离，径直提到了星球的上方。\n\n它现在仍然悬浮在上层大气中，由风暴的残余引力作用保持在高空。这一剧变使得地下基岩中以前无法开采的矿物贮藏暴露了出来，也为[owner.GetResearchers]提供了很多可以分析的资料。
entries.en: A severe §Y$gravity_storm$§! caused an extraordinary transformation of §H[this.GetName]§!'s landscape. The storm's powerful gravitational fluctuations severed the planet's largest mountain range from its tectonic shelf, lifting it vertically above the planet.\n\nIt remains suspended in the upper atmosphere, held aloft by a residual gravitational effect of the storm. This remarkable upheaval has exposed previously inaccessible ore reserves in the bedrock underneath, as well as providing [owner.GetResearchers] with much to analyze.

entries.zh: 近期的§Y[this.GetAffectedStormType]§!对[this.GetName]的气候产生了意想不到的影响。
entries.en: The recent §Y[this.GetAffectedStormType]§! has had an unexpected impact on the climate of [this.GetName].

entries.zh: 大气中积聚的电荷导致了两极地区的剧烈温度变化。$cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$
entries.en: The increased electrical charge in the atmosphere has led to a drastic temperature shift in the polar region, $cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: 大气中积聚的电荷导致了两极地区的剧烈温度变化。$cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$
entries.en: The corrosive effect of the storm's particles has heavily impacted the polar regions, $cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: 风暴带来的重力变化将许多水下冰层撕裂，$cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$
entries.en: The gravitational shifts brought on by the storm have shattered multiple layers of subaquatic ice, $cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: 产生的行星磁场扰动导致了剧烈的地震运动，$cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$
entries.en: The resulting disturbances in the planets magnetic fields have led to drastic seismic shifts, $cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: 风暴的极端热量在其持续期间内提升了整颗行星的温度，$cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$
entries.en: The extreme heat of the storm raised the temperatures across the planet throughout its duration, $cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: 高浓度超热星尘严重地影响了两极地区，$cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$
entries.en: Large concentrations of superheated celestial dust have heavily impacted the polar regions, $cstorms.1755.desc.common_2$

entries.zh: 让以前无法到达的冻土带发生了解冻。\n\n现在我们可以开发这片新发现的土地了。
entries.en: causing previously inaccessible frozen tundra to thaw.\n\nWe can now develop this newly-uncovered land.

entries.zh: 我们在§H[this.GetName]§!的[Owner.GetEngineerPlural]汇报§Y$celestial_storm$§!它对水过滤系统有不利影响。随着颗粒在星球地下水中沉淀，形成的矿浆堵塞了关键的基础设施。
entries.en: Our [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] on §H[this.GetName]§! report that the §Y$celestial_storm$§! is having adverse effects on water filtration systems. As the particles settle in the planet's groundwater, the resulting mineral slurry is clogging key infrastructure points.

entries.zh: 由此导致的水培故障严重影响了星球上的农业，也导致了安全饮用水的短缺。\n\n这个问题如果不加以处理，可能会对我们的供水造成长期的影响。幸运的是，我们的[owner.GetEngineerPlural]有信心他们可以创造更强大的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
entries.en: The resulting hydroponic failures are heavily impacting the planet's agriculture, as well as leading to shortages in safe drinkable water.\n\nThis problem could have long-lasting consequences on our water supply if not dealt with. Fortunately, our [owner.GetEngineerPlural] are confident they can create more robust filtration systems to address the issue.

entries.zh: 在研究水培堵塞的过程中，我们的[Owner.GetColonistPlural]发现，矿化的浆液本身对石质生理学人口实际上既美味又有营养。在对殖民地的过滤系统进行了一些小调整之后，它们大量生产了一种新的季节性饮料，可以供应到风暴结束。
entries.en: While investigating the hydroponic blockages, our [Owner.GetColonistPlural] discovered that the mineralized slurry itself is actually both delicious and nutritious when consumed by those with lithoid physiology. After making a few minor adjustments to the colony's filtration systems they have mass-produced a new seasonal drink with which to wait out the storm.

entries.zh: 当地的水资源被宇宙星尘饱和了，导致水培网络的堵塞。
entries.en: The local water supply is saturated with celestial cosmic dust, causing blockages in the hydroponic network.

entries.zh: §Y$celestial_storm$§!对§H[this.GetName]§!的影响导致了水过滤系统被许多不可溶的矿物泥浆阻塞了。我们必须改建出更强劲的过滤系统来解决这个问题。
entries.en: The impact of a §Y$celestial_storm$§! on §H[this.GetName]§! has left water filtration systems clogged with an insoluble mineral slurry. We must re-engineer a more robust filtration system to address the issue.

entries.zh: [Owner.GetEngineerPlural]解决了§H[this.GetName]§!上的水培阻塞和用水短缺的问题。殖民地的水供应网络得到了升级，现在可以滤去$celestial_storm$所带来的复杂杂质。\n\n这些对用水基础设施的改进还可以用来提升[Owner.GetName]上的灌溉作业。
entries.en: The [Owner.GetEngineerPlural] have dealt with the hydroponic blockages and water shortages on §H[this.GetName]§!. The colony's water supply network has been improved and can now filter out complex impurities such as those introduced by the $celestial_storm$.\n\nThese improvements to our water infrastructure can be repurposed to improve irrigation efforts across the [Owner.GetName].

entries.zh: [this.GetName]上的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]们观察到§Y$gravity_storm$§!对当地野生鸟类带来了严重的影响。\n\n风暴带来的重力波动导致了异常的大气条件，让许多鸟类物种无法飞行。
entries.en: The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] on [this.GetName] have observed harsh repercussions of the §Y$gravity_storm$§! on the local avian wildlife.\n\nThe gravitational fluctuations brought on by the storm are leading to erratic atmospheric conditions, rendering several species of avian fauna incapable of flight.

entries.zh: 这不仅使它们无法正常捕猎，也更容易受到捕食者攻击。\n\n有人担心，如果我们不加以干预，这些受影响的物种可能会被赶尽杀绝。
entries.en: Not only is this preventing the creatures unable to hunt as normal, it is also leaving them vulnerable to predators.\n\nThere is concern that the afflicted species may be hunted to extinction if we do not intervene.

entries.zh: 真正的盛宴等待着我们。
把这些生物放入保护区。
entries.en: Place the creatures in a reserve.

entries.zh: 在事态结束之前保存它们的基因物质。
entries.en: Save their DNA before the end.

entries.zh: 一座隐蔽的自然保护区，为保护脆弱的鸟类而建。
entries.en: A secluded nature reserve built to house vulnerable species of avian fauna.

entries.zh:
紧接着§Y$gravity_storm$§!过境之后，[this.GetName]上暂时无法飞行的在我们的鸟类保护区内避难，又一次翱翔天空。

虽然许多动物现在已经回到了它们以前的栖息地，但仍有相当数量的动物留在保护区，似乎在享受保护区提供的舒适和保护。

这为近距离研究这颗星球上的野生鸟类提供了一个独特的机会。
entries.en:
Following the passing of the §Y$gravity_storm$§!, the temporarily flightless fauna of [this.GetName] have taken to the skies again having taken shelter inside our avian reserve.

While many of the creatures have now returned to their former habitats, significant numbers remain in the reserve, seemingly enjoying the comforts and protections it provides.

This presents a unique opportunity to study the planet's avian wildlife at close proximity.

entries.zh: 扫描发现，在[from.GetName]中的[fromfrom.GetName]的中心出现了不规则现象，表明该构造的中心携带着一个奇怪的物质。这些不寻常的读数值得在风暴消散或离开该恒星系之前进行更深入的调查。
entries.en: Scans detect irregularities in the eye of [fromfrom.GetName] raging in [from.GetName], indicating that the formation is carrying a strange mass at its center. These unusual readings warrant closer investigation, before the storm dissipates or leaves the system.

entries.zh: 扫描位于[this.GetName]中的[fromfrom.GetName]，结果表明其内部漩涡中携带着大量物质。远程传感器无法对这一不寻常现象提供确凿的答案。为了增进我们的认识，需要对风暴中心进行一次实地考察。
entries.en: Scans of [fromfrom.GetName] in [this.GetName] suggest it is carrying a large mass within its inner vortex. Long-range sensors have been unable to provide conclusive answers about this unusual phenomenon. A field expedition into the eye of the storm is required to advance our understanding.

entries.zh: 通过进入[from.GetName]的宇宙风暴眼，[leader.GetName]发现了我们扫描不规则的原因。这场不寻常的风暴是由巨大的中心[from.star.GetEarnedResources]聚集所推动的。\n\n我们的科研船在被猛烈地弹射出去之前收获了可以收集的资源。传感器的数据将帮助我们的工程师在极端风暴条件下提高船只的性能。
entries.en: By navigating into the eye of the cosmic storm in [from.GetName], [leader.GetName] discovered the cause of our scan irregularities. This unusual storm is being fueled by a huge central concentration of [from.star.GetEarnedResources].\n\nOur science ship harvested what resources could be gathered before being violently ejected. The sensor data from their narrow withdrawal will aid our engineers in improving vessel performance under extreme storm conditions.

entries.zh: 不幸的是，这种危险的折磨对[leader.GetName]产生了持久的影响。
entries.en: Unfortunately, this dangerous ordeal has had a lasting impact on [leader.GetName].

entries.zh: 一个神秘的太空舱飘在§H[from.GetName]§!中。它看起来没有任何攻击能力并且对我们的信号毫无反应。\n\n初步扫描显示它受损的外部是用先进的材料和陌生的工程科技建造的。需要进一步分析。
entries.en: A mysterious capsule is adrift in §H[from.GetName]§!. It has no obvious offensive capability and is unresponsive to our signals.\n\nInitial scans show that its damaged exterior is constructed using advanced materials and unfamiliar engineering techniques. Further analysis is needed.

entries.zh: 一个明显受损的神秘胶囊正在飘过§H[this.GetName]§!星系。我们不知道它的起源，也对其功能一无所知。它看起来不具备明显的武器，我们相信对其先进的建造工艺进行分析是一个安全和值得投入的项目。
entries.en: A mysterious and visibly-damaged capsule is drifting through the §H[this.GetName]§! system. We know neither its origin nor function. It possesses no evident weaponry and we believe further analysis of its advanced construction would be a safe and worthwhile venture.

entries.zh:
[this.leader.GetName]相信飘过[solar_system.GetName]星系的神秘太空舱是一种古老的“风暴陷阱”，可能曾是一个更大的防御系统的一部分。

这个设备的进气口密封得很紧，但我们的扫描显示它里面藏有被俘获其中的高度压缩的宇宙风暴能量和物质。

研究如何这个非凡的容器可能会教会我们很多关于抑制风暴的知识，但也有释放其蕴含的所有能量的风险。
entries.en:
[this.leader.GetName] believes that the mysterious capsule drifting through the [solar_system.GetName] system is an ancient "storm trap", which may have once been part of a larger defense grid.

The device's intake port is sealed tightly, but our readings suggest it is holding the compressed energy and matter of a captive cosmic storm inside.

Finding a way to open this remarkable container may teach us a great deal about storm mitigation, although at the risk of releasing whatever forces are currently contained within.

entries.zh: 这里有很多值得学习的东西。
entries.en: There is much to learn here.

entries.zh: 一个古老的“风暴陷阱”在太空中自由漂流，内部携带着压缩的宇宙风暴。打开它将为风暴管理和缓解提供宝贵的洞见，但代价是释放被困在里面的未知力量。
entries.en: An ancient "storm trap" is drifting freely through space, carrying a compressed cosmic storm within. Opening it would provide valuable insights into storm management and mitigation, at the risk of releasing whatever forces are trapped inside.

entries.zh: [leader.GetName]完成了对古老风暴陷阱工作原理的分析，并解开了其输入装置。随着端口打开，§H[from.GetStormType]§!内部的风暴被释放到[solar_system.GetName]星系的虚空中。\n\n对陷阱复杂工程的研究已经对抗风暴材料和结构产生了惊人的洞见，尽管我们仍然不明白这个装置是如何能够完全控制风暴的。这些知识将极大地帮助我们抵御未来的宇宙扰动。
entries.en: [leader.GetName] completed analysis of the ancient storm trap's workings and was able to unlock its intake mechanism. As the ports opened, the §H[from.GetStormType]§! held inside was released into the void of the [solar_system.GetName] system.\n\nStudy of the trap's complex engineering has produced fascinating insights into storm-resistant materials and structures, though we still do not understand how the device is capable of containing storms entirely. This knowledge will greatly aid us in weathering future cosmic disturbances.

entries.zh: [solar_system.GetName]星系中诞生了一场小规模的低等级§Y$default_storm$§!
entries.en: A small, low-level §Y$default_storm$§! spawns in the [solar_system.GetName] system

entries.zh: 减少§G10%§!的§Y宇宙风暴§!负面影响由。
entries.en: Reduces the negative effects of §YCosmic Storms§! by §G10%§!.

entries.zh:
[this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们深表同情！我们目睹了一场大风暴在[this.GetName]肆虐。

听到那里遭到的破坏，我们当然感到非常难过。我们哭了，我们真的哭了！所以，请允许我们帮个忙……这是一笔特别的一次性超级交易！

我们可以提供一些小工具，一流的小工具。是我们能给的最好的！有了这些，当下一次风暴来临时，你就能做好准备了。那么我们成交吧？
entries.en:
Commiserations, [this.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! We chanced to see a big storm wreaking havoc in [this.GetName].

Of course, we were very sad to hear of the damage done there. We cried, indeed we cried! So please, allow us to help... with a special one time super deal!

We can provide gadgets, first class gadgets. Only the best from us! With these, when the next storm comes, you will be ready. So do we have a deal?

entries.zh: 允许科研船操纵恒星系内的一颗恒星来制造一场§Y宇宙风暴§!。
entries.en: Allows Science ships to generate §YCosmic Storms§! by manipulating a system's star.

entries.zh: 我们正操纵§H[target.GetName]§!的恒星风来播种§Y$solar_storm$§!。
entries.en: We are manipulating §H[target.GetName]§!'s stellar winds to seed a §Y$solar_storm$§!.

entries.zh: 我们正在切断围绕在§H[target.GetName]§!周围的电场来播种§Y$electric_storm$§!。
entries.en: We are severing the electron fields surrounding §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §Y$electric_storm$§!.

entries.zh: 我们正在操纵环绕§H[target.GetName]§!的离子来播种§Y$magnetic_storm$§!。
entries.en: We are manipulating the ions surrounding §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §Y$magnetic_storm$§!.

entries.zh: 我们正在扰动围绕§H[target.GetName]§!的分子来播种§Y$particle_storm$§!。
entries.en: We are agitating molecules around §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §Y$particle_storm$§!.

entries.zh: 我们正在破坏§H[target.GetName]§!的重力场来播种§Y$gravity_storm$§!。
entries.en: We are destabilizing the gravity fields of §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §Y$gravity_storm$§!.

entries.zh: 我们正在搅乱围绕§H[target.GetName]§!的天体星尘来播种§Y$celestial_storm$§!。
entries.en: We are scrambling the celestial dust around §H[target.GetName]§! to seed a §Y$celestial_storm$§!.

entries.zh: [target.solar_system.GetName]星系中一场对应类型的$default_storm$已经形成。
entries.en: A $default_storm$ of relevant type is created in the [target.solar_system.GetName] system.

entries.zh: 另一场风暴已经在酿造中。
entries.en: Another approach is already in progress.

entries.zh: 我们现在正在§H[target.solar_system.GetName]§!星系严阵以待，开始着手进行制造一场§Y$default_storm$§!的必要准备。\n\n通过暂时过载[target.GetName]，我们就可以为播种出所想要的星际气象学反应提供必要条件。
entries.en: We are now in position in the §H[target.solar_system.GetName]§! system and ready to begin the necessary preparations to generate a §Y$default_storm$§!.\n\nBy temporarily supercharging [target.GetName], we can create the ideal conditions to seed the desired astrometeorological reaction.

entries.zh: \n使用先进的能量操纵技术，我们可以用原材料使[target.GetName]过饱和来形成结构上更复杂的风暴。
entries.en: \nUsing advanced energy manipulation methods, we could oversaturate [target.GetName] with raw materials to form a more structurally complex storm.

entries.zh: \n这会是一笔时间成本不菲的投资，但其结果会是[owner.GetName]的巨大成就。在行动结束后，恒星本身将会恢复原状。
entries.en: \nThis will be a time-consuming endeavor, but the end result will be a great achievement for [owner.GetName]. The star itself will remain entirely intact after the operation is complete.

entries.en: The preparations towards the $default_storm$ in the §H[target.solar_system.GetName]§! system have reached a pivotal stage. The next actions require intense focus and new resource commitments to forge a §Y$solar_storm$§! by manipulating the solar winds of §H[target.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 对§H[target.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中$default_storm$的准备已经到了关键时刻，下一步行动非常关键，需要对这一项目做出更集中的资源承诺。
entries.en: The preparations towards the $default_storm$ in the §H[target.solar_system.GetName]§! system have reached a critical juncture. The next actions are crucial, and require more focused resource commitments to the cause.

entries.zh: 对§H[target.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中$default_storm$的准备已经到了关键阶段，[storm_researcher.GetName]的下一步行动需要高度专注以及更多资源投入，并将从[target.GetName]的膨胀状态受益。
entries.en: The preparations towards the $default_storm$ in the §H[target.solar_system.GetName]§! system have reached a pivotal stage. The next actions of [storm_researcher.GetName] require intense focus and new resource commitments to take advantage of the bloated state of [target.GetName].

entries.zh: 对§H[target.solar_system.GetName]§!星系中$default_storm$的准备已经到了关键时刻，[storm_researcher.GetName]的下一步行动非常关键，如果我们要从[target.GetName]的碰撞状态中获取优势，就需要对这一项目做出更集中的资源承诺。
entries.en: The preparations towards the $default_storm$ in the §H[target.solar_system.GetName]§! system have reached a critical juncture. The next actions of [storm_researcher.GetName] are crucial, and require more focused resource commitments to the cause, if we are to properly take advantage of the bloated of state of [target.GetName].

entries.zh: 驾驭$default_storm$的力量是一项不小的壮举，我们长年的耕耘终于到达了收获的时候了。
entries.en: Harnessing the power of the $default_storm$ has been no small feat. We can finally reap the long-awaited rewards of our endeavor.

entries.zh: 一场宇宙风暴磁化了大量以前未开发的矿物矿藏，使我们的采矿作业非常容易获取这些新资源。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm has magnetized an immense amount of previously unexploited mineral deposits, making it exceedingly easy for our mining operations to access these new resources.

entries.zh: 一场宇宙风暴蹂躏了这个行星，使得大量的铸造设备莫名其妙地带电。即使我们没有完全了解其机理，我们的合金产量也有了显著提高。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm that ravaged this planet has left a significant number of foundry equipment strangely charged. Even without fully understanding the mechanism, our alloy production has improved significantly.

entries.zh: 在经过的宇宙风暴的引力作用下，雄伟而漂浮的陆地可以直接移动到现有的工业园区上方。
entries.en: Magnetized by the gravitational effects of a passing cosmic storm, the majestic and floating landmasses can be maneuvered directly over existing industrial complexes.

entries.zh: 过境的宇宙风暴留下的不仅仅是毁灭。在[Planet.GetName]上，它还创造了一个全新的地理特征。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm has left more than mere devastation in its wake. On [Planet.GetName], it has created an entirely new geographical feature.

entries.zh: 一场令人难以置信的狂暴宇宙风暴将一个曾经繁荣的定居点变成了雷击的废墟，将我们平凡的建筑材料变成了稀有而不寻常的化合物。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm of incredible fury has transformed a once-thriving settlement into lightning-struck ruins, transmuting our mundane building materials into rare and unusual compounds.

entries.zh: 一场宇宙风暴对行星造成了如此集中的破坏，以至于留下了一道在太空中可见的伤疤。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm has unleashed such concentrated devastation upon the planet that it has carved a scar visible from space.

entries.zh: 一场宇宙风暴对无数民用船只的导航系统造成了严重破坏，将受灾最严重的地区变成了闹鬼的墓地，到处是破碎的船体和被摧毁的机器。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm has wreaked havoc on the navigation systems of countless civilian ships, turning the hardest-hit areas into haunting graveyards of broken hulks and decimated machinery.

entries.zh: 宇宙风暴把我们的一些郊区变成了废墟，仅存残骸用于研究。
entries.en: The Cosmic Storm has rendered some of our suburbs into ruins, fit only for study of the remains.

entries.zh: 宇宙风暴在这个星球上留下了一个巨大的撞击坑，残酷地提醒着宇宙对我们的存在漠不关心。
entries.en: The Cosmic Storm has left a tremendous crater on this world, a brutal reminder of cosmic indifference to our existence.

entries.zh: 宇宙风暴把几片巨大的平原变成了构造高活动区，巧合的是，危险的增加也伴随着易爆微粒的增产。
entries.en: The Cosmic Storm has turned several vast planes into areas of high tectonic activity, coincidentally the increase in danger has also come with an increase in volatile motes.

entries.zh: 宇宙风暴将这颗行星大气的臭氧层上撕开了一个洞。严重影响我们生活质量，但提高了生产力。
entries.en: The Cosmic Storm has torn a hole into the ozone layer of this planets atmosphere. While severely infringing on our quality of life, the quality of production has gone up.

entries.zh: 宇宙风暴用辐射洗涤了这个星球的高地，为我们的能源生产创造了一片升华之地。
entries.en: The Cosmic Storm has bathed the highlands of this world with radiation, creating a sublime ground for our energy production.

entries.zh: 宇宙风暴使整个沙漠发光，这是一种致命的景象，但如果有足够的安全措施，它就可以变成一个经济上可行的旅游景点。
entries.en: The Cosmic Storm has left entire desert aglow, a deadly view but with sufficient security measures it can turned into a financially viable tourist spot.

entries.zh: 一场经过的宇宙风暴的破坏性爆炸留下了锯齿状和尖刺晶体的景观，创造了一个危险但潜在利润丰厚的领域。
entries.en: The ravaging blasts of a passing cosmic storm have left behind a landscape of jagged and spiked crystals, creating a perilous yet potentially profitable terrain.

entries.zh: 一场宇宙风暴将整个沉积层炸飞，揭开了我们以前从未研究过的万年痕迹。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm has blasted away entire layers of sediment, unveiling traces of eons we have never before been able to study.

entries.zh: 一场转瞬即逝的宇宙风暴像巨浪一样席卷了这个世界。在它的尾迹中留下了一个闪闪发光的星尘沙丘的空灵景观。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm swept over this world like a great wave. In its wake, it left behind an ethereal landscape of glittering, stardust dunes.

entries.zh: 一场宇宙风暴的毁灭性引力效应已经压缩了几个以前被认为太不稳定而无法建设的地区，有效地给予我们免费的土地。
entries.en: The crushing gravitational effects of a passing cosmic storm have compacted several areas previously deemed too unstable for construction, effectively granting us free real estate.

entries.zh: 一场经过的宇宙风暴对我们一些比较脆弱的纪念碑施加了巨大的压力，使它们化为碎片与尘埃——这是一个谦逊的提醒，提醒着有可怕的力量在等待着我们。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm unleashed tremendous pressure on some of our more fragile monuments, reducing them to dust and debris - a humble reminder of the terrifying forces that await us out there.

entries.zh: 一场宇宙风暴把我们的一些采矿设施变成了破碎的超致密材料竖井。虽然我们重新开采这些矿山的尝试带来了工程和钻探方面的新理论，但在回收这些矿山方面进展甚微。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm has transformed some of our mining complexes into broken shafts of hyper-compact material. While our attempts to reopen them have sparked new theories in engineering and drilling, they have made little progress in reclaiming the mines.

entries.zh: 一场宇宙风暴在我们的牲口中传播了寄生虫。它们在我们的现实世界和虚境之间相位变换，同时它们被证实是可食用的、健康的，而且意外地很美味。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm has spread parasites among our livestock. Phasing between our reality and the Shroud, they have proven to be edible, healthy and surprisingly delicious.

entries.zh: 经过一场短暂的宇宙风暴，这个行星上最翠绿的生物群落已经变成了摇摆不定的泽珞场。这些是我们所见过的最纯净的矿藏。
entries.en: Transformed by a passing cosmic storm, this planet's most verdant biomes have become wavering fields of Zro. These are some of the purest deposits we have ever encountered.

entries.zh: 一场过境的宇宙风暴给我们留下了一份令人惊奇的礼物。这颗星球上最大的水体泛起了涟漪，组织出了某种看起来很重要的图案和符号，并能够以惊人的智慧回答问题。
entries.en: A passing cosmic storm has left us with a strange and wonderful gift. The largest body of water on this planet forms ripples that create patterns and symbols of obvious importance, capable of answering inquiries with surprising wisdom.

entries.zh: 虚境的帷幕覆盖在这个天体上，它们不自然的存在表明，这要么是一个深刻的破口，要么是一场灾难性虚境风暴的后果。
entries.en: Veils of the Shroud linger upon this celestial body, their unnatural presence suggesting either a profound breach or the aftermath of a catastrophic Shroud Storm.

entries.zh: 在一阵灵能风暴中，[from.GetName]被替成了来源不明的[from.GetClassName]。
entries.en: In a flurry of psionic activity, [from.GetName] was switched with a [from.GetClassName] from parts unknown.

entries.zh: 一股灵能浪潮席卷了[from.GetName]，使其部分人口发生了违背自然法则的改变。整个群体都被重塑了，它们的形态变得奇怪而陌生，仿佛有某种我们无法理解的东西改写了他们的本质。
entries.en: A surge of psionic energy has swept through [from.GetName], leaving parts of its population altered in ways that defy natural law. Entire groups have been reshaped, their forms now alien and unfamiliar, as if something beyond our understanding has rewritten their very essence.

entries.zh: 一股灵能浪潮重塑了[from.GetName]，时期变成了一颗具有截然不同性质的新恒星。如今，一颗[from.GetClassName]正向[from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系投射着它怪异的光，仿佛现实本身被扭曲了一般。
entries.en: A surge of psionic energy has remade [from.GetName], transforming it into a star of an entirely new nature. Now, a [from.GetClassName] casts its strange light upon the [from.solar_system.GetName] System, as if reality itself has been altered.

entries.zh: 即使是恒星也未能幸免……
entries.en: Even the stars are not immune...

entries.zh: 最聪明高贵的贵族后代学礼双修，诠释着他们至高无上的地位。
entries.en: The brightest and most noble of scions are educated in both decorum and the scientific method, to better explain their positions of supremacy.

entries.zh: 予神性以血统方是正道。予血统以神性是手段。因此，我们的高贵是受到天佑的。
entries.en: Divinity by Inheritance is the way. Inheritance by Divinity is the means. Thus we are blessed with nobility.

entries.zh: 能引导我们帝国的，除了这些以如此唾手可得实惠价格和最长的保修供应自我提升的人以外还有谁呢。
entries.en: Who could possibly guide our empire but the ones who offer self-improvement at such an affordable cost and with an extended warranty on top.

entries.zh: 不为先例所拘，也无谦卑之累，这些明日的梦想家将大胆的想象化为可售的现实。于真正的先驱而言，进步不仅是信条，更是商品。
entries.en: Unfettered by precedent and unburdened by humility, these dreamers of tomorrow transmute bold speculation into marketable reality. To a true visionary, progress is not merely a principle; it is a product.

entries.zh: 统治权并非由继承决定，而是由一个人的价值衡量；而衡量价值的最佳方式，难道不就是看资产负债表上的总额吗？
entries.en: The right to rule is determined not by inheritance, but by the measure of one's worth; and how better to measure your worth than by the sum total of the balance sheet?
